>packages/app/src/routes/upload.post.ts

   1| |import { post } from "@flux/core/http";
   2| |import { mkdir } from "node:fs/promises";
   4| |export default post(async (ctx) => {
   5| |  const file = await ctx.body.file();
   7| |  if (!file) {
   8| |    return ctx.json({ error: "file required" }, { status: 400 });
   9| |  }
  11| |  await mkdir("uploads", { recursive: true });
  13| |  const safeName = file.name.replace(/[^\w.\-]+/g, "_");
  14| |  const storedName = `${Date.now().toString(36)}-${safeName}`;
  15| |  const dest = `uploads/${storedName}`;
  17| |  await Bun.write(dest, file);
  19| |  return ctx.json({
  20| |    ok: true,
  21| |    size: file.size,
  22| |    type: file.type,
  23| |    path: `/files/${storedName}`,
  24| |  });
  25| |});

   1| |import { mkdir, writeFile, access, readFile, readdir } from "node:fs/promises";
   2| |import { dirname } from "node:path";
   4|▼|export async function exists(path: string): Promise<boolean> {
   5| |  try {
   6| |    await access(path);
   7| |    return true;
   8| |  } catch {
   9| |    return false;
  10| |  }
  11| |}
  13|▼|export async function writeFileEnsuringDir(path: string, data: string): Promise<void> {
  14| |  await mkdir(dirname(path), { recursive: true });
  15| |  await writeFile(path, data, "utf8");
  16| |}
  18|▼|export async function readTextFile(path: string): Promise<string> {
  19| |  return readFile(path, "utf8");
  20| |}
  22|▼|export async function isDirEmpty(path: string): Promise<boolean> {
  23| |  try {
  24| |    const entries = await readdir(path);
  25| |    return entries.length === 0;
  26| |  } catch {
  27| |    return true;
  28| |  }
  29| |}

>packages/cli/src/utils/route.ts
e:ROUTE_METHODS|RouteMethod|ParsedRoute|parseRouteInput
f:normalizeMethod(input: string | undefined)
f:parseRouteInput(raw: string, methodFlag?: string)
t:RouteMethod
t:ParsedRoute
---
   1| |export const ROUTE_METHODS = ["get", "post", "put", "patch", "del", "all"] as const;
   3|▼|export type RouteMethod = (typeof ROUTE_METHODS)[number];
   5|▼|export interface ParsedRoute {
   6| |  method: RouteMethod;
   7| |  file: string;
   8| |  routePath: string;
   9| |  paramNames: string[];
  10| |  isDynamic: boolean;
  11| |}
  13| |const METHOD_ALIASES: Record<string, RouteMethod> = {
  14| |  get: "get",
  15| |  post: "post",
  16| |  put: "put",
  17| |  patch: "patch",
  18| |  del: "del",
  19| |  delete: "del",
  20| |  all: "all",
  21| |};
  23|▼|function normalizeMethod(input: string | undefined): RouteMethod | undefined {
  24| |  if (!input) return undefined;
  25| |  return METHOD_ALIASES[input.toLowerCase()];
  26| |}
  28|▼|export function parseRouteInput(raw: string, methodFlag?: string): ParsedRoute {
  29| |  let input = raw
  30| |    .trim()
  31| |    .replace(/\.ts$/, "")
  32| |    .replace(/^\//, "");
  34| |  if (!input) {
  35|!|    throw new Error("Route path is required.");
  36| |  }
  38| |  let method: RouteMethod = normalizeMethod(methodFlag) ?? "get";
  40| |  const lastDot = input.lastIndexOf(".");
  41| |  if (lastDot > 0) {
  42| |    const maybeMethod = input.slice(lastDot + 1);
  43| |    const normalized = normalizeMethod(maybeMethod);
  45| |    if (normalized) {
  46| |      method = normalized;
  47| |      input = input.slice(0, lastDot);
  48| |    }
  49| |  }
  51| |  if (!input) {
  52| |    input = "index";
  53| |  }
  55| |  const file = `${input}.${method}.ts`;
  57| |  const segments = input === "index" ? [] : input.split("/").filter(Boolean);
  58| |  const paramNames: string[] = [];
  60| |  const pathSegments = segments.map((segment) => {
  61| |    const catchAll = segment.match(/^\[\.\.\.(.+)\]$/);
  62| |    if (catchAll) {
  63| |      const name = catchAll[1]!;
  64| |      paramNames.push(name);
  65| |      return `*${name}`;
  66| |    }
  68| |    const param = segment.match(/^\[(.+)\]$/);
  69| |    if (param) {
  70| |      const name = param[1]!;
  71| |      paramNames.push(name);
  72| |      return `:${name}`;
  73| |    }
  75| |    return segment;
  76| |  });
  78| |  const routePath = `/${pathSegments.join("/")}`;
  80| |  return {
  81| |    method,
  82| |    file,
  83| |    routePath,
  84| |    paramNames,
  85| |    isDynamic: paramNames.length > 0,
  86| |  };
  87| |}

   1| |/**
   2| | * Minimal functional core used by the compiler.
   3| | *
   4| | * This intentionally removes unused utility-belt code and external dependencies.
   5| | * If you need debounce/throttle/memoize/retry, add them in a separate optional
   6| | * module and do not import them into core runtime paths.
   7| | */
   9|▼|export type Result<T, E = string> =
  10| |  | { readonly ok: true; readonly value: T }
  11| |  | { readonly ok: false; readonly error: E };
  13|▼|export const ok = <T>(value: T): Result<T, never> => ({ ok: true, value });
  15|▼|export const err = <E>(error: E): Result<never, E> => ({ ok: false, error });
  17| |export const isOk = <T, E>(r: Result<T, E>): r is { ok: true; value: T } => r.ok;
  19| |export const isErr = <T, E>(r: Result<T, E>): r is { ok: false; error: E } => !r.ok;
  21|▼|export const unwrapOr =
  22| |  <T>(fallback: T) =>
  23| |  (r: Result<T>): T =>
  24| |    r.ok ? r.value : fallback;
  26|▼|export const unwrapOrElse =
  27| |  <T, E>(fn: (e: E) => T) =>
  28| |  (r: Result<T, E>): T =>
  29| |    r.ok ? r.value : fn(r.error);
  31|▼|export const mapResult =
  32| |  <T, U>(fn: (x: T) => U) =>
  33| |  <E>(r: Result<T, E>): Result<U, E> =>
  34| |    r.ok ? ok(fn(r.value)) : r;
  36|▼|export const flatMapResult =
  37| |  <T, U, E>(fn: (x: T) => Result<U, E>) =>
  38| |  (r: Result<T, E>): Result<U, E> =>
  39| |    r.ok ? fn(r.value) : r;
  41|▼|export const mapErr =
  42| |  <E, F>(fn: (e: E) => F) =>
  43| |  <T>(r: Result<T, E>): Result<T, F> =>
  44| |    r.ok ? r : err(fn(r.error));
  46|▼|export const tryCatch = <T>(fn: () => T): Result<T, unknown> => {
  47| |  try {
  48| |    return ok(fn());
  49|!|  } catch (error) {
  50| |    return err(error);
  51| |  }
  52| |};
  54|▼|export const tryCatchAsync = async <T>(fn: () => Promise<T>): Promise<Result<T, unknown>> => {
  55| |  try {
  56| |    return ok(await fn());
  57|!|  } catch (error) {
  58| |    return err(error);
  59| |  }
  60| |};
  62|▼|export const tryCatchOr = <T>(fallback: T, fn: () => T): T => {
  63| |  try {
  64| |    return fn();
  65| |  } catch {
  66| |    return fallback;
  67| |  }
  68| |};
  70|▼|export type Task<T> = () => Promise<T>;
  72|▼|export const taskMap =
  73| |  <T, U>(fn: (x: T) => U) =>
  74| |  (task: Task<T>): Task<U> =>
  75| |  async () =>
  76| |    fn(await task());
  78|▼|export const taskChain =
  79| |  <T, U>(fn: (x: T) => Task<U>) =>
  80| |  (task: Task<T>): Task<U> =>
  81| |  async () =>
  82| |    fn(await task())();
  84|▼|export const taskFromResult =
  85| |  <T>(value: T): Task<T> =>
  86| |  async () =>
  87| |    value;
  89|▼|export const pipe =
  90| |  <A>(a: A) =>
  91| |  <B>(...fns: Array<(x: any) => any>): B =>
  92| |    fns.reduce((acc: any, fn) => fn(acc), a) as unknown as B;

   1| |/**
   2| | * @fileoverview Structured Logger
   3| | * All side-effecting I/O is centralized here. Compiler phases receive a Logger
   4| | * interface and remain pure except for logging calls.
   5| | */
   7|▼|export interface Logger {
   8| |  debug(msg: string, meta?: Record<string, unknown>): void;
   9| |  info(msg: string, meta?: Record<string, unknown>): void;
  10| |  warn(msg: string, meta?: Record<string, unknown>): void;
  11| |  error(msg: string, meta?: Record<string, unknown>): void;
  12| |  /** Time a phase and log duration. */
  13| |  time<T>(label: string, fn: () => T): T;
  14| |}
  16| |/** No-op logger for tests and silent mode. */
  17| |export const silentLogger: Logger = {
  18| |  debug: () => {},
  19| |  info: () => {},
  20| |  warn: () => {},
  21| |  error: () => {},
  22| |  time: (_, fn) => fn(),
  23| |};
  25| |/** Console logger with emoji prefixes and structured metadata. */
  26|▼|export const consoleLogger = (verbose = false): Logger => ({
  27| |  debug(msg, meta) {
  28| |    if (verbose) console.log(`[debug] ${msg}`, meta ?? "");
  29| |  },
  30| |  info(msg, meta) {
  31| |    console.log(`ℹ️  ${msg}`, meta ?? "");
  32| |  },
  33| |  warn(msg, meta) {
  34| |    console.warn(`⚠️  ${msg}`, meta ?? "");
  35| |  },
  36| |  error(msg, meta) {
  37| |    console.error(`❌ ${msg}`, meta ?? "");
  38| |  },
  39| |  time(label, fn) {
  40| |    const t0 = performance.now();
  41| |    const result = fn();
  42| |    const elapsed = (performance.now() - t0).toFixed(2);
  43| |    console.log(`⏱️  ${label} completed in ${elapsed}ms`);
  44| |    return result;
  45| |  },
  46| |});
  48| |/** Enterprise-grade JSON logger for CI/CD pipelines. */
  49|▼|export const jsonLogger = (verbose = false): Logger => ({
  50| |  debug(msg, meta) {
  51| |    if (verbose) console.log(JSON.stringify({ level: "debug", msg, ...meta }));
  52| |  },
  53| |  info(msg, meta) {
  54| |    console.log(JSON.stringify({ level: "info", msg, ...meta }));
  55| |  },
  56| |  warn(msg, meta) {
  57| |    console.log(JSON.stringify({ level: "warn", msg, ...meta }));
  58| |  },
  59| |  error(msg, meta) {
  60| |    console.log(JSON.stringify({ level: "error", msg, ...meta }));
  61| |  },
  62| |  time(label, fn) {
  63| |    const t0 = performance.now();
  64| |    const result = fn();
  65| |    const elapsed = (performance.now() - t0).toFixed(2);
  66| |    console.log(JSON.stringify({ level: "metric", phase: label, durationMs: parseFloat(elapsed) }));
  67| |    return result;
  68| |  },
  69| |});

>packages/compiler/src/phases/schema-loader.ts
i:node:url
e:loadRouteModule|isStandardSchema|cloneSchema
f:loadRouteModule(
  absPath: string
):Promise<any | undefined>|a
f:isStandardSchema(value: unknown):boolean
f:cloneSchema(value: unknown):any
---
   1| |/**
   2| | * Build-time route schema loader.
   3| | *
   4| | * Bun 1.4 edition:
   5| | * - dynamic import remains native Bun TS import
   6| | * - structuredClone for schema cloning
   7| | */
   9| |import { pathToFileURL } from "node:url";
  11| |const moduleCache = new Map<string, unknown>();
  13|▼|export const loadRouteModule = async (
  14| |  absPath: string
  15| |): Promise<any | undefined> => {
  16| |  if (moduleCache.has(absPath)) {
  17| |    return moduleCache.get(absPath);
  18| |  }
  20| |  try {
  21| |    const url = pathToFileURL(absPath).href;
  22| |    const mod: any = await import(url);
  24| |    const handler = mod?.default;
  26| |    const inlineSchema =
  27| |      handler != null && typeof handler === "object" && "schema" in handler
  28| |        ? handler.schema
  29| |        : typeof handler === "function" && "schema" in handler
  30| |          ? handler.schema
  31| |          : undefined;
  33| |    const schema = mod?.schema ?? inlineSchema;
  34| |    const normalized = schema === undefined ? mod : { ...mod, schema };
  36| |    moduleCache.set(absPath, normalized);
  38| |    return normalized;
  39| |  } catch {
  40| |    moduleCache.set(absPath, undefined);
  41| |    return undefined;
  42| |  }
  43| |};
  45|▼|export const isStandardSchema = (value: unknown): boolean => {
  46| |  return (
  47| |    typeof value === "object" &&
  48| |    value !== null &&
  49| |    "~standard" in value
  50| |  );
  51| |};
  53|▼|export const cloneSchema = (value: unknown): any => {
  54| |  try {
  55| |    return structuredClone(value);
  56| |  } catch {
  57| |    return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(value));
  58| |  }
  59| |};

>packages/compiler/src/utils/hash.ts
e:fnv1a|computeSignatureHash
f:fnv1a(str: string):number
f:computeSignatureHash(methodIdx: number, path: string):number
---
   1| |/**
   2| | * Hash utilities used by route analysis.
   3| | *
   4| | * Removed:
   5| | * - canUseDenseArray
   6| | * - generatePerfectHash
   7| | * - segmentHash
   8| | *
   9| | * These belonged to the unused jump-table optimizer path.
  10| | */
  12|▼|export const fnv1a = (str: string): number => {
  13| |  let hash = 0x811c9dc5;
  15| |  for (let i = 0; i < str.length; i++) {
  16| |    hash ^= str.charCodeAt(i);
  17| |    hash += (hash << 1) + (hash << 4) + (hash << 7) + (hash << 8) + (hash << 24);
  18| |  }
  20| |  return hash >>> 0;
  21| |};
  23|▼|export const computeSignatureHash = (methodIdx: number, path: string): number => {
  24| |  const pathHash = fnv1a(path);
  25| |  return ((methodIdx & 0x07) << 29) | (pathHash >>> 3);
  26| |};

t:BodyKind
t:LazyBody
t:BodyParser

   1| |/**
   2| | * @fileoverview Lazy body parsing for production performance.
   3| | *
   4| | * Body parsing is deferred until actually needed.
   5| | * Uses Bun-native parsers:
   6| | * - req.json()
   7| | * - req.text()
   8| | * - req.formData()
   9| | * - req.arrayBuffer()
  10| | */
  12|▼|export class BodyParseError extends Error {
  13| |  constructor(
  14| |    message: string,
  15| |    public status = 400
  16| |  ) {
  17| |    super(message);
  18| |    this.name = "BodyParseError";
  19| |  }
  20| |}
  22|▼|export interface LazyBodyOptions {
  23| |  maxJsonBytes?: number;
  24| |  maxTextBytes?: number;
  25| |  maxFormBytes?: number;
  26| |  maxFileBytes?: number;
  27| |}
  29|▼|type BodyKind =
  30| |  | "none"
  31| |  | "json"
  32| |  | "text"
  33| |  | "formData"
  34| |  | "arrayBuffer"
  35| |  | "blob";
  37|▼|export interface LazyBody {
  38| |  (): Promise<unknown>;
  40| |  json<T = unknown>(): Promise<T>;
  41| |  text(): Promise<string>;
  42| |  form(): Promise<Record<string, string>>;
  43| |  multipart(): Promise<Record<string, unknown>>;
  44| |  formData(): Promise<FormData>;
  46| |  file(name?: string): Promise<File | null>;
  47| |  files(name?: string): Promise<File[]>;
  49| |  arrayBuffer(): Promise<ArrayBuffer>;
  50| |  blob(): Promise<Blob>;
  52| |  /**
  53| |   * Returns the raw request stream if the body has not been consumed.
  54| |   * Useful for proxying or streaming uploads downstream.
  55| |   */
  56| |  stream(): ReadableStream<Uint8Array> | null;
  58| |  readonly consumed: boolean;
  59| |  readonly parsed: unknown;
  60| |}
  62| |const DEFAULT_LIMITS = {
  63| |  maxJsonBytes: 2 * 1024 * 1024,
  64| |  maxTextBytes: 2 * 1024 * 1024,
  65| |  maxFormBytes: 2 * 1024 * 1024,
  66| |  maxFileBytes: 20 * 1024 * 1024,
  67| |};
  69|▼|const forEachFormDataEntry = (
  70| |  fd: FormData,
  71| |  cb: (value: unknown, key: string) => void,
  72| |): void => {
  73| |  const forEach = (fd as unknown as { forEach?: unknown }).forEach;
  75| |  if (typeof forEach === "function") {
  76| |    (forEach as (cb: (value: unknown, key: string) => void) => void).call(
  77| |      fd,
  78| |      cb,
  79| |    );
  80| |  }
  81| |};
  83|▼|const getFormDataEntry = (fd: FormData, name: string): unknown => {
  84| |  const get = (fd as unknown as { get?: unknown }).get;
  86| |  if (typeof get !== "function") {
  87| |    return null;
  88| |  }
  90| |  return (get as (name: string) => unknown).call(fd, name);
  91| |};
  93|▼|const getAllFormDataEntries = (fd: FormData, name: string): unknown[] => {
  94| |  const getAll = (fd as unknown as { getAll?: unknown }).getAll;
  96| |  if (typeof getAll !== "function") {
  97| |    return [];
  98| |  }
 100|▼|  const values = (getAll as (name: string) => unknown).call(fd, name);
 102| |  return Array.isArray(values) ? values : [];
 103| |};
 105|▼|const isFile = (value: unknown): value is File =>
 106| |  typeof File !== "undefined" && value instanceof File;
 108|▼|function formDataToRecord(fd: FormData): Record<string, string> {
 109| |  const out: Record<string, string> = {};
 111| |  forEachFormDataEntry(fd, (value, key) => {
 112| |    if (typeof value === "string") {
 113| |      out[key] = value;
 114| |    } else if (isFile(value)) {
 115| |      out[key] = value.name;
 116| |    }
 117| |  });
 119| |  return out;
 120| |}
 122|▼|function formDataToObject(fd: FormData): Record<string, unknown> {
 123| |  const out: Record<string, unknown> = {};
 125| |  forEachFormDataEntry(fd, (value, key) => {
 126| |    const existing = out[key];
 128| |    if (existing === undefined) {
 129| |      out[key] = value;
 130| |    } else if (Array.isArray(existing)) {
 131| |      existing.push(value);
 132| |    } else {
 133| |      out[key] = [existing, value];
 134| |    }
 135| |  });
 137| |  return out;
 138| |}
 140|▼|export function createLazyBody(
 141| |  req: Request,
 142| |  opts: LazyBodyOptions = {}
 143| |): LazyBody {
 144| |  const limits = {
 145| |    maxJsonBytes: opts.maxJsonBytes ?? DEFAULT_LIMITS.maxJsonBytes,
 146| |    maxTextBytes: opts.maxTextBytes ?? DEFAULT_LIMITS.maxTextBytes,
 147| |    maxFormBytes: opts.maxFormBytes ?? DEFAULT_LIMITS.maxFormBytes,
 148| |    maxFileBytes: opts.maxFileBytes ?? DEFAULT_LIMITS.maxFileBytes,
 149| |  };
 151| |  let kind: BodyKind = "none";
 152| |  let value: unknown;
 154| |  let pending: Promise<unknown> | null = null;
 155| |  let pendingKind: BodyKind | null = null;
 157|▼|  function assertSize(max?: number): void {
 158| |    if (!max) return;
 160| |    const len = Number(req.headers.get("content-length") || "0");
 161| |    if (Number.isFinite(len) && len > max) {
 162|!|      throw new BodyParseError("Payload too large", 413);
 163| |    }
 164| |  }
 166|▼|  function convert<T>(target: BodyKind): T {
 167| |    if (kind === target) return value as T;
 169| |    if (kind === "json") {
 170| |      const text = JSON.stringify(value);
 172| |      if (target === "text") return text as T;
 173| |      if (target === "arrayBuffer") {
 174| |        return new TextEncoder().encode(text).buffer as T;
 175| |      }
 176| |      if (target === "blob") {
 177| |        return new Blob([text], { type: "application/json" }) as T;
 178| |      }
 179| |    }
 181| |    if (kind === "text") {
 182| |      const text = value as string;
 184| |      if (target === "json") return JSON.parse(text) as T;
 185| |      if (target === "arrayBuffer") {
 186| |        return new TextEncoder().encode(text).buffer as T;
 187| |      }
 188| |      if (target === "blob") return new Blob([text]) as T;
 190| |      if (target === "formData") {
 191| |        const fd = new FormData();
 192| |        new URLSearchParams(text).forEach((v, k) => fd.append(k, v));
 193| |        return fd as T;
 194| |      }
 195| |    }
 197| |    if (kind === "arrayBuffer") {
 198| |      const buf = value as ArrayBuffer;
 199| |      const text = new TextDecoder().decode(buf);
 201| |      if (target === "text") return text as T;
 202| |      if (target === "json") return JSON.parse(text) as T;
 203| |      if (target === "blob") return new Blob([buf]) as T;
 204| |    }
 206| |    if (kind === "formData") {
 207| |      const fd = value as FormData;
 209| |      if (target === "text") {
 210| |        const params = new URLSearchParams();
 212| |        forEachFormDataEntry(fd, (v, k) => {
 213| |          if (typeof v === "string") {
 214| |            params.append(k, v);
 215| |          }
 216| |        });
 218| |        return params.toString() as T;
 219| |      }
 220| |    }
 222|!|    throw new BodyParseError(
 223| |      `Body already consumed as "${kind}"; cannot parse as "${target}".`,
 224| |      409
 225| |    );
 226| |  }
 228|▼|  async function use<T>(
 229| |    target: BodyKind,
 230| |    parser: () => Promise<T>,
 231| |    max?: number
 232| |  ): Promise<T> {
 233| |    if (kind === target) return value as T;
 234| |    if (kind !== "none") return convert<T>(target);
 236| |    if (pending) {
 237| |      if (pendingKind === target) return pending as Promise<T>;
 239|!|      throw new BodyParseError(
 240| |        `Body parse already in progress as "${pendingKind}".`,
 241| |        409
 242| |      );
 243| |    }
 245| |    assertSize(max);
 247| |    pendingKind = target;
 249| |    pending = parser()
 250| |      .then((v) => {
 251| |        kind = target;
 252| |        value = v;
 253| |        pending = null;
 254| |        pendingKind = null;
 255| |        return v;
 256| |      })
 257| |      .catch((err) => {
 258| |        pending = null;
 259| |        pendingKind = null;
 260|!|        throw err;
 261| |      });
 263| |    return pending as Promise<T>;
 264| |  }
 266|▼|  function assertFileSize(file: File): void {
 267| |    if (limits.maxFileBytes && file.size > limits.maxFileBytes) {
 268|!|      throw new BodyParseError("File too large", 413);
 269| |    }
 270| |  }
 272|▼|  const fn = async (): Promise<unknown> => {
 273| |    if (req.method === "GET" || req.method === "HEAD" || req.method === "OPTIONS") {
 274| |      return undefined;
 275| |    }
 277| |    const ct = (req.headers.get("content-type") || "")
 278| |      .split(";")[0]
 279| |      ?.trim()
 280| |      .toLowerCase();
 282| |    if (!ct) return undefined;
 284| |    const self = fn as unknown as LazyBody;
 286| |    if (ct.includes("json")) return self.json();
 287| |    if (ct.includes("x-www-form-urlencoded")) return self.form();
 288| |    if (ct.includes("multipart/form-data")) return self.multipart();
 289| |    if (ct.startsWith("text/")) return self.text();
 291| |    return self.arrayBuffer();
 292| |  };
 294| |  const body = fn as unknown as LazyBody;
 296| |  body.json = <T = unknown>() =>
 297| |    use<T>(
 298| |      "json",
 299| |      async () => {
 300| |        try {
 301| |          return (await req.json()) as T;
 302| |        } catch {
 303|!|          throw new BodyParseError("Invalid JSON body", 400);
 304| |        }
 305| |      },
 306| |      limits.maxJsonBytes,
 307| |    );
 309| |  body.text = () =>
 310| |    use<string>(
 311| |      "text",
 312| |      async () => {
 313| |        try {
 314| |          return await req.text();
 315| |        } catch {
 316|!|          throw new BodyParseError("Invalid text body", 400);
 317| |        }
 318| |      },
 319| |      limits.maxTextBytes
 320| |    );
 322| |  body.arrayBuffer = () =>
 323| |    use<ArrayBuffer>(
 324| |      "arrayBuffer",
 325| |      async () => {
 326| |        try {
 327| |          return await req.arrayBuffer();
 328| |        } catch {
 329|!|          throw new BodyParseError("Invalid binary body", 400);
 330| |        }
 331| |      },
 332| |      limits.maxFileBytes
 333| |    );
 335| |  body.blob = () =>
 336| |    use<Blob>(
 337| |      "blob",
 338| |      async () => {
 339| |        try {
 340| |          return await req.blob();
 341| |        } catch {
 342|!|          throw new BodyParseError("Invalid blob body", 400);
 343| |        }
 344| |      },
 345| |      limits.maxFileBytes
 346| |    );
 348| |  body.formData = () =>
 349| |    use<FormData>(
 350| |      "formData",
 351| |      async () => {
 352| |        try {
 353| |          return (await req.formData()) as unknown as FormData;
 354| |        } catch {
 355|!|          throw new BodyParseError("Invalid form/multipart body", 400);
 356| |        }
 357| |      },
 358| |      limits.maxFormBytes,
 359| |    );
 361| |  body.form = async () => {
 362| |    const fd = await body.formData();
 363| |    return formDataToRecord(fd);
 364| |  };
 366| |  body.multipart = async () => {
 367| |    const fd = await body.formData();
 368| |    return formDataToObject(fd);
 369| |  };
 371| |body.file = async (name?: string) => {
 372| |  const fd = await body.formData();
 374| |  if (name) {
 375| |    const value = getFormDataEntry(fd, name);
 377| |    if (isFile(value)) {
 378| |      assertFileSize(value);
 379| |      return value;
 380| |    }
 382| |    return null;
 383| |  }
 385| |  let found: File | null = null;
 387| |  forEachFormDataEntry(fd, (value) => {
 388| |    if (!found && isFile(value)) {
 389| |      assertFileSize(value);
 390| |      found = value;
 391| |    }
 392| |  });
 394| |  return found;
 395| |};
 397| |body.files = async (name?: string) => {
 398| |  const fd = await body.formData();
 399| |  const files: File[] = [];
 401| |  if (name) {
 402| |    for (const value of getAllFormDataEntries(fd, name)) {
 403| |      if (isFile(value)) {
 404| |        assertFileSize(value);
 405| |        files.push(value);
 406| |      }
 407| |    }
 409| |    return files;
 410| |  }
 412| |  forEachFormDataEntry(fd, (value) => {
 413| |    if (isFile(value)) {
 414| |      assertFileSize(value);
 415| |      files.push(value);
 416| |    }
 417| |  });
 419| |  return files;
 420| |};
 422| |  body.stream = () => {
 423| |    if (kind !== "none") return null;
 424| |    return req.body;
 425| |  };
 427| |  Object.defineProperty(body, "consumed", {
 428| |    get: () => kind !== "none",
 429| |  });
 431| |  Object.defineProperty(body, "parsed", {
 432| |    get: () => value,
 433| |  });
 435| |  return body;
 436| |}
 438| |// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 439| |// Backward compatibility helpers
 440| |// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 442|▼|export interface BodyParser {
 443| |  readonly contentTypes: readonly string[];
 444| |  parse(req: Request): Promise<unknown>;
 445| |}
 447| |export const jsonParser: BodyParser = {
 448| |  contentTypes: ["application/json"],
 449| |  async parse(req) {
 450| |    return createLazyBody(req).json();
 451| |  },
 452| |};
 454| |export const formUrlEncodedParser: BodyParser = {
 455| |  contentTypes: ["application/x-www-form-urlencoded"],
 456| |  async parse(req) {
 457| |    return createLazyBody(req).form();
 458| |  },
 459| |};
 461| |export const multipartParser: BodyParser = {
 462| |  contentTypes: ["multipart/form-data"],
 463| |  async parse(req) {
 464| |    return createLazyBody(req).multipart();
 465| |  },
 466| |};
 468| |export const defaultParsers: readonly BodyParser[] = [
 469| |  jsonParser,
 470| |  formUrlEncodedParser,
 471| |  multipartParser,
 472| |];
 474|▼|export async function parseBody(
 475| |  req: Request,
 476| |  _parsers: readonly BodyParser[] = defaultParsers
 477| |): Promise<unknown> {
 478| |  return createLazyBody(req)();
 479| |}
 481|▼|export function needsBodyParse(method: string): boolean {
 482| |  return method !== "GET" && method !== "HEAD" && method !== "OPTIONS";
 483| |}

   1| |/**
   2| | * Multi-core server helper.
   3| | *
   4| | * Fixed:
   5| | * - uses node:os availableParallelism()
   6| | * - avoids extending a union type
   7| | * - satisfies exactOptionalPropertyTypes
   8| | */
  10| |import { availableParallelism } from "node:os";
  12|▼|export type ServeOptions = Parameters<typeof Bun.serve>[0];
  14|▼|export type ClusterServeOptions = ServeOptions & {
  15| |  workers?: number | "auto";
  16| |};
  18|▼|export function serveCluster(options: ClusterServeOptions) {
  19| |  const requested = options.workers ?? 1;
  21| |  const count =
  22| |    requested === "auto"
  23| |      ? Math.max(1, availableParallelism())
  24| |      : Math.max(1, Number(requested));
  26| |  const serveOptions: Record<string, unknown> = { ...options };
  28| |  delete serveOptions.workers;
  30| |  if (count > 1) {
  31| |    serveOptions.reusePort = true;
  32| |  }
  34| |  const servers = Array.from({ length: count }, () =>
  35| |    Bun.serve(serveOptions as unknown as ServeOptions),
  36| |  );
  38| |  return {
  39| |    servers,
  40| |    port: servers[0]?.port,
  41| |    stop() {
  42| |      for (const server of servers) {
  43| |        server.stop();
  44| |      }
  45| |    },
  46| |  };
  47| |}

   1| |/**
   2| | * @fileoverview Structured Error Types v3.0
   3| | * Serializable, traceable, production-safe.
   4| | */
   6|▼|export class HTTPError extends Error {
   7| |  constructor(
   8| |    public readonly status: number,
   9| |    message: string,
  10| |    public readonly code?: string,
  11| |    public readonly details?: Record<string, unknown>
  12| |  ) {
  13| |    super(message);
  14| |    this.name = "HTTPError";
  15| |  }
  17| |  toJSON() {
  18| |    return {
  19| |      error: this.message,
  20| |      status: this.status,
  21| |      code: this.code,
  22| |      ...(this.details ? { details: this.details } : {}),
  23| |    };
  24| |  }
  26| |  toResponse(headers?: Record<string, string>): Response {
  27| |    return Response.json(this.toJSON(), {
  28| |      status: this.status,
  29| |      headers: { "content-type": "application/json", ...headers },
  30| |    });
  31| |  }
  32| |}
  34|▼|export class ValidationError extends HTTPError {
  35| |  constructor(
  36| |    message: string,
  37| |    public readonly errors: Record<string, string[]>,
  38| |    public readonly on?: string
  39| |  ) {
  40| |    super(422, message, "VALIDATION_ERROR", { errors, on });
  41| |    this.name = "ValidationError";
  42| |  }
  43| |}
  45|▼|export class NotFoundError extends HTTPError {
  46| |  constructor(resource?: string) {
  47| |    super(404, resource ? `${resource} not found` : "Not Found", "NOT_FOUND");
  48| |    this.name = "NotFoundError";
  49| |  }
  50| |}
  52|▼|export class UnauthorizedError extends HTTPError {
  53| |  constructor(message = "Unauthorized") {
  54| |    super(401, message, "UNAUTHORIZED");
  55| |    this.name = "UnauthorizedError";
  56| |  }
  57| |}
  59|▼|export class ForbiddenError extends HTTPError {
  60| |  constructor(message = "Forbidden") {
  61| |    super(403, message, "FORBIDDEN");
  62| |    this.name = "ForbiddenError";
  63| |  }
  64| |}
  66|▼|export class ConflictError extends HTTPError {
  67| |  constructor(message = "Conflict") {

  69| |    this.name = "ConflictError";
  70| |  }
  71| |}
  73|▼|export class TooManyRequestsError extends HTTPError {

  95|▼|export class InvalidCookieSignature extends HTTPError {

  98| |    this.name = "InvalidCookieSignature";
  99| |  }
 100| |}
 102| |// ============================================================================
 103| |// Error → Response Mapping

 106|▼|export const errorToResponse = (err: unknown, exposeDetails = false): Response => {
 107| |  if (err instanceof HTTPError) return err.toResponse();
 109| |  const message = exposeDetails && err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Internal Server Error";
 110| |  return Response.json(
 111| |    { error: message, status: 500, code: "INTERNAL_ERROR" },
 112| |    { status: 500 }
 113| |  );
 114| |};

 117| |// Status Map (Type-safe status codes)
 118| |// ============================================================================
 120| |export const StatusMap = {
 121| |  Continue: 100, "Switching Protocols": 101, Processing: 102,
 122| |  OK: 200, Created: 201, Accepted: 202, "No Content": 204, "Partial Content": 206,
 123| |  "Multiple Choices": 300, "Moved Permanently": 301, Found: 302, "Not Modified": 304,
 124| |  "Bad Request": 400, Unauthorized: 401, Forbidden: 403, "Not Found": 404,
 125| |  "Method Not Allowed": 405, Conflict: 409, Gone: 410, "Too Many Requests": 429,
 126| |  "Internal Server Error": 500, "Bad Gateway": 502, "Service Unavailable": 503,
 127| |} as const;

>packages/core/src/lru.ts
i:lru-cache
e:LRUCacheOptions|LRUCache
f:createEntry(
  value: V,
  bytes: number,
  ttlMs: number,
  staleTtlMs: number,
  now: number
):Entry<V>
c:LRUCache
t:LRUCacheOptions
t:Entry
t:WriteOptions
---
   1| |/**
   2| | * Production LRU cache backed by lru-cache.
   3| | *
   4| | * Bun 1.4 edition:
   5| | * - correct fresh/stale/expire semantics
   6| | * - single-flight getOrSet
   7| | * - stale-while-revalidate background revalidation
   8| | */
  10| |import { LRUCache as LRU } from "lru-cache";
  12|▼|export interface LRUCacheOptions<K extends {}, V> {
  13| |  max?: number;
  14| |  ttlMs?: number;
  15| |  staleTtlMs?: number;
  16| |  maxBytes?: number;
  17| |  sizeOf?: (value: V, key: K) => number;
  18| |  onEvict?: (key: K, value: V) => void;
  19| |}
  21|▼|interface Entry<V> {
  22| |  value: V;
  23| |  bytes: number;
  24| |  freshUntil: number;
  25| |  staleUntil: number;
  26| |  expireUntil: number;
  27| |}
  29|▼|interface WriteOptions {
  30| |  ttlMs?: number;
  31| |  staleTtlMs?: number;
  32| |  bytes?: number;
  33| |}
  35|▼|const createEntry = <V>(
  36| |  value: V,
  37| |  bytes: number,
  38| |  ttlMs: number,
  39| |  staleTtlMs: number,
  40| |  now: number
  41| |): Entry<V> => {
  42| |  const freshTtl = ttlMs > 0 ? ttlMs : 0;
  44| |  const staleTtl =
  45| |    staleTtlMs > 0 ? Math.max(staleTtlMs, ttlMs) : freshTtl;
  47| |  const freshUntil = freshTtl > 0 ? now + freshTtl : 0;
  48| |  const staleUntil = staleTtl > 0 ? now + staleTtl : freshUntil;
  49| |  const expireUntil = staleUntil || freshUntil;
  51| |  return {
  52| |    value,
  53| |    bytes,
  54| |    freshUntil,
  55| |    staleUntil,
  56| |    expireUntil,
  57| |  };
  58| |};
  60|▼|export class LRUCache<K extends {}, V> {
  61| |  private lru: LRU<K, Entry<V>>;
  62| |  private inflight = new Map<K, Promise<V>>();
  64| |  constructor(private readonly opts: LRUCacheOptions<K, V> = {}) {
  65| |    this.lru = new LRU<K, Entry<V>>({
  66| |      max: opts.max ?? 1000,
  67| |      sizeCalculation: (entry) => Math.max(1, entry.bytes),
  68| |      dispose: (entry, key) => {
  69| |        opts.onEvict?.(key, entry.value);
  70| |      },
  71| |      ...(opts.maxBytes !== undefined ? { maxSize: opts.maxBytes } : {}),
  72| |    });
  73| |  }
  75| |  get size(): number {
  76| |    return this.lru.size;
  77| |  }
  79| |  get byteSize(): number {
  80| |    return this.lru.calculatedSize;
  81| |  }
  83| |  private now(): number {
  84| |    return Date.now();
  85| |  }
  87| |  private alive(entry: Entry<V>, now: number): boolean {
  88| |    return entry.expireUntil === 0 || entry.expireUntil > now;
  89| |  }
  91| |  private fresh(entry: Entry<V>, now: number): boolean {
  92| |    return entry.freshUntil === 0 || entry.freshUntil > now;
  93| |  }
  95| |  get(key: K, options: { allowStale?: boolean } = {}): V | undefined {
  96| |    const entry = this.lru.get(key);
  97| |    if (!entry) return undefined;
  99| |    const now = this.now();
 101| |    if (!this.alive(entry, now)) {
 102| |      this.lru.delete(key);
 103| |      return undefined;
 104| |    }
 106| |    if (!options.allowStale && !this.fresh(entry, now)) {
 107| |      return undefined;
 108| |    }
 110| |    return entry.value;
 111| |  }
 113| |  set(key: K, value: V, options: WriteOptions = {}): this {
 114| |    const ttlMs = options.ttlMs ?? this.opts.ttlMs ?? 0;
 115| |    const staleTtlMs = options.staleTtlMs ?? this.opts.staleTtlMs ?? 0;
 116| |    const bytes = options.bytes ?? this.opts.sizeOf?.(value, key) ?? 0;
 118| |    const maxBytes = this.opts.maxBytes ?? 0;
 119| |    if (maxBytes > 0 && bytes > maxBytes) return this;
 121| |    const now = this.now();
 122| |    const entry = createEntry(value, bytes, ttlMs, staleTtlMs, now);
 124| |    const lruTtl = entry.expireUntil > 0 ? entry.expireUntil - now : 0;
 126| |    if (lruTtl > 0) {
 127| |      this.lru.set(key, entry, { ttl: lruTtl });
 128| |    } else {
 129| |      this.lru.set(key, entry);
 130| |    }
 132| |    return this;
 133| |  }
 135| |  delete(key: K): boolean {
 136| |    return this.lru.delete(key);
 137| |  }
 139| |  clear(): void {
 140| |    this.lru.clear();
 141| |    this.inflight.clear();
 142| |  }
 144| |  async getOrSet(
 145| |    key: K,
 146| |    factory: () => Promise<V> | V,
 147| |    options: WriteOptions = {}
 148| |  ): Promise<V> {
 149| |    const now = this.now();
 150| |    const entry = this.lru.get(key);
 152| |    if (entry && this.alive(entry, now)) {
 153| |      if (this.fresh(entry, now)) {
 154| |        return entry.value;
 155| |      }
 157| |      if (!this.inflight.has(key)) {
 158| |        const revalidate = Promise.resolve()
 159| |          .then(factory)
 160| |          .then((value) => {
 161| |            this.set(key, value, options);
 162| |            return value;
 163| |          })
 164| |          .catch(() => entry.value)
 165| |          .finally(() => {
 166| |            this.inflight.delete(key);
 167| |          });
 169| |        this.inflight.set(key, revalidate);
 170| |      }
 172| |      return entry.value;
 173| |    }
 175| |    const pending = this.inflight.get(key);
 176| |    if (pending) return pending;
 178| |    const promise = Promise.resolve()
 179| |      .then(factory)
 180| |      .then((value) => {
 181| |        this.set(key, value, options);
 182| |        return value;
 183| |      })
 184| |      .finally(() => {
 185| |        this.inflight.delete(key);
 186| |      });
 188| |    this.inflight.set(key, promise);
 190| |    return promise;
 191| |  }
 192| |}
---

):ProxyRequestInit
f:isTimeoutError(err: unknown):boolean
f:createGatewayTimeout():Response
f:createBadGateway():Response
t:FetchRequestInit
t:ProxyRequestInit
---
   1| |/**
   2| | * Proxy / forwarding helpers.
   3| | *
   4| | * Design:
   5| | * - Pure header sanitizers
   6| | * - Pure request-init factory
   7| | * - No global BodyInit dependency
   8| | * - AbortSignal.timeout based cancellation
   9| | */
  11| |const HOP_BY_HOP = [
  12| |  "connection",
  13| |  "keep-alive",
  14| |  "proxy-authenticate",
  15| |  "proxy-authorization",
  16| |  "te",
  17| |  "trailer",
  18| |  "transfer-encoding",
  19| |  "upgrade",
  20| |] as const;
  22|▼|type FetchRequestInit = NonNullable<Parameters<typeof fetch>[1]>;
  24|▼|type ProxyRequestInit = FetchRequestInit & {
  25| |  duplex?: "half";
  26| |};
  28| |export interface ProxyOptions extends Omit<FetchRequestInit, "body"> {
  29| |  timeoutMs?: number;
  30| |  body?: FetchRequestInit["body"];
  31| |}
  33| |/**
  34| | * Remove hop-by-hop headers and request-specific headers
  35| | * that must be recomputed for upstream.
  36| | */
  37|▼|const sanitizeRequestHeaders = (headers: Headers): Headers => {
  38| |  const out = new Headers(headers);
  40| |  for (const h of HOP_BY_HOP) out.delete(h);
  42| |  out.delete("host");
  43| |  out.delete("content-length");
  45| |  return out;
  46| |};
  48| |/**
  49| | * Remove hop-by-hop headers from upstream response.
  50| | */
  51|▼|const sanitizeResponseHeaders = (headers: Headers): Headers => {
  52| |  const out = new Headers(headers);
  54| |  for (const h of HOP_BY_HOP) out.delete(h);
  56| |  return out;
  57| |};
  59| |/**
  60| | * Create a combined timeout + optional caller signal.
  61| | */
  62|▼|const createProxySignal = (opts: ProxyOptions): AbortSignal => {
  63| |  const timeoutSignal = AbortSignal.timeout(opts.timeoutMs ?? 10_000);
  65| |  if (!opts.signal) return timeoutSignal;
  67| |  if (typeof AbortSignal.any === "function") {
  68| |    return AbortSignal.any([opts.signal, timeoutSignal]);
  69| |  }
  71| |  return timeoutSignal;
  72| |};
  74| |/**
  75| | * Type guard for stream-like bodies.
  76| | */
  77|▼|const isReadableStream = (
  78| |  value: unknown,
  79| |): value is ReadableStream<Uint8Array> =>
  80| |  typeof value === "object" &&
  81| |  value !== null &&
  82| |  "pipeTo" in value &&
  83| |  typeof value.pipeTo === "function";
  85| |/**
  86| | * Build fetch init for upstream request.
  87| | */
  88|▼|const createProxyInit = (
  89| |  opts: ProxyOptions,
  90| |  signal: AbortSignal,
  91| |): ProxyRequestInit => {
  92| |  const headers = sanitizeRequestHeaders(
  93| |    opts.headers instanceof Headers ? opts.headers : new Headers(opts.headers),
  94| |  );
  96| |  const init: ProxyRequestInit = {
  97| |    method: opts.method ?? "GET",
  98| |    headers,
  99| |    redirect: opts.redirect ?? "manual",
 100| |    signal,
 101| |  };
 103| |  const body = opts.body;
 105| |  if (body != null) {
 106| |    init.body = body;
 108| |    if (isReadableStream(body)) {
 109| |      init.duplex = "half";
 110| |    }
 111| |  }
 113| |  return init;
 114| |};
 116|▼|const isTimeoutError = (err: unknown): boolean =>
 117| |  err instanceof Error &&
 118| |  (err.name === "TimeoutError" || err.name === "AbortError");
 120|▼|const createGatewayTimeout = (): Response =>
 121| |  Response.json({ error: "Upstream timeout", status: 504 }, { status: 504 });
 123|▼|const createBadGateway = (): Response =>
 124| |  Response.json({ error: "Bad Gateway", status: 502 }, { status: 502 });
 126|▼|export async function proxyRequest(
 127| |  target: string | URL,
 128| |  opts: ProxyOptions = {},
 129| |): Promise<Response> {
 130| |  try {
 131| |    const signal = createProxySignal(opts);
 132| |    const init = createProxyInit(opts, signal);
 134| |    const upstream = await fetch(target.toString(), init);
 136| |    const responseHeaders = sanitizeResponseHeaders(upstream.headers);
 137| |    responseHeaders.set("x-proxy", "flux");
 139| |    return new Response(upstream.body, {
 140| |      status: upstream.status,
 141| |      statusText: upstream.statusText,
 142| |      headers: responseHeaders,
 143| |    });
 144|!|  } catch (err) {
 145| |    if (isTimeoutError(err)) {
 146| |      return createGatewayTimeout();
 147| |    }
 149| |    return createBadGateway();
 150| |  }
 151| |}
 153|▼|export async function forwardRequest(
 154| |  req: Request,
 155| |  target: string | URL,
 156| |  opts: ProxyOptions = {},
 157| |): Promise<Response> {
 158| |  const incoming = new URL(req.url);
 159| |  const targetUrl = new URL(target.toString());
 161| |  if (!targetUrl.search) {
 162| |    targetUrl.search = incoming.search;
 163| |  }
 165| |  const headers = sanitizeRequestHeaders(req.headers);
 167| |  const hasBody =
 168| |    req.method !== "GET" && req.method !== "HEAD" && req.body != null;
 170| |  const body = hasBody ? req.body : undefined;
 172| |  return proxyRequest(targetUrl, {
 173| |    ...opts,
 174| |    method: req.method,
 175| |    headers,
 176| |    ...(body ? { body } : {}),
 177| |  });
 178| |}

   1| |/**
   2| | * @fileoverview Server-Sent Events (SSE) support.
   3| | * Streaming responses with proper formatting.
   4| | */
   6|▼|export interface SSEOptions {
   7| |  event?: string;
   8| |  id?: string;
   9| |  retry?: number;
  10| |}
  12|▼|export interface SSEMessage {
  13| |  data: string;
  14| |  event?: string;
  15| |  id?: string;
  16| |  retry?: number;
  17| |}
  19|▼|export const formatSSE = (msg: SSEMessage): string => {
  20| |  let out = "";
  21| |  if (msg.id) out += `id: ${msg.id}\n`;
  22| |  if (msg.event) out += `event: ${msg.event}\n`;
  23| |  if (msg.retry) out += `retry: ${msg.retry}\n`;
  24| |  out += `data: ${msg.data}\n\n`;
  25| |  return out;
  26| |};
  28|▼|export const sse = (
  29| |  generator: AsyncGenerator<string | SSEMessage> | Generator<string | SSEMessage>,
  30| |  init?: ResponseInit
  31| |): Response => {
  32| |  const encoder = new TextEncoder();
  34| |  const stream = new ReadableStream({
  35| |    async start(controller) {
  36| |      try {
  37| |        for await (const chunk of generator as AsyncGenerator<string | SSEMessage>) {
  38| |          const msg = typeof chunk === "string" ? { data: chunk } : chunk;
  39| |          controller.enqueue(encoder.encode(formatSSE(msg)));
  40| |        }
  41| |      } catch { /* stream closed */ }
  42| |      finally { controller.close(); }
  43| |    }
  44| |  });
  46| |  return new Response(stream, {
  47| |    ...init,
  48| |    headers: {
  49| |      "content-type": "text/event-stream",
  50| |      "cache-control": "no-cache",
  51| |      "connection": "keep-alive",
  52| |      ...init?.headers,
  53| |    },
  54| |  });
  55| |};
  57|▼|export const sseFromStream = (stream: ReadableStream, init?: ResponseInit): Response =>
  58| |  new Response(stream, {
  59| |    ...init,
  60| |    headers: {
  61| |      "content-type": "text/event-stream",
  62| |      "cache-control": "no-cache",
  63| |      "connection": "keep-alive",
  64| |      ...init?.headers,
  65| |    },
  66| |  });

   1| |/**
   2| | * Distributed tracing helpers — Bun 1.4 edition.
   3| | *
   4| | * Uses Bun.randomUUIDv7 when available.
   5| | */
   7|▼|export type TraceEvent =
   8| |  | "request"
   9| |  | "parse"
  10| |  | "transform"
  11| |  | "beforeHandle"
  12| |  | "handle"
  13| |  | "afterHandle"
  14| |  | "mapResponse"
  15| |  | "afterResponse"
  16| |  | "error";
  18|▼|export interface TraceSpan {
  19| |  id: string;
  20| |  name: string;
  21| |  event: TraceEvent;
  22| |  begin: number;
  23| |  end?: number;
  24| |  error?: Error | null;
  25| |  attributes?: Record<string, unknown>;
  26| |  children: TraceSpan[];
  27| |}
  29|▼|export interface TraceContext {
  30| |  traceId: string;
  31| |  spans: TraceSpan[];
  32| |  startSpan(name: string, event: TraceEvent): TraceSpan;
  33| |  endSpan(span: TraceSpan, error?: Error | null): void;
  34| |}
  36| |let traceCounter = 0;
  38|▼|export const createTraceContext = (requestId: string): TraceContext => {
  39| |  const spans: TraceSpan[] = [];
  41| |  return {
  42| |    traceId: requestId,
  43| |    spans,
  45| |    startSpan(name, event) {
  46| |      const span: TraceSpan = {
  47| |        id: `${requestId}-${++traceCounter}`,
  48| |        name,
  49| |        event,
  50| |        begin: performance.now(),
  51| |        children: [],
  52| |      };
  54| |      spans.push(span);
  56| |      return span;
  57| |    },
  59| |    endSpan(span, error = null) {
  60| |      span.end = performance.now();
  61| |      span.error = error;
  62| |    },
  63| |  };
  64| |};
  66| |export const startTrace = (req: Request): { traceId: string; start: number } => {
  67| |  const bun: any = (globalThis as any).Bun;
  69| |  const traceId =
  70| |    req.headers.get("x-trace-id") ||
  71| |    req.headers.get("x-request-id") ||
  72| |    bun?.randomUUIDv7?.() ||
  73| |    crypto.randomUUID();
  75| |  return { traceId, start: performance.now() };
  76| |};
  78|▼|export const finishTrace = (
  79| |  _req: Request,
  80| |  trace: { traceId: string; start: number },
  81| |  response: Response
  82| |): Response => {
  83| |  const duration = performance.now() - trace.start;
  85| |  const headers = new Headers(response.headers);
  86| |  headers.set("x-trace-id", trace.traceId);
  87| |  headers.set("x-response-time", duration.toFixed(2) + "ms");
  89| |  return new Response(response.body, {
  90| |    status: response.status,
  91| |    statusText: response.statusText,
  92| |    headers,
  93| |  });
  94| |};

   1| |/**
   2| | * Flux Core Unified Type System
   3| | *
   4| | * AOT upgrade:
   5| | * - ContextUsage now comes from shared
   6| | * - keeps runtime schema/lifecycle/server types
   7| | */
   9| |import type { ContextUsage } from "@flux/shared";
  10| |import { EMPTY_USAGE, FULL_USAGE } from "@flux/shared";
  12| |export type { ContextUsage };
  13| |export { EMPTY_USAGE, FULL_USAGE };
  15| |export const HTTP_METHODS = [

>scripts/benchmark.ts
f:worker()|a
---
   1| |#!/usr/bin/env bun
   3| |const url = process.argv[2] || "http://localhost:3000/health";
   4| |const durationMs = Number(process.env.DURATION ?? 10) * 1000;
   5| |const concurrency = Number(process.env.CONCURRENCY ?? 100);
   7| |let count = 0;
   8| |let errors = 0;
  10| |const latencies: number[] = [];
  12|▼|async function worker() {
  13| |  const end = Date.now() + durationMs;
  15| |  while (Date.now() < end) {
  16| |    const start = performance.now();
  18| |    try {
  19| |      const res = await fetch(url);
  20| |      await res.arrayBuffer();
  22| |      count++;
  23| |      latencies.push(performance.now() - start);
  24| |    } catch {
  25| |      errors++;
  26| |    }
  27| |  }
  28| |}
  30| |console.log(`Benchmarking ${url}`);
  31| |console.log(`concurrency=${concurrency} duration=${durationMs / 1000}s`);
  33| |await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: concurrency }, () => worker()));
  35| |latencies.sort((a, b) => a - b);
  37| |const avg =
  38| |  latencies.length > 0
  39| |    ? latencies.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / latencies.length
  40| |    : 0;
  42| |const p50 = latencies[Math.floor(latencies.length * 0.5)] ?? 0;
  43| |const p95 = latencies[Math.floor(latencies.length * 0.95)] ?? 0;
  44| |const p99 = latencies[Math.floor(latencies.length * 0.99)] ?? 0;
  46| |console.log("\nSummary:");
  47| |console.log(`requests: ${count}`);
  48| |console.log(`errors: ${errors}`);
  49| |console.log(`requests/sec: ${(count / (durationMs / 1000)).toFixed(2)}`);
  50| |console.log(`latency avg: ${avg.toFixed(2)}ms`);
  51| |console.log(`latency p50: ${p50.toFixed(2)}ms`);
  52| |console.log(`latency p95: ${p95.toFixed(2)}ms`);
  53| |console.log(`latency p99: ${p99.toFixed(2)}ms`);
---

>scripts/generate-openapi-client.ts

---
   1| |#!/usr/bin/env bun
   2| |import { mkdirSync } from "node:fs";
   3| |import { basename, dirname, extname, join } from "node:path";
   4| |import { pathToFileURL } from "node:url";
   6| |const ROUTES_DIR = process.env.ROUTES_DIR || "./packages/app/src/routes";
   7| |const OPENAPI_OUT = process.env.OPENAPI_OUT || "./packages/app/dist/openapi.json";
   8| |const CLIENT_OUT = process.env.CLIENT_OUT || "./packages/app/src/client";
  10| |const HTTP_METHODS = new Set([
  11| |  "GET",
  12| |  "POST",
  13| |  "PUT",
  14| |  "PATCH",
  15| |  "DELETE",
  16| |  "HEAD",
  17| |  "OPTIONS",
  18| |  "ALL",
  19| |]);
  21|▼|function parseRouteFile(file: string) {
  22| |  const ext = extname(file);
  23| |  const name = basename(file, ext);
  24| |  const parts = name.split(".");
  26| |  let method = "GET";
  27| |  let routeName = name;
  29| |  const last = parts.at(-1);
  31| |  if (last && HTTP_METHODS.has(last.toUpperCase())) {
  32| |    method = last.toUpperCase();
  33| |    routeName = parts.slice(0, -1).join(".");
  34| |  }
  36| |  const dir = dirname(file);
  38| |  let routePath = `/${join(dir, routeName).replace(/\\/g, "/")}`;
  40| |  if (routePath.endsWith("/index")) {
  41| |    routePath = routePath.slice(0, -5) || "/";
  42| |  }
  44| |  routePath = routePath
  45| |    .replace(/\[(\.\.\.[^\]]+)\]/g, (_, raw) => `*${raw.slice(3)}`)
  46| |    .replace(/\[([^\]]+)\]/g, (_, p) => `:${p}`);
  48| |  return {
  49| |    method,
  50| |    path: routePath,
  51| |  };
  52| |}
  54|▼|function toOpenApiPath(path: string) {
  55| |  return path
  56| |    .replace(/:([A-Za-z0-9_]+)/g, "{$1}")
  57| |    .replace(/\*([A-Za-z0-9_]+)/g, "{$1}");
  58| |}
  60|▼|function isJsonSchema(value: unknown): boolean {
  61| |  return (
  62| |    typeof value === "object" &&
  63| |    value !== null &&
  64| |    !("~standard" in value)
  65| |  );
  66| |}
  68|▼|function schemaToParameters(schema: any, location: "path" | "query") {
  69| |  if (!isJsonSchema(schema) || !schema.properties) {
  70| |    return [];
  71| |  }
  73| |  const required = new Set<string>(schema.required ?? []);
  75| |  return Object.entries(schema.properties).map(([name, propSchema]) => ({
  76| |    name,
  77| |    in: location,
  78| |    required: location === "path" ? true : required.has(name),
  79| |    schema: propSchema,
  80| |  }));
  81| |}
  83|▼|function pickResponseSchema(responseSchema: any) {
  84| |  if (!responseSchema) return undefined;
  86| |  if (isJsonSchema(responseSchema)) {
  87| |    if (
  88| |      responseSchema.type ||
  89| |      responseSchema.properties ||
  90| |      responseSchema.$ref
  91| |    ) {
  92| |      return responseSchema;
  93| |    }
  94| |  }
  96| |  return (
  97| |    responseSchema[200] ??
  98| |    responseSchema["200"] ??
  99| |    Object.values(responseSchema)[0]
 100| |  );
 101| |}
 103|▼|async function loadRouteSchema(absPath: string) {
 104| |  try {
 105| |    const mod: any = await import(pathToFileURL(absPath).href);
 107| |    return mod?.schema ?? mod?.default?.schema ?? undefined;
 108|!|  } catch (err) {
 109| |    console.warn(`[openapi] Skipped ${absPath}: ${(err as Error).message}`);
 110| |    return undefined;
 111| |  }
 112| |}
 114|▼|async function main() {
 115| |  const glob = new Bun.Glob("**/*.{ts,tsx,js,mjs,jsx}");
 117| |  const files: string[] = [];
 119| |  for await (const file of glob.scan({
 120| |    cwd: ROUTES_DIR,
 121| |    onlyFiles: true,
 122| |  })) {
 123| |    if (file.endsWith(".d.ts")) continue;
 124| |    files.push(file);
 125| |  }
 127| |  const paths: Record<string, Record<string, unknown>> = {};
 129| |  for (const file of files) {
 130| |    const parsed = parseRouteFile(file);
 132| |    if (!parsed || parsed.method === "ALL") continue;
 134| |    const abs = join(process.cwd(), ROUTES_DIR, file);
 135| |    const schema = await loadRouteSchema(abs);
 137| |    const openApiPath = toOpenApiPath(parsed.path);
 138| |    const method = parsed.method.toLowerCase();
 140| |    const operation: Record<string, unknown> = {
 141| |      operationId: `${method}_${openApiPath.replace(/[{}\/]/g, "_")}`,
 142| |      responses: {
 143| |        200: {
 144| |          description: "Successful response",
 145| |        },
 146| |      },
 147| |    };
 149| |    const parameters: unknown[] = [];
 151| |    if (schema?.params) {
 152| |      parameters.push(...schemaToParameters(schema.params, "path"));
 153| |    }
 155| |    if (schema?.query) {
 156| |      parameters.push(...schemaToParameters(schema.query, "query"));
 157| |    }
 159| |    if (parameters.length) {
 160| |      operation.parameters = parameters;
 161| |    }
 163| |    if (schema?.body && isJsonSchema(schema.body)) {
 164| |      operation.requestBody = {
 165| |        required: true,
 166| |        content: {
 167| |          "application/json": {
 168| |            schema: schema.body,
 169| |          },
 170| |        },
 171| |      };
 172| |    }
 174| |    const responseSchema = pickResponseSchema(schema?.response);
 176| |    if (responseSchema && isJsonSchema(responseSchema)) {
 177| |      operation.responses = {
 178| |        200: {
 179| |          description: "Successful response",
 180| |          content: {
 181| |            "application/json": {
 182| |              schema: responseSchema,
 183| |            },
 184| |          },
 185| |        },
 186| |      };
 187| |    }
 189| |    paths[openApiPath] ??= {};
 190| |    paths[openApiPath][method] = operation;
 191| |  }
 193| |  const openapi = {
 194| |    openapi: "3.1.0",
 195| |    info: {
 196| |      title: "Flux API",
 197| |      version: "1.0.0",
 198| |    },
 199| |    paths,
 200| |  };
 202| |  mkdirSync(dirname(OPENAPI_OUT), { recursive: true });
 204| |  await Bun.write(OPENAPI_OUT, JSON.stringify(openapi, null, 2));
 206| |  console.log(`[openapi] Wrote ${OPENAPI_OUT}`);
 208| |  const result = Bun.spawnSync(
 209| |    [
 210| |      "bunx",
 211| |      "@hey-api/openapi-ts@latest",
 212| |      "--input",
 213| |      OPENAPI_OUT,
 214| |      "--output",
 215| |      CLIENT_OUT,
 216| |      "--client",
 217| |      "@hey-api/client-fetch",
 218| |    ],
 219| |    {
 220| |      stdio: ["inherit", "inherit", "inherit"],
 221| |    }
 222| |  );
 224| |  if (result.exitCode !== 0) {
 225| |    console.warn("[heyapi] Client generation failed. Check @hey-api/openapi-ts install.");
 226| |  } else {
 227| |    console.log(`[heyapi] Generated client in ${CLIENT_OUT}`);
 228| |  }
 229| |}
 231| |await main();
---

>packages/cli/src/utils/config.ts
i:node:url|node:path
l:./fs.js|./logger.js
f:loadConfig(root: string)|a
---
   1| |import { pathToFileURL } from "node:url";
   2| |import { join } from "node:path";
   3| |import { exists, readTextFile } from "./fs.js";
   4| |import { warn } from "./logger.js";
   6| |const CONFIG_FILES = [
   7| |  "flux.config.ts",
   8| |  "flux.config.mts",
   9| |  "flux.config.mjs",
  10| |  "flux.config.js",
  11| |  "flux.config.json",
  12| |];
  14|▼|export async function loadConfig(root: string): Promise<Record<string, unknown>> {
  15| |  for (const file of CONFIG_FILES) {
  16| |    const configPath = join(root, file);
  17| |    if (!(await exists(configPath))) continue;
  19| |    if (file.endsWith(".json")) {
  20| |      try {
  21| |        return JSON.parse(await readTextFile(configPath)) as Record<string, unknown>;
  22|!|      } catch (err) {
  23| |        warn(`Failed to parse ${file}: ${err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err)}`);
  24| |        return {};
  25| |      }
  26| |    }
  28| |    try {
  29| |      const url = `${pathToFileURL(configPath).href}?t=${Date.now()}`;
  30| |      const mod = (await import(url)) as {
  31| |        default?: unknown;
  32| |      };
  34| |      const value = mod.default ?? mod;
  36| |      if (typeof value === "function") {
  37| |        return (await (value as () => Promise<Record<string, unknown>>)()) ?? {};
  38| |      }
  40| |      return (value ?? {}) as Record<string, unknown>;
  41|!|    } catch (err) {
  42| |      if (file.endsWith(".ts") || file.endsWith(".mts")) {
  43| |        warn(
  44| |          `Could not import ${file}. Use flux.config.mjs with Node, or run the CLI with Bun.`,
  45| |        );
  46| |      } else {
  47| |        warn(`Failed to load ${file}: ${err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err)}`);
  48| |      }
  49| |    }
  50| |  }
  52| |  return {};
  53| |}

>packages/cli/src/templates/route.ts
i:@sinclair/typebox|@flux/core/http
l:../utils/route.js
e:routeFileTemplate
f:routeFileTemplate(
  route: ParsedRoute,
  options: { schema?: boolean } = {},
)
---
   1| |import type { ParsedRoute } from "../utils/route.js";
   3|▼|export function routeFileTemplate(
   4| |  route: ParsedRoute,
   5| |  options: { schema?: boolean } = {},
   6| |): string {
   7| |  const fn = route.method;
   8| |  const hasBody = route.method === "post" || route.method === "put" || route.method === "patch";
   9| |  const params = route.paramNames;
  11| |  if (options.schema) {
  12| |    const schemaParts: string[] = [];
  14| |    if (params.length > 0) {
  15| |      schemaParts.push(
  16| |        `  params: Type.Object({ ${params
  17| |          .map((param) => `${param}: Type.String()`)
  18| |          .join(", ")} }),`,
  19| |      );
  20| |    }
  22| |    if (hasBody) {
  23| |      schemaParts.push(`  body: Type.Object({ name: Type.String() }),`);
  24| |    }
  26| |    schemaParts.push(`  response: Type.Object({ ok: Type.Boolean() }),`);
  28| |    const usesCtx = params.length > 0 || hasBody;
  30| |    const handlerLines: string[] = [];
  32| |    if (params.length > 0) {
  33| |      handlerLines.push(`  const { ${params.join(", ")} } = ctx.params;`);
  34| |    }
  36| |    if (hasBody) {
  37| |      handlerLines.push(`  await ctx.body.json();`);
  38| |    }
  40| |    handlerLines.push(`  return Response.json({ ok: true });`);
  42| |    const handler = usesCtx
  43| |      ? `async (ctx) => {\n${handlerLines.join("\n")}\n}`
  44| |      : `() => Response.json({ ok: true })`;
  46| |    return `import { Type } from "@sinclair/typebox";
  47| |import { ${fn} } from "@flux/core/http";
  49| |export const schema = {
  50| |${schemaParts.join("\n")}
  51| |};
  53| |export default ${fn}(${handler}, schema);
  54| |`;
  55| |  }
  57| |  if (params.length > 0) {
  58| |    const json = params.map((param) => `${param}: String(${param})`).join(", ");
  60| |    return `import { ${fn} } from "@flux/core/http";
  62| |export default ${fn}((ctx) => {
  63| |  const { ${params.join(", ")} } = ctx.params;
  65| |  return Response.json({ ${json} });
  66| |});
  67| |`;
  68| |  }
  70| |  if (hasBody) {
  71| |    return `import { ${fn} } from "@flux/core/http";
  73| |export default ${fn}(async (ctx) => {
  74| |  const body = await ctx.body.json();
  76| |  return Response.json({ received: body }, { status: 201 });
  77| |});
  78| |`;
  79| |  }
  81| |  if (route.method === "all") {
  82| |    return `import { all } from "@flux/core/http";
  84| |export default all(() => new Response("OK"));
  85| |`;
  86| |  }
  88| |  return `import { ${fn} } from "@flux/core/http";
  90| |export default ${fn}(() => new Response("OK"));
  91| |`;
  92| |}

  92|▼|export type ValidatedCompilerOptions = Static<typeof CompilerOptionsSchema>;
  94| |const ajv = new Ajv({
  95| |  allErrors: true,
  96| |  strict: false,
  97| |  useDefaults: true,
  98| |  coerceTypes: false,
  99| |});
 101| |const validate = ajv.compile(CompilerOptionsSchema);
 103|▼|export const validateOptions = (
 104| |  input: Partial<CompilerOptions>
 105| |): Result<CompilerOptions, string[]> => {
 106| |  const data = { ...DEFAULT_OPTS, ...input };
 108| |  if (validate(data)) {
 109| |    return ok(data as CompilerOptions);
 110| |  }
 112| |  const errors = (validate.errors ?? []).map((e) => {
 113| |    const path =
 114| |      e.instancePath?.replace(/^\//, "").replace(/\//g, ".") ||
 115| |      (e.params as any)?.missingProperty ||
 116| |      "options";
 118| |    return `${path}: ${e.message}`;
 119| |  });
 121| |  return err(errors);
 122| |};

   1| |/**
   2| | * AOT artifact generation:
   3| | * - routes.d.ts
   4| | * - openapi.json
   5| | * - client.d.ts
   6| | * - manifest.json
   7| | */
   9| |import { mkdirSync, writeFileSync } from "fs";
  10| |import { join } from "path";
  11| |import type { RouteDef, CompilerOptions } from "../types";
  12| |import type { Logger } from "../logger";
  14|▼|const tsParamType = (paramNames: readonly string[]): string => {
  15| |  if (paramNames.length === 0) return "Record<string, never>";
  17| |  const lines = paramNames.map((name) => `    ${name}: string;`);
  18| |  return `{
  19| |${lines.join("\n")}
  20| |  }`;
  21| |};
  23|▼|export const generateRouteTypes = (routes: readonly RouteDef[]): string => {
  24| |  const lines: string[] = [];
  26| |  lines.push("// Auto-generated by Flux AOT compiler.");
  27| |  lines.push("// Do not edit manually.");
  28| |  lines.push("");
  29| |  lines.push("export interface FluxRoutes {");
  31| |  const byPath = new Map<string, RouteDef[]>();
  32| |  for (const route of routes) {
  33| |    const group = byPath.get(route.path);
  34| |    if (group) group.push(route);
  35| |    else byPath.set(route.path, [route]);
  36| |  }
  38| |  for (const [path, defs] of byPath) {
  39| |    lines.push(`  ${JSON.stringify(path)}: {`);
  41| |    for (const route of defs) {
  42| |      const method = route.method.toLowerCase();
  43| |      lines.push(`    ${method}: {`);
  45| |      if (route.paramNames.length > 0) {
  46| |        lines.push(`      params: ${tsParamType(route.paramNames)};`);
  47| |      }
  49| |      if (route.usage.query) {
  50| |        lines.push("      query: Record<string, string | string[]>;");
  51| |      }
  53| |      if (route.usage.body) {
  54| |        lines.push("      body: unknown;");
  55| |      }
  57| |      lines.push("      response: unknown;");
  58| |      lines.push("    };");
  59| |    }
  61| |    lines.push("  };");
  62| |  }
  64| |  lines.push("}");
  65| |  lines.push("");
  67| |  return lines.join("\n");
  68| |};
  70|▼|export const generateClientDts = (): string => {
  71| |  return `// Auto-generated by Flux AOT compiler.
  72| |import type { FluxRoutes } from "./routes";
  74| |export type FluxClient = {
  75| |  [Path in keyof FluxRoutes]: {
  76| |    [Method in keyof FluxRoutes[Path]]: (
  77| |      ...args: FluxRoutes[Path][Method] extends { params: infer P }
  78| |        ? [params: P, init?: RequestInit]
  79| |        : [init?: RequestInit]
  80| |    ) => Promise<Response>;
  81| |  };
  82| |};
  84| |export declare function createClient(baseUrl?: string): FluxClient;
  85| |`;
  86| |};
  88|▼|const toOpenApiPath = (path: string): string =>
  89| |  path.replace(/:([A-Za-z0-9_]+)/g, "{$1}").replace(/\*([A-Za-z0-9_]+)/g, "{$1}");
  91|▼|export const generateOpenApi = (
  92| |  routes: readonly RouteDef[],
  93| |  opts: CompilerOptions
  94| |): Record<string, unknown> => {
  95| |  const paths: Record<string, Record<string, unknown>> = {};
  97| |  for (const route of routes) {
  98| |    if (route.method === "ALL") continue;
 100| |    const openApiPath = toOpenApiPath(route.path);
 101| |    paths[openApiPath] ??= {};
 103| |    const operation: Record<string, unknown> = {
 104| |      operationId: `${route.method.toLowerCase()}_${openApiPath.replace(/[{}\/]/g, "_")}`,
 105| |      responses: {
 106| |        "200": {
 107| |          description: "Successful response",
 108| |        },
 109| |      },
 110| |    };
 112| |    const detail = (route.config as any)?.detail;
 113| |    if (detail && typeof detail === "object") {
 114| |      Object.assign(operation, detail);
 115| |    }
 117| |    if (route.paramNames.length > 0) {
 118| |      operation.parameters = route.paramNames.map((name) => ({
 119| |        name,
 120| |        in: "path",
 121| |        required: true,
 122| |        schema: { type: "string" },
 123| |      }));
 124| |    }
 126| |    if (route.usage.body) {
 127| |      operation.requestBody = {
 128| |        content: {
 129| |          "application/json": {
 130| |            schema: { type: "object" },
 131| |          },
 132| |        },
 133| |      };
 134| |    }
 136| |    paths[openApiPath][route.method.toLowerCase()] = operation;
 137| |  }
 139| |  return {
 140| |    openapi: "3.1.0",
 141| |    info: {
 142| |      title: opts.serviceName ?? "flux",
 143| |      version: "1.0.0",
 144| |    },
 145| |    paths,
 146| |  };
 147| |};
 149|▼|export const generateManifest = (
 150| |  routes: readonly RouteDef[],
 151| |  opts: CompilerOptions
 152| |): Record<string, unknown> => ({
 153| |  generatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
 154| |  serviceName: opts.serviceName ?? "flux",
 155| |  target: opts.target,
 156| |  routes: routes.map((r) => ({
 157| |    method: r.method,
 158| |    path: r.path,
 159| |    file: r.file,
 160| |    isStatic: r.isStatic,
 161| |    isDynamic: r.isDynamic,
 162| |    isConstantResponse: r.isConstantResponse,
 163| |    responseType: r.responseType,
 164| |    paramNames: r.paramNames,
 165| |    hooks: r.hooks,
 166| |    usage: r.usage,
 167| |  })),
 168| |});
 170|▼|export const writeArtifacts = (
 171| |  routes: readonly RouteDef[],
 172| |  opts: CompilerOptions,
 173| |  logger: Logger
 174| |): void => {
 175| |  mkdirSync(opts.outDir, { recursive: true });
 177| |  if (opts.generateTypes) {
 178| |    const types = generateRouteTypes(routes);
 179| |    writeFileSync(join(opts.outDir, "routes.d.ts"), types);
 180| |    logger.info("Generated routes.d.ts");
 181| |  }
 183| |  if (opts.generateClient) {
 184| |    writeFileSync(join(opts.outDir, "client.d.ts"), generateClientDts());
 185| |    logger.info("Generated client.d.ts");
 186| |  }
 188| |  if (opts.generateOpenAPI) {
 189| |    const openapi = generateOpenApi(routes, opts);
 190| |    writeFileSync(
 191| |      join(opts.outDir, "openapi.json"),
 192| |      JSON.stringify(openapi, null, 2)
 193| |    );
 194| |    logger.info("Generated openapi.json");
 195| |  }
 197| |  const manifest = generateManifest(routes, opts);
 198| |  writeFileSync(join(opts.outDir, "manifest.json"), JSON.stringify(manifest, null, 2));
 199| |  logger.info("Generated manifest.json");
 200| |};

  44|▼|const toImportPath = (absPath: string, opts: CompilerOptions): string => {

  54|▼|const runtimeImport = (projectPath: string, opts: CompilerOptions): string =>

  87|▼|const routeReplyFn = (route: RouteDef): string => {
  88| |  if (route.responseType === "text") return "textReply";
  89| |  if (route.responseType === "html") return "htmlReply";
  90| |  if (route.responseType === "stream") return "streamReply";
  91| |  return "jsonReply";

  94|▼|const tryNormalizeConstant = (route: RouteDef): string | null => {
  95| |  if (!route.isConstantResponse || !route.constantResponse) return null;
  96| |  if (route.hooks.length > 0) return null;
  97| |  if (route.hasValidation) return null;
  99| |  if (route.validators && Object.keys(route.validators).length > 0) {
 100| |    return null;
 101| |  }
 103| |  try {
 104| |    JSON.parse(route.constantResponse);
 105| |    return route.constantResponse;
 106| |  } catch {
 107| |    return null;
 108| |  }
 109| |};
 111| |const getCacheConfig = (
 112| |  route: RouteDef,
 113| |  cfg: CodegenConfig
 114| |):
 115| |  | {
 116| |    ttlMs?: number;
 117| |    staleTtlMs?: number;
 118| |    vary?: string[];
 119| |  }
 120| |  | undefined => {
 121| |  if (!cfg.routeCache) return undefined;
 122| |  if (route.method !== "GET" && route.method !== "HEAD") return undefined;
 124| |  const cache = route.cache;
 125| |  if (!cache) return undefined;
 127| |  const out: {
 128| |    ttlMs?: number;
 129| |    staleTtlMs?: number;
 130| |    vary?: string[];
 131| |  } = {};
 133| |  if (typeof cache.maxAge === "number") {
 134| |    out.ttlMs = cache.maxAge * 1000;
 135| |  }
 137| |  if (typeof cache.swr === "number") {
 138| |    out.staleTtlMs = cache.swr * 1000;
 139| |  }
 141| |  if (Array.isArray(cache.vary)) {
 142| |    out.vary = [...cache.vary];
 143| |  }
 145| |  return Object.keys(out).length > 0 ? out : undefined;

 148|▼|const bunRoutePath = (path: string): string =>

 151|▼|const wildcardNames = (path: string): string[] =>
 152| |  Array.from(path.matchAll(/\*([A-Za-z0-9_]+)/g)).map((m) => m[1] as string);
 154| |const FORCE_FULL_TOKENS = [
 155| |  "ctx.cookie",
 156| |  "ctx.server",
 157| |  "ctx.set",
 158| |  "ctx.proxy",
 159| |  "ctx.forward",
 160| |  "ctx.cache",
