 163|▼|export const generateServer = (
 164| |  routes: readonly RouteDef[],
 165| |  modules: readonly ModuleInfo[],
 166| |  hooks: ReadonlyMap<string, HookDef>,
 167| |  opts: CompilerOptions
 168| |): string => {
 169| |  const cfg = getConfig(opts);
 171| |  const imports = new Set<string>();
 172| |  const header: string[] = [];
 173| |  const cacheDecls: string[] = [];
 174| |  const functions: string[] = [];
 176| |  const corePath = "@flux/core";
 178| |  const appConfigPath = (opts as any).appConfig;
 179| |  const hasAppConfig = typeof appConfigPath === "string" && appConfigPath.length > 0 && existsSync(join(process.cwd(), appConfigPath));
 181| |  const coreNames = [
 182| |    "createContext",
 183| |    "createLazyBody",
 184| |    "parseQueryFromURL",
 185| |    "errorToResponse",
 186| |    "sendFile",
 187| |    "HttpResponseCache",
 188| |    "ValidationError",
 189| |    "serializeCookie",
 190| |    "parseCookieString",
 191| |    "createCookieJar",
 192| |    "validateAsync",
 193| |    "EMPTY_LIFECYCLE",
 194| |  ];
 196| |  if (hasAppConfig) {
 197| |    coreNames.push("createPluginContext", "mergeLifeCycle", "pluginsToLifeCycle");
 198| |  }
 200| |  for (const route of routes) {
 201| |    if (route.usage.proxy) coreNames.push("proxyRequest");
 202| |    if (route.usage.forward) coreNames.push("forwardRequest");
 203| |  }
 205| |  const uniqueCore = [...new Set(coreNames)].sort();
 206| |  imports.add(
 207| |    `import { ${uniqueCore.join(", ")} } from ${JSON.stringify(corePath)};`
 208| |  );
 210| |  if (hasAppConfig) {
 211| |    imports.add(
 212| |      `import * as __appConfig from ${JSON.stringify(
 213| |        toImportPath(join(process.cwd(), appConfigPath), opts)
 214| |      )};`
 215| |    );
 216| |  }
 218| |  for (const route of routes) {
 219| |    const mod = modules[route.moduleIdx];
 221| |    if (mod) {
 222| |      imports.add(
 223| |        `import ${handlerImportName(route)} from ${JSON.stringify(
 224| |          toImportPath(mod.path, opts)
 225| |        )};`
 226| |      );
 227| |      if (route.hasValidation) {
 228| |        imports.add(
 229| |          `import * as schema_${route.handlerRef} from ${JSON.stringify(
 230| |            toImportPath(mod.path, opts)
 231| |          )};`
 232| |        );
 233| |      }
 234| |    }
 236| |    if (route.validators) {
 237| |      const kinds = ["body", "query", "params", "headers", "cookie"] as const;
 239| |      for (const kind of kinds) {
 240| |        if (route.validators[kind]) {
 241| |          imports.add(
 242| |            `import ${validatorImportName(
 243| |              route,
 244| |              kind
 245| |            )} from "./validators/${route.handlerRef}.${kind}.cjs";`
 246| |          );
 247| |        }
 248| |      }
 249| |    }
 251| |    if (route.serializers?.json) {
 252| |      imports.add(
 253| |        `import ${serializerImportName(
 254| |          route
 255| |        )} from "./serializers/${route.handlerRef}.200.mjs";`
 256| |      );
 257| |    }
 259| |    for (const hookName of route.hooks) {
 260| |      const hook = hooks.get(hookName);
 262| |      if (hook) {
 263| |        imports.add(
 264| |          `import ${hookIdent(hookName)} from ${JSON.stringify(
 265| |            toImportPath(join(process.cwd(), hook.source), opts)
 266| |          )};`
 267| |        );
 268| |      }
 269| |    }
 270| |  }
 272| |  header.push(`const EMPTY_PARAMS = Object.freeze({});`);
 274| |  header.push(`const BODY_LIMITS = Object.freeze({
 275| |  maxJsonBytes: ${opts.maxJsonBytes ?? 2 * 1024 * 1024},
 276| |  maxTextBytes: ${opts.maxTextBytes ?? 2 * 1024 * 1024},
 277| |  maxFormBytes: ${opts.maxFormBytes ?? 2 * 1024 * 1024},
 278| |  maxFileBytes: ${opts.maxFileBytes ?? 20 * 1024 * 1024},
 279| |});`);
 281| |  header.push(`const EXPOSE_ERRORS = ${cfg.exposeErrorDetails ? "true" : "false"};`);
 283| |  if (hasAppConfig) {
 284| |    imports.add(
 285| |      `import * as __appConfig from ${JSON.stringify(
 286| |        toImportPath(join(process.cwd(), appConfigPath), opts)
 287| |      )};`
 288| |    );
 290| |    header.push(`const __pluginContext = createPluginContext();`);
 291| |    header.push(`for (const __p of __appConfig.plugins ?? []) {
 292| |  if (typeof __p === "function") await __p(__pluginContext);
 293| |  else if (__p && typeof __p.setup === "function") await __p.setup(__pluginContext);
 294| |}`);
 295| |    header.push(`const __pluginLC = pluginsToLifeCycle(__appConfig.plugins ?? []);`);
 296| |    header.push(`const __userLC = __appConfig.lifecycle ?? __appConfig.hooks ?? {};`);
 297| |    header.push(`const __lc = mergeLifeCycle(mergeLifeCycle(EMPTY_LIFECYCLE, __pluginLC), __userLC);`);
 298| |    header.push(`const __serverCfg = __appConfig.server ?? {};`);
 299| |  } else {
 300| |    header.push(`const __lc = EMPTY_LIFECYCLE;`);
 301| |    header.push(`const __serverCfg = {};`);
 302| |  }
 303| |  header.push(`const jsonReply = (data, init) => Response.json(data, init);`);
 305| |  header.push(`const textReply = (data, init) =>
 306| |  new Response(
 307| |    String(data),
 308| |    init
 309| |      ? { ...init, headers: { "content-type": "text/plain; charset=utf-8", ...init.headers } }
 310| |      : { headers: { "content-type": "text/plain; charset=utf-8" } }
 311| |  );`);
 313| |  header.push(`const htmlReply = (data, init) =>
 314| |  new Response(
 315| |    String(data),
 316| |    init
 317| |      ? { ...init, headers: { "content-type": "text/html; charset=utf-8", ...init.headers } }
 318| |      : { headers: { "content-type": "text/html; charset=utf-8" } }
 319| |  );`);
 321| |  header.push(`const streamReply = (stream, init) => new Response(stream, init);`);
 323| |  header.push(`const emptyReply = (status = 204) => new Response(null, { status });`);
 325| |  header.push(`const redirectReply = (url, status = 302) => Response.redirect(url, status);`);
 327| |  header.push(`const statusReply = (code) => new Response(null, { status: code });`);
 329| |  header.push(`const validationError = (errors, on) =>
 330| |  new ValidationError("Validation failed", errors, on);`);
 332| |  header.push(`const __applySet = (response, set) => {
 333| |  if (!set) return response;
 334| |  const h = new Headers(response.headers);
 335| |  if (set.headers) {
 336| |    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(set.headers)) {
 337| |      if (v == null) continue;
 338| |      if (Array.isArray(v)) { h.delete(k); for (const x of v) h.append(k, String(x)); }
 339| |      else h.set(k, String(v));
 340| |    }
 341| |  }
 342| |  if (set.cookie && typeof set.cookie === "object") {
 343| |    const s = serializeCookie(set.cookie);
 344| |    if (s) {
 345| |      if (Array.isArray(s)) for (const c of s) h.append("set-cookie", c);
 346| |      else h.append("set-cookie", s);
 347| |    }
 348| |  }
 349| |  return new Response(response.body, { status: set.status ?? response.status, headers: h, statusText: response.statusText });
 350| |};`);
 352| |  header.push(`const __finalize = (result, ctx, serializers, reply) => {
 353| |  const set = ctx?.set;
 354| |  if (result instanceof Response) return __applySet(result, set);
 355| |  if (result === undefined || result === null) return __applySet(new Response(null, { status: set?.status ?? 204 }), set);
 356| |  let status = set?.status;
 357| |  let body = result;
 358| |  if (typeof result === "object" && result !== null && "status" in result && "body" in result && Number.isInteger(result.status)) {
 359| |    status = status ?? result.status;
 360| |    body = result.body;
 361| |  }
 362| |  status = status ?? 200;
 363| |  const ser = serializers?.[String(status)] ?? serializers?.["200"] ?? serializers?.default;
 364| |  if (ser) return __applySet(new Response(ser(body), { status, headers: { "content-type": "application/json; charset=utf-8" } }), set);
 365| |  return __applySet(reply(body, { status }), set);
 366| |};`);
 368| |  header.push(`async function __runHooks(hooks, ctx, arg) {
 369| |  let c = ctx;
 370| |  for (const entry of hooks ?? []) {
 371| |    const fn = typeof entry === "function" ? entry : entry?.fn;
 372| |    if (typeof fn !== "function") continue;
 373| |    const r = arg === undefined ? await fn(c) : await fn(c, arg);
 374| |    if (r instanceof Response) return { response: r, ctx: c };
 375| |    if (r && typeof r === "object") {
 376| |      if (r.ok === false && r.response instanceof Response) return { response: r.response, ctx: c };
 377| |      if (r.response instanceof Response) return { response: r.response, ctx: c };
 378| |      if (r.ctx) c = r.ctx;
 379| |    }
 380| |  }
 381| |  return { ctx: c };
 382| |}`);
 384| |  header.push(`async function __handleError(err, ctx) {
 385| |  try {
 386| |    const r = await __runHooks(__lc.error ?? __lc.onError, ctx, err);
 387| |    if (r.response) return __applySet(r.response, r.ctx?.set ?? ctx?.set);
 388| |  } catch {}
 389| |  return errorToResponse(err, EXPOSE_ERRORS);
 390| |}`);
 392| |  header.push(`const __schemaFor = (m) => m?.schema ?? m?.default?.schema ?? undefined;`);
 394| |  header.push(`async function __validatePart(schemaPart, input, on) {
 395| |  if (schemaPart !== undefined && schemaPart !== null) {
 396| |    await validateAsync(schemaPart, input, on);
 397| |  }
 398| |}`);
 400| |  header.push(`function __extractParams(req, a, b) {
 401| |  if (req && typeof req === "object" && "params" in req && req.params) {
 402| |    return req.params;
 403| |  }
 405| |  const isServerLike = (x) =>
 406| |    x && typeof x === "object" && ("requestIP" in x || "fetch" in x || "stop" in x);
 408| |  if (a && typeof a === "object" && !isServerLike(a)) return a;
 409| |  if (b && typeof b === "object" && !isServerLike(b)) return b;
 411| |  return EMPTY_PARAMS;
 412| |}`);
 414| |  header.push(`function __extractServer(a, b) {
 415| |  const isServerLike = (x) =>
 416| |    x && typeof x === "object" && ("requestIP" in x || "fetch" in x || "stop" in x);
 418| |  if (isServerLike(a)) return a;
 419| |  if (isServerLike(b)) return b;
 420| |  return undefined;
 421| |}`);
 423| |  header.push(`function __wrap(handler, wildcards = []) {
 424| |  return async function (req, a, b) {
 425| |    let params = __extractParams(req, a, b);
 427| |    if (wildcards.length && params && params["*"] != null) {
 428| |      params = { ...params };
 429| |      for (const name of wildcards) {
 430| |        params[name] = params["*"];
 431| |      }
 432| |    }
 434| |    const server = __extractServer(a, b);
 436| |    try {
 437| |      return await handler(req, params ?? EMPTY_PARAMS, server);
 438| |    } catch (err) {
 439| |      const ctx = createContext(req, params ?? EMPTY_PARAMS, { body: BODY_LIMITS });
 440| |      ctx.server = server;
 441| |      return __handleError(err, ctx);
 442| |    }
 443| |  };
 444| |}`);
 446| |  header.push(`function __head(handler, wildcards = []) {
 447| |  const wrapped = __wrap(handler, wildcards);
 449| |  return async function (req, a, b) {
 450| |    const res = await wrapped(req, a, b);
 451| |    const headers = new Headers(res.headers);
 452| |    headers.delete("content-length");
 454| |    return new Response(null, {
 455| |      status: res.status,
 456| |      statusText: res.statusText,
 457| |      headers,
 458| |    });
 459| |  };
 460| |}`);
 462| |  header.push(`async function __optionsHandler(req, params, server) {
 463| |  const url = new URL(req.url);
 464| |  const allow = __allowFor(url.pathname) ?? "OPTIONS";
 466| |  const ctx = createContext(req, params ?? EMPTY_PARAMS, { body: BODY_LIMITS });
 467| |  ctx.server = server;
 469| |  const r = await __runHooks(__lc.request ?? [], ctx);
 470| |  if (r.response) {
 471| |    const headers = new Headers(r.response.headers);
 472| |    if (!headers.has("access-control-allow-methods")) {
 473| |      headers.set("Allow", allow);
 474| |    }
 476| |    return new Response(r.response.body, {
 477| |      status: r.response.status,
 478| |      statusText: r.response.statusText,
 479| |      headers,
 480| |    });
 481| |  }
 483| |  return new Response(null, {
 484| |    status: 204,
 485| |    headers: {
 486| |      Allow: allow,
 487| |    },
 488| |  });
 489| |}`);
 491|▼|  const generateRouteCode = (route: RouteDef): void => {
 492| |    const mod = modules[route.moduleIdx];
 493| |    const constantJson = tryNormalizeConstant(route);
 495| |    if (constantJson !== null) {
 496| |      functions.push(`const ${constantBodyVar(route)} = ${constantJson};`);
 498| |      functions.push(`const ${constantInitVar(route)} = Object.freeze({
 499| |  status: 200,
 500| |  headers: { "content-type": "application/json; charset=utf-8" },
 501| |});`);
 503| |      functions.push(`function ${methodHandlerName(route)}(req, params, server) {
 504| |  return new Response(${constantBodyVar(route)}, ${constantInitVar(route)});
 505| |}`);
 507| |      return;
 508| |    }
 510| |    const hasHooks = route.hooks.length > 0;
 512| |    const hasGlobalLifecycle = !!hasAppConfig;
 514| |    const needsFull =
 515| |      !cfg.specializeContext ||
 516| |      hasHooks ||
 517| |      hasGlobalLifecycle ||
 518| |      route.hasValidation ||
 519| |      route.usage.cookie ||
 520| |      route.usage.set ||
 521| |      route.usage.proxy ||
 522| |      route.usage.forward ||
 523| |      route.usage.cache ||
 524| |      route.usage.sendFile ||
 525| |      route.usage.file ||
 526| |      (mod ? FORCE_FULL_TOKENS.some((token) => mod.content.includes(token)) : false);
 528| |    const hasParamsValidator = !!route.validators?.params;
 529| |    const hasQueryValidator = !!route.validators?.query;
 530| |    const hasHeadersValidator = !!route.validators?.headers;
 531| |    const hasBodyValidator = !!route.validators?.body;
 532| |    const hasCookieValidator = !!route.validators?.cookie;
 534| |    const serializer = route.serializers?.json;

   1| |/**
   2| | * Phase 5: LINKER — Bun 1.4 edition.
   3| | *
   4| | * Important:
   5| | * - The temporary Bun.build entry MUST live in opts.outDir.
   6| | * - Generated import paths are relative to opts.outDir.
   7| | */
   9| |import {
  10| |  writeFileSync,
  11| |  mkdirSync,
  12| |  renameSync,
  13| |  rmSync,
  14| |  existsSync,
  15| |} from "fs";
  16| |import { join, basename } from "path";
  18| |import type { CompilerOptions } from "../types";
  19| |import type { Logger } from "../logger";
  21|▼|const formatBuildLogs = (input: unknown): string => {
  22| |  const logs: any[] = Array.isArray(input)
  23| |    ? input
  24| |    : input && typeof input === "object" && "logs" in input
  25| |      ? ((input as any).logs ?? [])
  26| |      : [];
  28| |  if (!logs.length) return "";
  30| |  return (
  31| |    "\n" +
  32| |    logs
  33| |      .map((log) => {
  34| |        if (typeof log === "string") return log;
  36| |        const pos = log?.position
  37| |          ? ` (${log.position.file}:${log.position.line}:${log.position.column})`
  38| |          : "";
  40| |        return `${log?.message ?? String(log)}${pos}`;
  41| |      })
  42| |      .join("\n")
  43| |  );
  44| |};
  46| |const bun: any = (globalThis as any).Bun;
  48|▼|const writeRaw = (
  49| |  outPath: string,
  50| |  code: string,
  51| |  logger: Logger,
  52| |  warning?: string
  53| |): string => {
  54| |  if (warning) {
  55| |    logger.warn(warning);
  56| |  }
  58| |  writeFileSync(outPath, code);
  60| |  logger.info(
  61| |    `Linked → ${outPath} (${(Buffer.byteLength(code) / 1024).toFixed(1)} KB)`
  62| |  );
  64| |  return outPath;
  65| |};
  67|▼|export const runLinkerAsync = async (
  68| |  code: string,
  69| |  opts: CompilerOptions,
  70| |  logger: Logger
  71| |): Promise<string> => {
  72| |  const start = performance.now();
  74| |  mkdirSync(opts.outDir, { recursive: true });
  76| |  const outPath = join(opts.outDir, opts.outFile);
  78| |  if (!bun?.build) {
  79| |    return writeRaw(
  80| |      outPath,
  81| |      code,
  82| |      logger,
  83| |      "Bun.build unavailable. Wrote unminified output."
  84| |    );
  85| |  }
  87| |  if (!opts.minify && !opts.sourceMap) {
  88| |    return writeRaw(outPath, code, logger);
  89| |  }
  91| |  /**
  92| |   * IMPORTANT:
  93| |   *
  94| |   * This entry file must be inside opts.outDir.
  95| |   *
  96| |   * Correct:
  97| |   *   dist/.__server.js.entry.js
  98| |   *
  99| |   * Wrong:
 100| |   *   dist/.flux-link/__server.js
 101| |   *
 102| |   * Because generated imports are relative to dist/.
 103| |   */
 104| |  const entryPath = join(opts.outDir, `.${opts.outFile}.entry.js`);
 106| |  await bun.write(entryPath, code);
 108| |  const buildOptions: any = {
 109| |    entrypoints: [entryPath],
 110| |    outdir: opts.outDir,
 111| |    target: "bun",
 112| |    format: "esm",
 113| |    minify: opts.minify,
 114| |    sourcemap: opts.sourceMap ? "external" : "none",
 115| |  };
 117| |  let result: any;
 119| |  try {
 120| |    result = await bun.build(buildOptions);
 121|!|  } catch (err: any) {
 122| |    rmSync(entryPath, { force: true });
 124| |    const details = formatBuildLogs(
 125| |      err?.errors ?? err?.logs ?? err?.cause?.errors ?? err?.cause?.logs,
 126| |    );
 128|!|    throw new Error(
 129| |      `Bun.build threw an exception:\n${err?.message ?? String(err)}${details}`,
 130| |    );
 131| |  }
 133| |  if (!result.success) {
 134| |    const message = (result.logs ?? [])
 135| |      .map((log: any) => log?.message ?? String(log))
 136| |      .join("\n");
 138| |    rmSync(entryPath, { force: true });
 140|!|    throw new Error(`Bun.build failed:\n${message}`);
 141| |  }
 143| |  const builtPath: string | undefined = result.outputs?.[0]?.path;
 145| |  if (builtPath && existsSync(builtPath)) {
 146| |    if (builtPath !== outPath) {
 147| |      renameSync(builtPath, outPath);
 148| |    }
 149| |  } else if (existsSync(entryPath)) {
 150| |    if (entryPath !== outPath) {
 151| |      renameSync(entryPath, outPath);
 152| |    }
 153| |  }
 155| |  if (opts.sourceMap) {
 156| |    const mapSource = builtPath
 157| |      ? `${builtPath}.map`
 158| |      : `${entryPath}.map`;
 160| |    const mapOut = `${outPath}.map`;
 162| |    if (existsSync(mapSource) && mapSource !== mapOut) {
 163| |      renameSync(mapSource, mapOut);
 164| |    }
 166| |    if (existsSync(outPath)) {
 167| |      const text = await bun.file(outPath).text();
 169| |      const fixed = text.replace(
 170| |        /\/\/# sourceMappingURL=.*$/m,
 171| |        `//# sourceMappingURL=${basename(mapOut)}`
 172| |      );
 174| |      await bun.write(outPath, fixed);
 175| |    }
 176| |  }
 178| |  if (existsSync(entryPath) && entryPath !== outPath) {
 179| |    rmSync(entryPath, { force: true });
 180| |  }
 182| |  const finalCode = existsSync(outPath)
 183| |    ? await bun.file(outPath).text()
 184| |    : code;
 186| |  const elapsed = (performance.now() - start).toFixed(2);
 188| |  logger.info(
 189| |    `Linked → ${outPath} (${(Buffer.byteLength(finalCode) / 1024).toFixed(1)} KB)`
 190| |  );
 192| |  logger.info(`linker completed in ${elapsed}ms`);
 194| |  return outPath;
 195| |};
 197| |/**
 198| | * Sync fallback.
 199| | *
 200| | * Bun.build is async, so synchronous compile() cannot use it.
 201| | * Prefer buildAsync() in production.
 202| | */
 203|▼|export const runLinker = (
 204| |  code: string,
 205| |  opts: CompilerOptions,
 206| |  logger: Logger
 207| |): string =>
 208| |  logger.time("linker", () => {
 209| |    mkdirSync(opts.outDir, { recursive: true });
 211| |    const outPath = join(opts.outDir, opts.outFile);
 213| |    return writeRaw(
 214| |      outPath,
 215| |      code,
 216| |      logger,
 217| |      "Sync linker wrote unminified output. Use buildAsync() for Bun.build minification."
 218| |    );
 219| |  });
 221| |/**
 222| | * Compatibility stubs.
 223| | *
 224| | * The old esbuild linker exported these.
 225| | * They are no longer used by the Bun.build linker.
 226| | */
 227|▼|export const minifyCode = (code: string): string => code;
 229|▼|export const emitSourceMap = (
 230| |  _fileName: string,
 231| |  _code: string
 232| |): string => "";

   1| |/**
   2| | * Phase 2: Serializer Precompilation
   3| | *
   4| | * Emits specialized JSON serializers for route response schemas.
   5| | */
   7| |import { mkdirSync, writeFileSync } from "fs";
   8| |import { join } from "path";
  10| |import type {
  11| |  RouteDef,
  12| |  ModuleInfo,
  13| |  CompilerOptions,
  14| |} from "../types";
  16| |import type { Logger } from "../logger";
  17| |import {
  18| |  loadRouteModule,
  19| |  isStandardSchema,
  20| |  cloneSchema,
  21| |} from "./schema-loader";
  23|▼|const serializerImportName = (route: RouteDef): string =>
  24| |  `serialize_${route.handlerRef}`;
  26|▼|const serializerFileName = (route: RouteDef): string =>
  27| |  `${route.handlerRef}.200.mjs`;
  29|▼|const pickResponseSchema = (responseSchema: any): any => {
  30| |  if (!responseSchema || typeof responseSchema !== "object") {
  31| |    return undefined;
  32| |  }
  34| |  if (isStandardSchema(responseSchema)) {
  35| |    return responseSchema;
  36| |  }
  38| |  if ("type" in responseSchema) {
  39| |    return responseSchema;
  40| |  }
  42| |  return responseSchema[200] ?? responseSchema["200"] ?? responseSchema;
  43| |};
  45|▼|const getStatusSchemas = (responseSchema: any): Record<string, any> | null => {
  46| |  if (!responseSchema || typeof responseSchema !== "object") return null;
  48| |  const statusKeys = Object.keys(responseSchema).filter((k) => /^\d{3}$/.test(k));
  49| |  if (statusKeys.length === 0) return null;
  51| |  const out: Record<string, any> = {};
  53| |  for (const status of statusKeys) {
  54| |    const s = responseSchema[status];
  55| |    if (s) {
  56| |      out[status] = s;
  57| |    }
  58| |  }
  60| |  return Object.keys(out).length > 0 ? out : null;
  61| |};
  63|▼|export const precompileSerializers = async (
  64| |  routes: readonly RouteDef[],
  65| |  modules: readonly ModuleInfo[],
  66| |  opts: CompilerOptions,
  67| |  logger: Logger
  68| |): Promise<readonly RouteDef[]> => {
  69| |  if (!opts.precompileSerializers) {
  70| |    return routes;
  71| |  }
  73| |  let fastJson: any;
  75| |  try {
  76| |    const mod: any = await import("fast-json-stringify");
  77| |    fastJson = mod.default ?? mod;
  78| |  } catch {
  79| |    logger.warn(
  80| |      "fast-json-stringify unavailable. Serializer precompilation will be skipped."
  81| |    );
  82| |    return routes;
  83| |  }
  85| |  const serializersDir = join(opts.outDir, "serializers");
  86| |  mkdirSync(serializersDir, { recursive: true });
  88| |  const nextRoutes: RouteDef[] = [];
  90| |  for (const route of routes) {
  91| |    const isJsonRoute =
  92| |      route.responseType === "json" || route.usage.json === true;
  94| |    if (!isJsonRoute) {
  95| |      nextRoutes.push(route);
  96| |      continue;
  97| |    }
  99| |    const mod = modules[route.moduleIdx];
 101| |    if (!mod || !mod.schemaExport) {
 102| |      nextRoutes.push(route);
 103| |      continue;
 104| |    }
 106| |    const routeModule = await loadRouteModule(mod.path);
 107| |    const schema = routeModule?.schema;
 109| |    if (!schema || typeof schema !== "object") {
 110| |      nextRoutes.push(route);
 111| |      continue;
 112| |    }
 114| |    const multiStatus = getStatusSchemas(schema.response);
 115| |    const responseSchema = pickResponseSchema(schema.response);
 117| |    if (!multiStatus && !responseSchema) {
 118| |      nextRoutes.push(route);
 119| |      continue;
 120| |    }
 122| |    const byStatus: Record<string, string> = {};
 123| |    const schemasToCompile = multiStatus ?? { "200": responseSchema };
 125| |for (const [status, statusSchema] of Object.entries(schemasToCompile)) {
 126| |  const fileName = `${route.handlerRef}.${status}.mjs`;
 127| |  const importName = `serialize_${route.handlerRef}_${status}`;
 129| |  // Standard Schema fallback: safe JSON.stringify serializer
 130| |  if (isStandardSchema(statusSchema)) {
 131| |    const code = `export default (input) => JSON.stringify(input);
 132| |`;
 134| |    writeFileSync(join(serializersDir, fileName), code);
 135| |    byStatus[status] = importName;
 136| |    continue;
 137| |  }
 139| |  let cloned: any;
 140| |  try {
 141| |    cloned = cloneSchema(statusSchema);
 142| |  } catch {
 143| |    continue;
 144| |  }
 146| |  try {
 147| |    fastJson(cloned);
 149| |    const code = `import fastJson from "fast-json-stringify";
 151| |const schema = ${JSON.stringify(cloned)};
 153| |const serialize = fastJson(schema);
 155| |export default serialize;
 156| |`;
 158| |    writeFileSync(join(serializersDir, fileName), code);
 159| |    byStatus[status] = importName;
 160| |  } catch {
 161| |    // If schema compilation fails, fall back to JSON.stringify
 162| |    const code = `export default (input) => JSON.stringify(input);
 163| |`;
 165| |    writeFileSync(join(serializersDir, fileName), code);
 166| |    byStatus[status] = importName;
 167| |  }
 168| |}
 170| |    if (Object.keys(byStatus).length === 0) {
 171| |      nextRoutes.push(route);
 172| |      continue;
 173| |    }
 175| |    nextRoutes.push({
 176| |      ...route,
 177| |      serializers: {
 178| |        json: byStatus["200"] ?? Object.values(byStatus)[0],
 179| |        byStatus,
 180| |      },
 181| |    });
 183| |    logger.info(`Precompiled serializer for ${route.method} ${route.path}`);
 184| |  }
 186| |  return nextRoutes;
 187| |};

   1| |/**
   2| | * Phase 2: Validator Precompilation
   3| | *
   4| | * Emits Ajv standalone validators for route schemas.
   5| | */
   7| |import { mkdirSync, writeFileSync } from "fs";
   8| |import { join } from "path";
   9| |import Ajv from "ajv";
  10| |import addFormats from "ajv-formats";
  12| |import type {
  13| |  RouteDef,
  14| |  ModuleInfo,
  15| |  CompilerOptions,
  16| |} from "../types";
  18| |import type { Logger } from "../logger";
  19| |import {
  20| |  loadRouteModule,
  21| |  isStandardSchema,
  22| |  cloneSchema,
  23| |} from "./schema-loader";
  25| |const VALIDATOR_KINDS = ["body", "query", "params", "headers", "cookie"] as const;
  27|▼|type ValidatorKind = (typeof VALIDATOR_KINDS)[number];
  29|▼|const validatorImportName = (
  30| |  route: RouteDef,
  31| |  kind: ValidatorKind
  32| |): string => `validate_${route.handlerRef}_${kind}`;
  34|▼|const validatorFileName = (
  35| |  route: RouteDef,
  36| |  kind: ValidatorKind
  37| |): string => `${route.handlerRef}.${kind}.cjs`;
  39|▼|export const precompileValidators = async (
  40| |  routes: readonly RouteDef[],
  41| |  modules: readonly ModuleInfo[],
  42| |  opts: CompilerOptions,
  43| |  logger: Logger
  44| |): Promise<readonly RouteDef[]> => {
  45| |  if (!opts.precompileValidators) {
  46| |    return routes;
  47| |  }
  49| |  const validatorsDir = join(opts.outDir, "validators");
  50| |  mkdirSync(validatorsDir, { recursive: true });
  52| |  let standaloneCode: any;
  54| |  try {
  55| |    const standaloneModule: any = await import("ajv/dist/standalone/index.js");
  56| |    standaloneCode = standaloneModule.default ?? standaloneModule;
  57| |  } catch {
  58| |    logger.warn(
  59| |      "Ajv standalone unavailable. Validator precompilation will be skipped."
  60| |    );
  61| |    return routes;
  62| |  }
  64| |  const ajv = new Ajv({
  65| |    allErrors: true,
  66| |    strict: false,
  67| |    coerceTypes: true,
  68| |    removeAdditional: true,
  69| |    useDefaults: true,
  70| |    code: {
  71| |      source: true,
  72| |      esm: false,
  73| |    },
  74| |  });
  76| |  addFormats(ajv);
  78|▼|  const compileSchemaPart = (schemaPart: unknown): string | null => {
  79| |    if (!schemaPart || typeof schemaPart !== "object") {
  80| |      return null;
  81| |    }
  83| |    if (isStandardSchema(schemaPart)) {
  84| |      return null;
  85| |    }
  87| |    let cloned: any;
  89| |    try {
  90| |      cloned = cloneSchema(schemaPart);
  91| |    } catch {
  92| |      return null;
  93| |    }
  95| |    if (!cloned || typeof cloned !== "object") {
  96| |      return null;
  97| |    }
  99| |    if (cloned.noValidate === true) {
 100| |      return null;
 101| |    }
 103| |    delete cloned.$id;
 105| |    try {
 106| |      const validate = ajv.compile(cloned);
 107| |      const code = standaloneCode(ajv, validate);
 109| |      return `${code}
 110| |try {
 111| |  if (typeof module !== "undefined" && module.exports && typeof module.exports === "function") {
 112| |    module.exports.default = module.exports;
 113| |  }
 114| |} catch {}
 115| |`;
 116| |    } catch {
 117| |      return null;
 118| |    }
 119| |  };
 121| |  const nextRoutes: RouteDef[] = [];
 123| |  for (const route of routes) {
 124| |    if (!route.hasValidation) {
 125| |      nextRoutes.push(route);
 126| |      continue;
 127| |    }
 129| |    const mod = modules[route.moduleIdx];
 131| |    if (!mod || !mod.schemaExport) {
 132| |      nextRoutes.push(route);
 133| |      continue;
 134| |    }
 136| |    const routeModule = await loadRouteModule(mod.path);
 137| |    const schema = routeModule?.schema;
 139| |    if (!schema || typeof schema !== "object") {
 140| |      nextRoutes.push(route);
 141| |      continue;
 142| |    }
 144| |    const validators: Record<string, string> = {};
 146| |    for (const kind of VALIDATOR_KINDS) {
 147| |      const schemaPart = schema[kind];
 149| |      if (!schemaPart) {
 150| |        continue;
 151| |      }
 153| |      const code = compileSchemaPart(schemaPart);
 155| |      if (!code) {
 156| |        continue;
 157| |      }
 159| |      const file = validatorFileName(route, kind);
 160| |      writeFileSync(join(validatorsDir, file), code);
 162| |      validators[kind] = validatorImportName(route, kind);
 163| |    }
 165| |    if (Object.keys(validators).length === 0) {
 166| |      nextRoutes.push(route);
 167| |      continue;
 168| |    }
 170| |    nextRoutes.push({
 171| |      ...route,
 172| |      validators: validators as any,
 173| |    });
 175| |    logger.info(`Precompiled validators for ${route.method} ${route.path}`);
 176| |  }
 178| |  return nextRoutes;
 179| |};

   1| |/**
   2| | * @fileoverview Bun.Transpiler-based AST Parser
   3| | * Replaces regex hacks with a proper ESTree walker.
   4| | * Handles edge cases: nested functions, template literals, comments, re-exports, etc.
   5| | */
   7| |import type {
   8| |  ContextUsage,
   9| |  ImportInfo,
  10| |  ExportInfo,
  11| |  SymbolInfo,
  12| |  Position,
  13| |} from "../types";
  14| |import { EMPTY_USAGE } from "@flux/shared";
  15| |import * as oxcParser from "oxc-parser";
  17| |import { createRequire } from "node:module";
  18| |/**
  19| | * Build ImportInfo without assigning explicit undefined properties.
  20| | *
  21| | * This satisfies exactOptionalPropertyTypes cleanly.
  22| | */
  24|▼|const createImportInfo = (
  25| |  source: string,
  26| |  names: string[],
  27| |  defaultName?: string,
  28| |  namespaceName?: string,
  29| |): ImportInfo => {
  30| |  const info: {
  31| |    source: string;
  32| |    names: string[];
  33| |    defaultName?: string;
  34| |    namespaceName?: string;
  35| |  } = {
  36| |    source,
  37| |    names,
  38| |  };
  40| |  if (defaultName !== undefined) info.defaultName = defaultName;
  41| |  if (namespaceName !== undefined) info.namespaceName = namespaceName;
  43| |  return info;
  44| |};
  47| |// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  48| |// ESTree Walker — tiny, zero-dependency
  49| |// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  51|▼|function walk(node: any, cb: (node: any) => void): void {
  52| |  if (!node || typeof node !== "object") return;
  53| |  cb(node);
  54| |  for (const key of Object.keys(node)) {
  55| |    if (key === "parent" || key === "loc" || key === "range") continue;
  56| |    const child = node[key];
  57| |    if (Array.isArray(child)) {
  58| |      for (const c of child) walk(c, cb);
  59| |    } else if (child && typeof child === "object" && child.type) {
  60| |      walk(child, cb);
  61| |    }
  62| |  }
  63| |}
  65|▼|function walkUntil<T>(node: any, predicate: (node: any) => T | undefined): T | undefined {
  66| |  let result: T | undefined;
  67| |  walk(node, (n) => {
  68| |    if (result !== undefined) return;
  69| |    const r = predicate(n);
  70| |    if (r !== undefined) result = r;
  71| |  });
  72| |  return result;
  73| |}
  75| |// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  76| |// Context-Usage Detection
  77| |// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  79| |const CONTEXT_METHODS = new Set([
  80| |  "json", "text", "html", "redirect", "stream", "empty", "get", "set",
  81| |]);
  83| |const CONTEXT_PROPS = new Set([
  84| |  "body", "params", "query", "file", "files", "headers", "state", "req", "url",
  85| |  "cookie", "server", "set", "sendFile", "proxy", "forward", "cache",
  86| |]);
  88| |/** Build a map: localVariableName → contextProperty (or "__root__") */
  89|▼|function buildContextMapping(params: any[]): Map<string, string> {
  90| |  const map = new Map<string, string>();
  91| |  for (const param of params) {
  92| |    if (!param) continue;
  93| |    if (param.type === "Identifier") {
  94| |      map.set(param.name, "__root__");
  95| |    } else if (param.type === "ObjectPattern") {
  96| |      for (const prop of param.properties || []) {
  97| |        if (prop.type !== "Property") continue;
  98| |        const key = prop.key?.name ?? prop.key?.value;
  99| |        const local = prop.value?.name ?? prop.value?.value;
 100| |        if (key && local) map.set(local, key);
 101| |        // Nested destructuring not supported for DX simplicity
 102| |      }
 103| |    }
 104| |  }
 105| |  return map;
 106| |}
 108|▼|function detectUsage(bodyNode: any, mapping: Map<string, string>): ContextUsage {
 109| |  const usage: ContextUsage = { ...EMPTY_USAGE };
 110| |  const rootNames = new Set<string>();
 111| |  const aliases = new Map<string, string>();
 113| |  for (const [local, prop] of mapping.entries()) {
 114| |    if (prop === "__root__") rootNames.add(local);
 115| |    else aliases.set(local, prop);
 116| |  }
 118|▼|  const mark = (prop: string | undefined) => {
 119| |    if (!prop) return;
 120| |    if (prop === "body" || prop === "files") usage.body = true;
 121| |    if (prop === "file") usage.file = true;
 122| |    if (prop === "params") usage.params = true;
 123| |    if (prop === "query") usage.query = true;
 124| |    if (prop === "headers") usage.headers = true;
 125| |    if (prop === "state" || prop === "getState" || prop === "setState") usage.state = true;
 126| |    if (prop === "req") usage.req = true;
 127| |    if (prop === "url" || prop === "path" || prop === "method") usage.url = true;
 128| |    if (prop === "cookie") usage.cookie = true;
 129| |    if (prop === "server") usage.server = true;
 130| |    if (prop === "set") usage.set = true;
 131| |    if (prop === "json") usage.json = true;
 132| |    if (prop === "text") usage.text = true;
 133| |    if (prop === "html") usage.html = true;
 134| |    if (prop === "redirect") usage.redirect = true;
 135| |    if (prop === "stream") usage.stream = true;
 136| |    if (prop === "empty") usage.empty = true;
 137| |    if (prop === "status") usage.status = true;
 138| |    if (prop === "sendFile") usage.sendFile = true;
 139| |    if (prop === "proxy") usage.proxy = true;
 140| |    if (prop === "forward") usage.forward = true;
 141| |    if (prop === "cache") usage.cache = true;
 142| |  };
 144| |  walk(bodyNode, (n) => {
 145| |    // Track aliases: const b = ctx.body;
 146| |    if (
 147| |      n.type === "VariableDeclarator" &&
 148| |      n.id?.type === "Identifier" &&
 149| |      n.init?.type === "MemberExpression" &&
 150| |      n.init.object?.type === "Identifier" &&
 151| |      rootNames.has(n.init.object.name)
 152| |    ) {
 153| |      aliases.set(n.id.name, n.init.property?.name);
 154| |    }
 156| |    if (n.type === "MemberExpression" && n.object?.type === "Identifier") {
 157| |      const name = n.object.name;
 158| |      if (rootNames.has(name)) {
 159| |        mark(n.computed ? n.property?.value : n.property?.name);
 160| |      }
 161| |      if (aliases.has(name)) {
 162| |        mark(aliases.get(name));
 163| |      }
 164| |    }
 166| |    if (n.type === "Identifier" && aliases.has(n.name)) {
 167| |      mark(aliases.get(n.name));
 168| |    }
 170| |    // Call expressions: ctx.json(...)
 171| |    if (
 172| |      n.type === "CallExpression" &&
 173| |      n.callee?.type === "MemberExpression" &&
 174| |      n.callee.object?.type === "Identifier"
 175| |    ) {
 176| |      const name = n.callee.object.name;
 177| |      if (rootNames.has(name)) mark(n.callee.property?.name);
 178| |      if (aliases.has(name)) mark(aliases.get(name));
 179| |    }
 180| |  });
 182| |  return usage;
 183| |}
 185| |// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 186| |// Handler Extraction
 187| |// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 189| |const HTTP_WRAPPERS = new Set(["get", "post", "put", "patch", "del", "all"]);
 190|▼|const nodeStart = (node: any): number | undefined =>
 191| |  node?.range?.[0] ?? node?.start ?? node?.span?.[0];
 193|▼|const nodeEnd = (node: any): number | undefined =>
 194| |  node?.range?.[1] ?? node?.end ?? node?.span?.[1];
 196|▼|function extractHandlerFunction(node: any): { fn: any; isAsync: boolean } | null {
 197| |  // export default get(async (ctx) => ...)
 198| |  if (node.type === "CallExpression" && node.callee?.type === "Identifier" && HTTP_WRAPPERS.has(node.callee.name)) {
 199| |    const arg = node.arguments?.[0];
 200| |    if (!arg) return null;
 201| |    if (arg.type === "ArrowFunctionExpression" || arg.type === "FunctionExpression") {
 202| |      return { fn: arg, isAsync: arg.async ?? false };
 203| |    }
 204| |    // export default get(myHandler)
 205| |    if (arg.type === "Identifier") {
 206| |      // We can't inline a referenced handler — return null to signal "imported"
 207| |      return null;
 208| |    }
 209| |  }
 210| |  // export default (ctx) => ...
 211| |  if (node.type === "ArrowFunctionExpression" || node.type === "FunctionExpression") {
 212| |    return { fn: node, isAsync: node.async ?? false };
 213| |  }
 214| |  // export default async function(ctx) { ... }
 215| |  if (node.type === "FunctionDeclaration") {
 216| |    return { fn: node, isAsync: node.async ?? false };
 217| |  }
 218| |  return null;
 219| |}
 221|▼|export interface ExtractedHandler {
 222| |  readonly body: string;        // source slice of function body
 223| |  readonly isAsync: boolean;
 224| |  readonly paramName: string;  // first param identifier name (or "ctx" fallback)
 225| |  readonly usage: ContextUsage;
 226| |}
 228|▼|export function extractHandler(source: string, ast: any): ExtractedHandler | null {
 229| |  const defaultExport = walkUntil<any>(ast, (n) =>
 230| |    n.type === "ExportDefaultDeclaration" ? n : undefined
 231| |  );
 233| |  if (!defaultExport) return null;
 235| |  const extracted = extractHandlerFunction(defaultExport.declaration);
 236| |  if (!extracted) return null;
 238| |  const { fn, isAsync } = extracted;
 239| |  const params = fn.params || [];
 240| |  const mapping = buildContextMapping(params);
 241| |  const rootParam = params[0]?.type === "Identifier" ? params[0].name : "ctx";
 243| |  let bodyText = "";
 244| |  const body = fn.body;
 246| |  if (body) {
 247| |    const start = nodeStart(body);
 248| |    const end = nodeEnd(body);
 250| |    if (start != null && end != null) {
 251| |      if (body.type === "BlockStatement") {
 252| |        bodyText = source.slice(start + 1, end - 1).trim();
 253| |      } else {
 254| |        bodyText = `return ${source.slice(start, end).trim()};`;
 255| |      }
 256| |    }
 257| |  }
 259| |  const usage = detectUsage(body || fn, mapping);
 261| |  return {
 262| |    body: bodyText,
 263| |    isAsync,
 264| |    paramName: rootParam,
 265| |    usage,
 266| |  };
 267| |}
 268| |// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 269| |// Import / Export / Symbol Extraction (AST-based, zero regex)
 270| |// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 272|▼|export function extractImportsAST(ast: any): ImportInfo[] {
 273| |  const imports: ImportInfo[] = [];
 275| |  walk(ast, (n) => {
 276| |    if (n.type !== "ImportDeclaration") return;
 278| |    const source = n.source?.value as string;
 279| |    if (!source) return;
 281| |    const names: string[] = [];
 282| |    let defaultName: string | undefined;
 283| |    let namespaceName: string | undefined;
 285| |    for (const spec of n.specifiers || []) {
 286| |      if (spec.type === "ImportDefaultSpecifier") defaultName = spec.local.name;
 287| |      if (spec.type === "ImportNamespaceSpecifier") namespaceName = spec.local.name;
 288| |      if (spec.type === "ImportSpecifier") names.push(spec.local.name);
 289| |    }
 291| |    imports.push(createImportInfo(source, names, defaultName, namespaceName));
 292| |  });
 294| |  return imports;
 295| |}
 297|▼|export function extractExportsAST(ast: any): ExportInfo[] {
 298| |  const exports: ExportInfo[] = [];
 299| |  walk(ast, (n) => {
 300| |    if (n.type === "ExportDefaultDeclaration") {
 301| |      const name = n.declaration?.name || "default";
 302| |      exports.push({ name, kind: "default" });
 303| |    }
 304| |    if (n.type === "ExportNamedDeclaration") {
 305| |      for (const spec of n.specifiers || []) {
 306| |        if (spec.type === "ExportSpecifier") {
 307| |          exports.push({ name: spec.local.name, kind: "named" });
 308| |        }
 309| |      }
 310| |      for (const decl of n.declaration ? [n.declaration] : []) {
 311| |        if (decl.type === "FunctionDeclaration" || decl.type === "VariableDeclaration") {
 312| |          const id = decl.id || decl.declarations?.[0]?.id;
 313| |          if (id?.name) exports.push({ name: id.name, kind: "named" });
 314| |        }
 315| |      }
 316| |    }
 317| |  });
 318| |  return exports;
 319| |}
 321|▼|function posFromNode(source: string, node: any): Position {
 322| |  if (node.loc) return { line: node.loc.start.line, column: node.loc.start.column };
 323| |  return { line: 0, column: 0 };
 324| |}
 326|▼|export function extractSymbolsAST(source: string, ast: any): SymbolInfo[] {
 327| |  const symbols: SymbolInfo[] = [];
 328| |  walk(ast, (n) => {
 329| |    if (n.type === "FunctionDeclaration" && n.id?.name) {
 330| |      symbols.push({
 331| |        name: n.id.name,
 332| |        kind: "function",
 333| |        pos: posFromNode(source, n),
 334| |        isAsync: n.async ?? false,
 335| |        isDefaultExport: false,
 336| |        params: (n.params || []).map((p: any) => p.name || "..."),
 337| |        decorators: [],
 338| |        calls: [],
 339| |        calledBy: [],
 340| |        size: n.range ? n.range[1] - n.range[0] : 9999,
 341| |        hotness: 0,
 342| |      });
 343| |    }
 344| |    if (n.type === "VariableDeclaration") {
 345| |      for (const decl of n.declarations || []) {
 346| |        if (decl.id?.name && decl.init?.type === "ArrowFunctionExpression") {
 347| |          symbols.push({
 348| |            name: decl.id.name,
 349| |            kind: "const",
 350| |            pos: posFromNode(source, n),
 351| |            isAsync: decl.init.async ?? false,
 352| |            isDefaultExport: false,
 353| |            params: (decl.init.params || []).map((p: any) => p.name || "..."),
 354| |            decorators: [],
 355| |            calls: [],
 356| |            calledBy: [],
 357| |            size: n.range ? n.range[1] - n.range[0] : 9999,
 358| |            hotness: 0,
 359| |          });
 360| |        }
 361| |      }
 362| |    }
 363| |  });
 364| |  return symbols;
 365| |}
 367|▼|export function hasDefaultExportAST(ast: any): boolean {
 368| |  return walkUntil(ast, (n) => (n.type === "ExportDefaultDeclaration" ? true : undefined)) ?? false;
 369| |}
 371|▼|export function hasSchemaExportAST(ast: any): boolean {
 372| |  let found = false;
 373| |  walk(ast, (n) => {
 374| |    if (n.type === "ExportNamedDeclaration" && n.declaration?.type === "VariableDeclaration") {
 375| |      for (const d of n.declaration.declarations || []) {
 376| |        if (d.id?.name === "schema") found = true;
 377| |      }
 378| |    }
 379| |    if (n.type === "ExportSpecifier" && n.local?.name === "schema") found = true;
 381| |    // Schema-first HTTP: export default get(handler, { ... })
 382| |    if (
 383| |      n.type === "ExportDefaultDeclaration" &&
 384| |      n.declaration?.type === "CallExpression" &&
 385| |      n.declaration.callee?.type === "Identifier" &&
 386| |      HTTP_WRAPPERS.has(n.declaration.callee.name)
 387| |    ) {
 388| |      const args = n.declaration.arguments || [];
 389| |      const schemaArg = args[1];
 391| |      if (
 392| |        schemaArg &&
 393| |        schemaArg.type !== "Literal" &&
 394| |        schemaArg.type !== "StringLiteral" &&
 395| |        schemaArg.type !== "TemplateLiteral"
 396| |      ) {
 397| |        found = true;
 398| |      }
 399| |    }
 400| |  });
 401| |  return found;
 402| |}
 404|▼|export function hasConfigExportAST(ast: any): boolean {
 405| |  let found = false;
 406| |  walk(ast, (n) => {
 407| |    if (n.type === "ExportNamedDeclaration" && n.declaration?.type === "VariableDeclaration") {
 408| |      for (const d of n.declaration.declarations || []) {
 409| |        if (d.id?.name === "config") found = true;
 410| |      }
 411| |    }
 412| |    if (n.type === "ExportSpecifier" && n.local?.name === "config") found = true;
 413| |  });
 414| |  return found;
 415| |}
 417| |// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 418| |// Purity Analysis (AST-based)
 419| |// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 421| |const IMPURE_GLOBALS = new Set([
 422| |  "fetch", "Date", "Math", "console", "process", "crypto",
 423| |  "setTimeout", "setInterval", "clearTimeout", "clearInterval",
 424| |  "Promise", "Map", "Set", "WeakMap", "WeakSet",
 425| |]);
 427| |const IMPURE_CALLS = new Set([
 428| |  "Math.random", "Date.now", "crypto.randomUUID", "crypto.getRandomValues",
 429| |  "console.log", "console.warn", "console.error", "fetch",
 430| |]);
 432|▼|export function isPureBodyAST(ast: any): boolean {
 433| |  let impure = false;
 434| |  walk(ast, (n) => {
 435| |    if (impure) return;
 436| |    // new Date(), new Map(), etc.
 437| |    if (n.type === "NewExpression" && n.callee?.type === "Identifier" && IMPURE_GLOBALS.has(n.callee.name)) {
 438| |      impure = true;
 439| |    }
 440| |    // fetch(), Math.random(), etc.
 441| |    if (n.type === "CallExpression") {
 442| |      const callee = n.callee;
 443| |      if (callee.type === "Identifier" && IMPURE_GLOBALS.has(callee.name)) {
 444| |        impure = true;
 445| |      }
 446| |      if (callee.type === "MemberExpression") {
 447| |        const chain = flattenMember(callee);
 448| |        if (chain && IMPURE_CALLS.has(chain)) impure = true;
 449| |      }
 450| |    }
 451| |    // await
 452| |    if (n.type === "AwaitExpression") {
 453| |      // Conservative: any await is impure (could be DB, fetch, etc.)
 454| |      impure = true;
 455| |    }
 456| |  });
 457| |  return !impure;
 458| |}
 459| |// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 460| |// Safe Constant Evaluator (replaces new Function)
 461| |// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 463|▼|type ConstResult = { ok: true; value: unknown } | { ok: false };
 464| |const constFail: ConstResult = { ok: false };
 466|▼|export function evaluateConstantNode(node: any): ConstResult {
 467| |  if (!node) return constFail;
 468| |  switch (node.type) {
 469| |    case "Literal":
 470| |    case "StringLiteral":
 471| |    case "NumericLiteral":
 472| |    case "BooleanLiteral":
 473| |    case "NullLiteral":
 474| |      return { ok: true, value: node.value };
 475| |    case "Identifier":
 476| |      return node.name === "undefined" ? { ok: true, value: undefined } : constFail;
 477| |    case "TemplateLiteral":
 478| |      if (node.expressions?.length) return constFail;
 479| |      return { ok: true, value: node.quasis?.map((q: any) => q.value?.cooked ?? q.value?.raw ?? "").join("") };
 480| |    case "UnaryExpression": {
 481| |      const arg = evaluateConstantNode(node.argument);
 482| |      if (!arg.ok) return constFail;
 483| |      if (node.operator === "-") return { ok: true, value: -(arg.value as number) };
 484| |      if (node.operator === "+") return { ok: true, value: +(arg.value as number) };
 485| |      if (node.operator === "!") return { ok: true, value: !arg.value };
 486| |      return constFail;
 487| |    }
 488| |    case "ArrayExpression": {
 489| |      const vals: unknown[] = [];
 490| |      for (const el of node.elements ?? []) {
 491| |        if (!el || el.type === "SpreadElement") return constFail;
 492| |        const r = evaluateConstantNode(el);
 493| |        if (!r.ok) return constFail;
 494| |        vals.push(r.value);
 495| |      }
 496| |      return { ok: true, value: vals };
 497| |    }
 498| |    case "ObjectExpression": {
 499| |      const obj: Record<string, unknown> = {};
 500| |      for (const p of node.properties ?? []) {
 501| |        if (p.type !== "Property" || p.computed || p.kind !== "init") return constFail;
 502| |        const k = p.key?.type === "Identifier" ? p.key.name : p.key?.value;
 503| |        if (typeof k !== "string" && typeof k !== "number") return constFail;
 504| |        const v = evaluateConstantNode(p.value);
 505| |        if (!v.ok) return constFail;
 506| |        obj[String(k)] = v.value;
 507| |      }
 508| |      return { ok: true, value: obj };
 509| |    }
 510| |    default:
 511| |      return constFail;
 512| |  }
 513| |}
 515|▼|export function extractConstantReturn(ast: any): ConstResult {
 516| |  const ret = walkUntil<any>(ast, (n) => n.type === "ReturnStatement" ? n : undefined);
 517| |  if (!ret?.argument) return { ok: true, value: undefined };
 518| |  return evaluateConstantNode(ret.argument);
 519| |}
 521|▼|function flattenMember(node: any): string | null {
 522| |  if (node.type === "Identifier") return node.name;
 523| |  if (node.type === "MemberExpression" && !node.computed) {
 524| |    const obj = flattenMember(node.object);
 525| |    const prop = node.property?.name;
 526| |    if (obj && prop) return `${obj}.${prop}`;
 527| |  }
 528| |  return null;
 529| |}
 531| |// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 532| |// Response-Type Inference (AST-based)
 533| |// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 535|▼|export function inferResponseTypeAST(ast: any): "json" | "text" | "html" | "stream" | "unknown" {
 536| |  let type: "json" | "text" | "html" | "stream" | "unknown" = "unknown";
 537| |  walk(ast, (n) => {
 538| |    if (n.type === "CallExpression" && n.callee?.type === "MemberExpression") {
 539| |      const chain = flattenMember(n.callee);
 540| |      if (chain === "ctx.json") type = "json";
 541| |      if (chain === "ctx.text") type = "text";
 542| |      if (chain === "ctx.html") type = "html";
 543| |      if (chain === "ctx.stream") type = "stream";
 544| |    }
 545| |    // Heuristic: return "string" or template literal → text
 546| |    if (n.type === "ReturnStatement" && n.argument?.type === "Literal" && typeof n.argument.value === "string") {
 547| |      if (type === "unknown") type = "text";
 548| |    }
 549| |  });
 550| |  return type;
 551| |}

 561| |  readonly symbols: SymbolInfo[];
 562| |  readonly hasDefaultExport: boolean;

---
   1| |/**
   2| | * @fileoverview HTTP caching primitives:
   3| | * - Cache-Control builder
   4| | * - ETag generation
   5| | * - mtime-based cache bursting
   6| | * - browser conditional requests
   7| | * - LRU-backed HTTP response cache
   8| | */
  10| |import { LRUCache } from "./lru";
  12|▼|export interface CacheControlOptions {
  13| |  maxAge?: number;
  14| |  sMaxAge?: number;
  15| |  swr?: number; // stale-while-revalidate seconds
  16| |  immutable?: boolean;
  17| |  noStore?: boolean;
  18| |  noCache?: boolean;
  19| |  public?: boolean;
  20| |  private?: boolean;
  21| |}
  23| |export interface BrowserCacheOptions extends CacheControlOptions {
  24| |  req?: Request;
  25| |  etag?: string;
  26| |  lastModified?: Date | string;
  27| |  vary?: string[];
  28| |}
  30|▼|export function cacheControl(opts: CacheControlOptions = {}): string {
  31| |  if (opts.noStore) return "no-store";
  32| |  if (opts.noCache) return "no-cache";
  34| |  const parts: string[] = [];
  36| |  if (opts.public) parts.push("public");
  37| |  if (opts.private) parts.push("private");
  39| |  if (opts.maxAge != null) {
  40| |    parts.push(`max-age=${Math.max(0, Math.floor(opts.maxAge))}`);
  41| |  }
  43| |  if (opts.swr != null) {
  44| |    parts.push(`stale-while-revalidate=${Math.max(0, Math.floor(opts.swr))}`);
  45| |  }
  47| |  if (opts.sMaxAge != null) {
  48| |    parts.push(`s-maxage=${Math.max(0, Math.floor(opts.sMaxAge))}`);
  49| |  }
  51| |  if (opts.immutable) parts.push("immutable");
  53| |  return parts.length > 0 ? parts.join(", ") : "no-cache";
  54| |}
  56|▼|function toBytes(input: string | ArrayBuffer | Uint8Array): Uint8Array {
  57| |  if (typeof input === "string") return new TextEncoder().encode(input);
  58| |  if (input instanceof Uint8Array) return input;
  59| |  return new Uint8Array(input);
  60| |}
  62|▼|function fallbackHash(bytes: Uint8Array): bigint {
  63| |  let h = 0xcbf29ce484222325n;
  65| |  for (const b of bytes) {
  66| |    h ^= BigInt(b);
  67| |    h = (h * 0x100000001b3n) & 0xffffffffffffffffn;
  68| |  }
  70| |  return h;
  71| |}
  73| |/**
  74| | * Fast non-cryptographic hash for cache keys and weak ETags.
  75| | * Uses Bun.hash when available.
  76| | */
  77|▼|export function fastHash(input: string | ArrayBuffer | Uint8Array): string {
  78| |  const bytes = toBytes(input);
  80| |  const bunHash = (Bun as any).hash;
  81| |  if (typeof bunHash === "function") {
  82| |    const h = bunHash(bytes);
  83| |    return (typeof h === "bigint" ? h : BigInt(h)).toString(36);
  84| |  }
  86| |  return fallbackHash(bytes).toString(36);
  87| |}
  89|▼|export function entityTag(
  90| |  body: string | ArrayBuffer | Uint8Array,
  91| |  weak = true
  92| |): string {
  93| |  return `${weak ? "W/" : ""}"${fastHash(body)}"`;
  94| |}
  96| |/**
  97| | * mtime-based cache burst version.
  98| | *
  99| | * Example:
 100| | *   mtimeVersion(stats.mtimeMs, stats.size)
 101| | *   => "m4k2j1-1a2b"
 102| | */
 103|▼|export function mtimeVersion(mtimeMs: number, size?: number): string {
 104| |  const mtime = Math.floor(mtimeMs).toString(36);
 105| |  return size ? `${mtime}-${size.toString(36)}` : mtime;
 106| |}
 108| |/**
 109| | * Append a cache-busting version to a URL.
 110| | */
 111|▼|export function withCacheBurst(url: string, version: string): string {
 112| |  const sep = url.includes("?") ? "&" : "?";
 113| |  return `${url}${sep}v=${encodeURIComponent(version)}`;
 114| |}
 116| |/**
 117| | * Apply browser cache headers and handle conditional requests.
 118| | */
 119|▼|export function withBrowserCache(
 120| |  response: Response,
 121| |  opts: BrowserCacheOptions = {}
 122| |): Response {
 123| |  const headers = new Headers(response.headers);
 125| |  if (opts.etag) headers.set("etag", opts.etag);
 127| |  const lastModified =
 128| |    opts.lastModified instanceof Date
 129| |      ? opts.lastModified.toUTCString()
 130| |      : opts.lastModified;
 132| |  if (lastModified) headers.set("last-modified", lastModified);
 134| |  if (!headers.has("cache-control")) {
 135| |    headers.set("cache-control", cacheControl(opts));
 136| |  }
 138| |  if (opts.vary?.length) {
 139| |    headers.set("vary", opts.vary.join(", "));
 140| |  }
 142| |  if (opts.req && response.status !== 304) {
 143| |    const inm = opts.req.headers.get("if-none-match");
 144| |    const ims = opts.req.headers.get("if-modified-since");
 146| |    const etagMatch =
 147| |      opts.etag && inm
 148| |        ? inm
 149| |            .split(",")
 150| |            .map((s) => s.trim())
 151| |            .includes(opts.etag)
 152| |        : false;
 154| |    const lastModifiedMatch =
 155| |      lastModified && ims
 156| |        ? new Date(ims).getTime() >= new Date(lastModified).getTime()
 157| |        : false;
 159| |    if (etagMatch || lastModifiedMatch) {
 160| |      return new Response(null, { status: 304, headers });
 161| |    }
 162| |  }
 164| |  return new Response(response.body, {
 165| |    status: response.status,
 166| |    statusText: response.statusText,
 167| |    headers,
 168| |  });
 169| |}
 171| |// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 172| |// HTTP response cache
 173| |// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 175|▼|export interface HttpResponseCacheOptions {
 176| |  max?: number;
 177| |  ttlMs?: number;
 178| |  staleTtlMs?: number;
 179| |  maxBytes?: number;
 180| |  maxBodyBytes?: number;
 181| |}
 183|▼|export interface CachedHttpResponse {
 184| |  status: number;
 185| |  statusText: string;
 186| |  headers: [string, string][];
 187| |  body: ArrayBuffer | null;
 188| |  etag?: string;
 189| |}
 191| |const HOP_HEADERS = new Set([
 192| |  "connection",
 193| |  "keep-alive",
 194| |  "proxy-authenticate",
 195| |  "proxy-authorization",
 196| |  "te",
 197| |  "trailer",
 198| |  "transfer-encoding",
 199| |  "upgrade",
 200| |  "content-length",
 201| |]);
 203|▼|function sanitizeHeaders(headers: Headers): [string, string][] {
 204| |  const out: [string, string][] = [];
 206| |  headers.forEach((value, key) => {
 207| |    const lower = key.toLowerCase();
 208| |    if (!HOP_HEADERS.has(lower)) {
 209| |      out.push([key, value]);
 210| |    }
 211| |  });
 213| |  return out;
 214| |}
 216|▼|function isCacheableResponse(response: Response): boolean {
 217| |  if (response.headers.has("set-cookie")) return false;
 219| |  const cc = response.headers.get("cache-control") || "";
 220| |  if (cc.includes("no-store")) return false;
 221| |  if (cc.includes("private")) return false;
 223| |  return [200, 203, 204, 300, 301, 404, 410].includes(response.status);
 224| |}
 226|▼|export class HttpResponseCache {
 227| |  private lru: LRUCache<string, CachedHttpResponse>;
 228| |  private maxBodyBytes: number;
 230| |  constructor(opts: HttpResponseCacheOptions = {}) {
 231| |    this.maxBodyBytes = opts.maxBodyBytes ?? 1_048_576;
 233| |    this.lru = new LRUCache({
 234| |      max: opts.max ?? 1000,
 235| |      ttlMs: opts.ttlMs ?? 60_000,
 236| |      staleTtlMs: opts.staleTtlMs ?? 300_000,
 237| |      maxBytes: opts.maxBytes ?? 64 * 1024 * 1024,
 238| |      sizeOf: (v) => (v.body?.byteLength ?? 0) + 512,
 239| |    });
 240| |  }
 242| |  key(req: Request, vary: string[] = []): string {
 243| |    const url = new URL(req.url);
 245| |    const varyKey = vary
 246| |      .map((h) => `${h.toLowerCase()}=${req.headers.get(h) ?? ""}`)
 247| |      .join("|");
 249| |    return `${req.method}:${url.pathname}${url.search}:${varyKey}`;
 250| |  }
 252| |  async get(req: Request, key: string): Promise<Response | null> {
 253| |    const stored = this.lru.get(key, { allowStale: true });
 254| |    if (!stored) return null;
 256| |    const inm = req.headers.get("if-none-match");
 258| |    if (
 259| |      stored.etag &&
 260| |      inm &&
 261| |      inm
 262| |        .split(",")
 263| |        .map((s) => s.trim())
 264| |        .includes(stored.etag)
 265| |    ) {
 266| |      return new Response(null, {
 267| |        status: 304,
 268| |        headers: stored.headers,
 269| |      });
 270| |    }
 272| |    const headers = new Headers(stored.headers);
 273| |    headers.set("x-cache", "hit");
 275| |    return new Response(stored.body ? stored.body.slice(0) : null, {
 276| |      status: stored.status,
 277| |      statusText: stored.statusText,
 278| |      headers,
 279| |    });
 280| |  }
 282| |  async set(
 283| |    key: string,
 284| |    response: Response,
 285| |    opts: { ttlMs?: number; staleTtlMs?: number; etag?: boolean } = {},
 286| |  ): Promise<Response> {
 287| |    if (!isCacheableResponse(response)) return response;
 289| |    const clone = response.clone();
 290| |    const body = await clone.arrayBuffer();
 292| |    if (body.byteLength > this.maxBodyBytes) {
 293| |      return response;
 294| |    }
 296| |    const headers = sanitizeHeaders(response.headers);
 297| |    const etag = opts.etag === false ? undefined : entityTag(body);
 299| |    if (etag) {
 300| |      headers.push(["etag", etag]);
 301| |    }
 303| |    const cached: CachedHttpResponse = {
 304| |      status: response.status,
 305| |      statusText: response.statusText,
 306| |      headers,
 307| |      body,
 308| |    };
 310| |    if (etag) {
 311| |      cached.etag = etag;
 312| |    }
 314| |    this.lru.set(key, cached, {
 315| |      ...(opts.ttlMs !== undefined ? { ttlMs: opts.ttlMs } : {}),
 316| |      ...(opts.staleTtlMs !== undefined ? { staleTtlMs: opts.staleTtlMs } : {}),
 317| |    });
 319| |    return response;
 320| |  }
 322| |  async getOrSet(
 323| |    req: Request,
 324| |    factory: () => Promise<Response>,
 325| |    opts: {
 326| |      ttlMs?: number;
 327| |      staleTtlMs?: number;
 328| |      vary?: string[];
 329| |      etag?: boolean;
 330| |    } = {}
 331| |  ): Promise<Response> {
 332| |    if (req.method !== "GET" && req.method !== "HEAD") {
 333| |      return factory();
 334| |    }
 336| |    const reqCc = req.headers.get("cache-control") || "";
 337| |    if (reqCc.includes("no-store")) {
 338| |      return factory();
 339| |    }
 341| |    const key = this.key(req, opts.vary);
 342| |    const hit = await this.get(req, key);
 344| |    if (hit) return hit;
 346| |    const response = await factory();
 347| |    return this.set(key, response, opts);
 348| |  }
 349| |}

   1| |/**
   2| | * @fileoverview OpenAPI 3.1 Specification Generator.
   3| | * Auto-generates docs from route definitions.
   4| | */
   6| |import type { RouteSchema, DocumentDecoration, HttpMethod } from "./types";
   8|▼|export interface OpenAPIInfo {
   9| |    title: string;
  10| |    version: string;
  11| |    description?: string;
  12| |}
  14|▼|export interface RouteDefinition {
  15| |    method: HttpMethod;
  16| |    path: string;
  17| |    schema?: RouteSchema;
  18| |    detail?: DocumentDecoration;
  19| |}
  21|▼|export const generateOpenAPI = (
  22| |    info: OpenAPIInfo,
  23| |    routes: RouteDefinition[]
  24| |): Record<string, unknown> => {
  25| |    const paths: Record<string, Record<string, unknown>> = {};
  27| |    for (const route of routes) {
  28| |        if (route.method === "ALL" || route.method === "WS") continue;
  30| |        const openApiPath = route.path
  31| |            .replace(/:(\w+)/g, "{$1}")
  32| |            .replace(/\*(\w+)/g, "{$1}");
  34| |        if (!paths[openApiPath]) paths[openApiPath] = {};
  36| |        const operation: Record<string, unknown> = {
  37| |            operationId: `${route.method.toLowerCase()}_${openApiPath.replace(/[{}\/]/g, "_")}`,
  38| |            ...route.detail,
  39| |            responses: { "200": { description: "Successful response" } },
  40| |        };
  42| |        if (route.schema?.params) {
  43| |            const schema = route.schema.params as any;
  44| |            const required = new Set(schema.required ?? []);
  46| |            operation.parameters = Object.entries(schema.properties ?? {}).map(
  47| |                ([name, propSchema]: [string, any]) => ({
  48| |                    name,
  49| |                    in: "path",
  50| |                    required: required.has(name),
  51| |                    schema: {
  52| |                        type: propSchema.type ?? "string",
  53| |                        ...(propSchema.format ? { format: propSchema.format } : {}),
  54| |                        ...(propSchema.enum ? { enum: propSchema.enum } : {}),
  55| |                    },
  56| |                })
  57| |            );
  58| |        }
  60| |        if (route.schema?.query) {
  61| |            const schema = route.schema.query as any;
  62| |            const required = new Set(schema.required ?? []);
  64| |            const queryParams = Object.entries(schema.properties ?? {}).map(
  65| |                ([name, propSchema]: [string, any]) => ({
  66| |                    name,
  67| |                    in: "query",
  68| |                    required: required.has(name),
  69| |                    schema: {
  70| |                        type: propSchema.type ?? "string",
  71| |                        ...(propSchema.format ? { format: propSchema.format } : {}),
  72| |                        ...(propSchema.enum ? { enum: propSchema.enum } : {}),
  73| |                        ...(propSchema.default !== undefined
  74| |                            ? { default: propSchema.default }
  75| |                            : {}),
  76| |                    },
  77| |                })
  78| |            );
  80| |            operation.parameters = [
  81| |                ...((operation.parameters as any[]) ?? []),
  82| |                ...queryParams,
  83| |            ];
  85| |        }
  87| |        if (route.schema?.body) {
  88| |            operation.requestBody = {
  89| |                content: { "application/json": { schema: route.schema.body } },
  90| |            };
  91| |        }
  93| |        paths[openApiPath][route.method.toLowerCase()] = operation;
  94| |    }
  96| |    return {
  97| |        openapi: "3.1.0",
  98| |        info,
  99| |        paths,
 100| |    };
 101| |};

   1| |/**
   2| | * Runtime schema validation.
   3| | *
   4| | * Bun 1.4 edition:
   5| | * - TypeBox / JSON Schema via Ajv
   6| | * - Standard Schema v1 via async validation
   7| | * - compiled validator cache
   8| | */
  10| |import Ajv, { type ErrorObject } from "ajv";
  11| |import addFormats from "ajv-formats";
  12| |import type { AnySchema, StandardSchemaV1 } from "./types";
  13| |import { ValidationError } from "./errors";
  15| |const ajv = new Ajv({
  16| |  allErrors: true,
  17| |  strict: false,
  18| |  coerceTypes: true,
  19| |  removeAdditional: true,
  20| |  useDefaults: true,
  21| |});
  23| |addFormats(ajv);
  25| |const compiledCache = new WeakMap<object, (input: unknown) => unknown>();
  27|▼|function isStandardSchema(schema: AnySchema): schema is StandardSchemaV1 {
  28| |  return typeof schema === "object" && schema !== null && "~standard" in schema;
  29| |}
  31|▼|function toErrorRecord(
  32| |  errors: ErrorObject[] | null | undefined,
  33| |  on: string
  34| |): Record<string, string[]> {
  35| |  const out: Record<string, string[]> = {};
  37| |  for (const e of errors ?? []) {
  38| |    const path =
  39| |      e.instancePath?.replace(/^\//, "").replace(/\//g, ".") ||
  40| |      (e.params as any)?.missingProperty ||
  41| |      on;
  43| |    out[path] ??= [];
  44| |    out[path].push(e.message ?? "Invalid value");
  45| |  }
  47| |  return out;
  48| |}
  50|▼|export function compileValidator<T = unknown>(
  51| |  schema: AnySchema,
  52| |  on: string = "input"
  53| |) {
  54| |  if (isStandardSchema(schema)) {
  55| |    return (_input: unknown): T => {
  56|!|      throw new Error(
  57| |        "Standard Schema validators are async. Use validateAsync() instead of compileValidator()."
  58| |      );
  59| |    };
  60| |  }
  62| |  const schemaKey = schema as object;
  64| |  let validator = compiledCache.get(schemaKey);
  66| |  if (!validator) {
  67| |    const validate = ajv.compile(schema as object);
  69| |    validator = (input: unknown): unknown => {
  70| |      if (!validate(input)) {
  71|!|        throw new ValidationError(
  72| |          "Validation failed",
  73| |          toErrorRecord(validate.errors, on),
  74| |          on
  75| |        );
  76| |      }
  78| |      return input;
  79| |    };
  81| |    compiledCache.set(schemaKey, validator);
  82| |  }
  84| |  return validator as (input: unknown) => T;
  85| |}
  87|▼|export function validateOrThrow<T = unknown>(
  88| |  schema: AnySchema,
  89| |  input: unknown,
  90| |  on: string = "input"
  91| |): T {
  92| |  return compileValidator<T>(schema, on)(input);
  93| |}
  95|▼|export async function validateAsync<T = unknown>(
  96| |  schema: AnySchema,
  97| |  input: unknown,
  98| |  on: string = "input"
  99| |): Promise<T> {
 100| |  if (isStandardSchema(schema)) {
 101| |    const result = await schema["~standard"].validate(input);
 103| |    if ("issues" in result) {
 104| |      const errors: Record<string, string[]> = {};
 106| |      for (const issue of result.issues) {
 107| |        const path = issue.path?.join(".") || on;
 108| |        errors[path] ??= [];
 109| |        errors[path].push(issue.message);
 110| |      }
 112|!|      throw new ValidationError("Validation failed", errors, on);
 113| |    }
 115| |    return result.value as T;
 116| |  }
 118| |  return compileValidator<T>(schema, on)(input);
 119| |}

  34|▼|type Readline = ReturnType<typeof createInterface>;
  36|▼|export async function runCreate(args: string[]): Promise<void> {
  37| |  const { values, positionals } = parseArgs({
  38| |    args,
  39| |    options: {
  40| |      name: { type: "string" },
  41| |      runtime: { type: "string" },
  42| |      pm: { type: "string" },
  43| |      features: { type: "string" },
  44| |      install: { type: "boolean" },
  45| |      git: { type: "boolean" },
  46| |      yes: { type: "boolean" },
  47| |      force: { type: "boolean" },
  48| |    },
  49| |    allowPositionals: true,
  50| |    strict: false,
  51| |  });
  53| |  const interactive = Boolean(process.stdin.isTTY && !values.yes);
  55| |  let name = positionals[0] ?? (values.name as string | undefined);
  56| |  let runtimeInput = values.runtime as string | undefined;
  57| |  let pmInput = values.pm as string | undefined;
  58| |  let featuresInput = values.features as string | undefined;
  59| |  let install = values.install as boolean | undefined;
  60| |  let git = values.git as boolean | undefined;
  62| |  if (interactive) {
  63| |    const rl = createInterface({
  64| |      input: process.stdin,
  65| |      output: process.stdout,
  66| |    });
  68| |    try {
  69| |      if (!name) {
  70| |        name = await ask(rl, "Project name", "flux-app");
  71| |      }
  73| |      if (!runtimeInput) {
  74| |        runtimeInput = await ask(rl, "Runtime (bun/node)", "bun");
  75| |      }
  77| |      if (!pmInput) {
  78| |        pmInput = await ask(
  79| |          rl,
  80| |          "Package manager (bun/npm/pnpm/yarn)",
  81| |          runtimeInput === "node" ? "npm" : "bun",
  82| |        );
  83| |      }
  85| |      if (!featuresInput) {
  86| |        featuresInput = await ask(
  87| |          rl,
  88| |          "Features (all, none, or comma-separated)",
  89| |          "openapi,examples,tests",
  90| |        );
  91| |      }
  93| |      if (install === undefined) {
  94| |        install = await askConfirm(rl, "Install dependencies?", true);
  95| |      }
  97| |      if (git === undefined) {
  98| |        git = await askConfirm(rl, "Initialize git?", true);
  99| |      }
 100| |    } finally {
 101| |      rl.close();
 102| |    }
 103| |  }
 105| |  name = name ?? "flux-app";
 107| |  const runtime = normalizeRuntime(runtimeInput);
 108| |  const pm = normalizePm(pmInput, runtime);
 110| |  const features = parseFeatures(
 111| |    featuresInput ?? (values.yes ? "openapi,examples,tests" : "none"),
 112| |  );
 114| |  install = install ?? false;
 115| |  git = git ?? false;
 117| |  const target = resolve(process.cwd(), name);
 119| |  if (await exists(target)) {
 120| |    if (!(await isDirEmpty(target)) && !values.force) {
 121| |      error(`${name} already exists and is not empty. Use --force to overwrite.`);
 122| |      process.exitCode = 1;
 123| |      return;
 124| |    }
 125| |  }
 127| |  step(`Scaffolding ${name}`);
 129| |  const opts = {
 130| |    name,
 131| |    runtime,
 132| |    pm,
 133| |    features,
 134| |  };
 136| |  await writeFileEnsuringDir(join(target, "package.json"), packageJsonTemplate(opts));
 137| |  await writeFileEnsuringDir(join(target, "tsconfig.json"), tsconfigTemplate(opts));
 138| |  await writeFileEnsuringDir(join(target, "flux.config.mjs"), fluxConfigTemplate());
 139| |  await writeFileEnsuringDir(join(target, "biome.json"), biomeTemplate());
 140| |  await writeFileEnsuringDir(join(target, ".gitignore"), gitignoreTemplate());
 141| |  await writeFileEnsuringDir(join(target, "README.md"), readmeTemplate(opts));
 143| |  await writeFileEnsuringDir(
 144| |    join(target, "src/routes/index.get.ts"),
 145| |    indexRouteTemplate(name),
 146| |  );
 148| |  await writeFileEnsuringDir(
 149| |    join(target, "src/routes/health.get.ts"),
 150| |    healthRouteTemplate(),
 151| |  );
 153| |  await writeFileEnsuringDir(
 154| |    join(target, "src/hooks/README.md"),
 155| |    `# Hooks
 157| |Place shared hooks here.
 158| |`,
 159| |  );
 161| |  if (features.has("openapi")) {
 162| |    await writeFileEnsuringDir(
 163| |      join(target, "src/routes/openapi.json.get.ts"),
 164| |      openApiRouteTemplate(name),
 165| |    );
 166| |  }
 168| |  if (features.has("examples")) {
 169| |    await writeFileEnsuringDir(
 170| |      join(target, "src/routes/products/[id].get.ts"),
 171| |      productByIdRouteTemplate(),
 172| |    );
 174| |    await writeFileEnsuringDir(
 175| |      join(target, "src/routes/products/add.post.ts"),
 176| |      productAddRouteTemplate(),
 177| |    );
 178| |  }
 180| |  if (features.has("files")) {
 181| |    await writeFileEnsuringDir(
 182| |      join(target, "src/routes/upload.post.ts"),
 183| |      uploadRouteTemplate(),
 184| |    );
 185| |  }
 187| |  if (features.has("sse")) {
 188| |    await writeFileEnsuringDir(
 189| |      join(target, "src/routes/events.get.ts"),
 190| |      sseRouteTemplate(),
 191| |    );
 192| |  }
 194| |  if (features.has("cache")) {
 195| |    await writeFileEnsuringDir(
 196| |      join(target, "src/routes/cached.get.ts"),
 197| |      cacheRouteTemplate(),
 198| |    );
 199| |  }
 201| |  if (features.has("proxy")) {
 202| |    await writeFileEnsuringDir(
 203| |      join(target, "src/routes/proxy.get.ts"),
 204| |      proxyRouteTemplate(),
 205| |    );
 206| |  }
 208| |  if (hasPluginFeatures(features)) {
 209| |    await writeFileEnsuringDir(
 210| |      join(target, "src/plugins/index.ts"),
 211| |      pluginsTemplate(opts),
 212| |    );
 213| |  }
 215| |  if (features.has("ws")) {
 216| |    await writeFileEnsuringDir(join(target, "src/ws.example.ts"), wsExampleTemplate());
 217| |  }
 219| |  if (features.has("cluster")) {
 220| |    await writeFileEnsuringDir(
 221| |      join(target, "src/cluster.example.ts"),
 222| |      clusterExampleTemplate(),
 223| |    );
 224| |  }
 226| |  if (features.has("tests")) {
 227| |    await writeFileEnsuringDir(join(target, "vitest.config.ts"), vitestConfigTemplate());
 228| |    await writeFileEnsuringDir(join(target, "test/app.test.ts"), testTemplate());
 229| |  }
 231| |  if (git) {
 232| |    const result = spawnSync("git", ["init"], {
 233| |      cwd: target,
 234| |      stdio: "ignore",
 235| |    });
 237| |    if (result.error) {
 238| |      warn(`Could not initialize git: ${result.error.message}`);
 239| |    }
 240| |  }
 242| |  if (install) {
 243| |    const result = spawnSync(pm, ["install"], {
 244| |      cwd: target,
 245| |      stdio: "inherit",
 246| |      shell: process.platform === "win32",
 247| |    });
 249| |    if (result.error) {
 250| |      warn(`Could not run ${pm} install: ${result.error.message}`);
 251| |    }
 252| |  }
 254| |  const rel = relative(process.cwd(), target) || ".";
 256| |  console.log();
 257| |  success(`Created ${name}`);
 258| |  console.log();
 259| |  console.log("Next steps:");
 261| |  if (rel !== ".") {
 262| |    console.log(`  cd ${rel}`);
 263| |  }
 265| |  if (!install) {
 266| |    console.log(`  ${pm} install`);
 267| |  }
 269| |  console.log(`  ${pm} run dev`);
 270| |  console.log();
 271| |}
 273|▼|function ask(rl: Readline, question: string, fallback: string): Promise<string> {
 274| |  return rl.question(`${question} (${fallback}): `).then((answer) => {
 275| |    const trimmed = answer.trim();
 276| |    return trimmed.length > 0 ? trimmed : fallback;
 277| |  });
 278| |}
 280|▼|async function askConfirm(
 281| |  rl: Readline,
 282| |  question: string,
 283| |  fallback: boolean,
 284| |): Promise<boolean> {
 285| |  const suffix = fallback ? "(Y/n)" : "(y/N)";
 286| |  const answer = (await rl.question(`${question} ${suffix} `)).trim().toLowerCase();
 288| |  if (!answer) return fallback;
 290| |  return answer.startsWith("y");
 291| |}
 293|▼|function normalizeRuntime(input?: string): "bun" | "node" {
 294| |  return input?.toLowerCase() === "node" ? "node" : "bun";
 295| |}
 297|▼|function normalizePm(input: string | undefined, runtime: "bun" | "node"): string {
 298| |  const lower = input?.toLowerCase();
 300| |  if (lower === "bun" || lower === "npm" || lower === "pnpm" || lower === "yarn") {
 301| |    return lower;
 302| |  }
 304| |  return runtime === "bun" ? "bun" : "npm";
 305| |}
 307| |const FEATURE_ALIASES: Record<string, Feature> = {
 308| |  cors: "cors",
 309| |  ratelimit: "rateLimit",
 310| |  "rate-limit": "rateLimit",
 311| |  security: "security",
 312| |  compression: "compression",
 313| |  logger: "logger",
 314| |  logs: "logger",
 315| |  openapi: "openapi",
 316| |  files: "files",
 317| |  upload: "files",
 318| |  ws: "ws",
 319| |  websocket: "ws",
 320| |  sse: "sse",
 321| |  cache: "cache",
 322| |  proxy: "proxy",
 323| |  cluster: "cluster",
 324| |  examples: "examples",
 325| |  tests: "tests",
 326| |  test: "tests",
 327| |};
 329|▼|function parseFeatures(input: string | undefined): Set<Feature> {
 330| |  if (!input) return new Set();
 332| |  const normalized = input.trim().toLowerCase();
 334| |  if (normalized === "all") {
 335| |    return new Set(FEATURE_NAMES);
 336| |  }
 338| |  if (normalized === "none" || normalized === "") {
 339| |    return new Set();
 340| |  }
 342| |  const out = new Set<Feature>();
 344| |  for (const rawToken of normalized.split(",")) {
 345| |    const token = rawToken.trim();
 346| |    if (!token) continue;
 348| |    const feature = FEATURE_ALIASES[token];
 350| |    if (feature) {
 351| |      out.add(feature);
 352| |    } else {
 353| |      warn(`Unknown feature: ${token}`);
 354| |    }
 355| |  }
 357| |  return out;
 358| |}
