   7| | * CLI flags are mapped to real CompilerOptions names here.
   8| | * Never pass raw CLI names directly into the compiler.
   9| | */
  10| |const CLI_TO_COMPILER: Record<string, string> = {
  11| |  routesDir: "routesDir",
  12| |  hooksDir: "hooksDir",
  13| |  outDir: "outDir",
  14| |  outFile: "outFile",
  15| |  minify: "minify",

  25|▼|function mapCliFlags(flags: Record<string, unknown>): Record<string, unknown> {
  26| |  const out: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  28| |  for (const [cliKey, compilerKey] of Object.entries(CLI_TO_COMPILER)) {
  29| |    if (flags[cliKey] !== undefined) {
  30| |      out[compilerKey] = flags[cliKey];
  31| |    }
  32| |  }
  34| |  return out;
  35| |}
  37|▼|export async function buildProject(
  38| |  root: string,
  39| |  flags: Record<string, unknown>,
  40| |): Promise<any> {
  41| |  const config = await loadConfig(root);
  43| |  let compiler: any;
  44| |  try {
  45| |    compiler = await import("@flux/compiler");
  46|!|  } catch (err) {
  47|!|    throw new Error(
  48| |      `Failed to load @flux/compiler. Make sure it is installed in your workspace.\n${
  49| |        err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err)
  50| |      }`,
  51| |    );
  52| |  }
  54| |  const input: Record<string, unknown> = { ...config };
  55| |  Object.assign(input, mapCliFlags(flags));
  57| |  const opts =
  58| |    typeof compiler.mergeOptions === "function"
  59| |      ? compiler.mergeOptions(input)
  60| |      : input;
  62| |  const build = compiler.buildAsync ?? compiler.build;
  64| |  if (typeof build !== "function") {
  65|!|    throw new Error("@flux/compiler does not export buildAsync or build.");
  66| |  }
  68| |  step(
  69| |    `Compiling ${String(opts.routesDir ?? "src/routes")} → ${String(
  70| |      opts.outDir ?? ".flux",
  71| |    )}`,
  72| |  );
  74| |  await build(opts);
  76| |  return opts;
  77| |}
  79|▼|export async function findServerEntry(
  80| |  root: string,
  81| |  opts: any,
  82| |): Promise<string | undefined> {
  83| |  const outDir = typeof opts?.outDir === "string" ? opts.outDir : ".flux";
  84| |  const outFile = typeof opts?.outFile === "string" ? opts.outFile : "server.js";
  86| |  const candidates = [
  87| |    opts?.output,
  88| |    opts?.serverEntry,
  89| |    opts?.entry,
  90| |    opts?.outFile ? join(outDir, opts.outFile) : undefined,
  91| |    join(outDir, outFile),
  92| |    join(outDir, "server.js"),
  93| |    join(outDir, "server.mjs"),
  94| |    join(outDir, "index.js"),
  95| |    join(outDir, "entry.js"),
  96| |    ".flux/server.js",
  97| |    "dist/server.js",
  98| |    "dist/__server.js",
  99| |  ]
 100| |    .filter((x): x is string => typeof x === "string" && x.length > 0)
 101| |    .map((x) => (isAbsolute(x) ? x : join(root, x)));
 103| |  for (const candidate of candidates) {
 104| |    if (await exists(candidate)) {
 105| |      return candidate;
 106| |    }
 107| |  }
 109| |  return undefined;
 110| |}

   1| |import { parseArgs } from "node:util";
   2| |import { resolve, join, relative } from "node:path";
   3| |import { createInterface } from "node:readline/promises";
   4| |import { exists, writeFileEnsuringDir } from "../utils/fs.js";
   5| |import { loadConfig } from "../utils/config.js";
   6| |import { parseRouteInput } from "../utils/route.js";
   7| |import { routeFileTemplate } from "../templates/route.js";
   8| |import { error, info, step, success } from "../utils/logger.js";
  10|▼|export async function runRoute(args: string[]): Promise<void> {
  11| |  const { values, positionals } = parseArgs({
  12| |    args,
  13| |    options: {
  14| |      root: { type: "string" },
  15| |      dir: { type: "string" },
  16| |      method: { type: "string" },
  17| |      schema: { type: "boolean" },
  18| |      force: { type: "boolean" },
  19| |    },
  20| |    allowPositionals: true,
  21| |    strict: false,
  22| |  });
  24| |  const root = resolve((values.root as string | undefined) ?? ".");
  26| |  let input = positionals[0];
  28| |  if (!input && process.stdin.isTTY) {
  29| |    const rl = createInterface({
  30| |      input: process.stdin,
  31| |      output: process.stdout,
  32| |    });
  34| |    input = await rl.question("Route path (e.g. products/[id].get): ");
  35| |    rl.close();
  36| |  }
  38| |  if (!input) {
  39| |    error("Route path is required.");
  40| |    process.exitCode = 1;
  41| |    return;
  42| |  }
  44| |  const parsed = parseRouteInput(input, values.method as string | undefined);
  46| |  const config = await loadConfig(root);
  48| |  const routesDir = resolve(
  49| |    root,
  50| |    (values.dir as string | undefined) ??
  51| |      (typeof config.routesDir === "string" ? config.routesDir : "src/routes"),
  52| |  );
  54| |  const filePath = join(routesDir, parsed.file);
  56| |  if ((await exists(filePath)) && !values.force) {
  57| |    error(`${relative(process.cwd(), filePath)} already exists. Use --force to overwrite.`);
  58| |    process.exitCode = 1;
  59| |    return;
  60| |  }
  62| |  step(`Creating ${parsed.method.toUpperCase()} ${parsed.routePath}`);
  64| |  await writeFileEnsuringDir(
  65| |    filePath,
  66| |    routeFileTemplate(parsed, { schema: Boolean(values.schema) }),
  67| |  );
  69| |  success(`Created ${relative(process.cwd(), filePath)}`);
  71| |  if (values.schema) {
  72| |    info("Schema template uses @sinclair/typebox. Install it if missing:");
  73| |    info("  bun add @sinclair/typebox");
  74| |  }
  75| |}

---
   1| |/**
   2| | * @fileoverview Phase 1: DISCOVERY
   3| | * Scans filesystem for route files and extracts module metadata via AST.
   4| | * IO isolated in entry function. Pure functions do parsing.
   5| | * Now with functional composition and error recovery.
   6| | */
   8| |import { readdirSync, statSync, readFileSync } from "fs";
   9| |import { join, dirname, basename, extname } from "path";
  11| |import type {
  12| |  ModuleInfo,
  13| |  RouteDef,
  14| |  HttpMethod,
  15| |  CompilerOptions,
  16| |  DiscoveryResult,
  17| |} from "../types";
  19| |import { HTTP_METHODS, normalizeHttpMethod } from "../types";
  20| |import { parseModule as parseModuleAST } from "../utils/ast";
  21| |import type { Logger } from "../logger";
  22| |import { tryCatch } from "../fp";
  24| |// Pure Functions
  25|▼|export const isRouteFile = (entry: string): boolean =>
  26| |  /\.(ts|js|mjs|tsx|jsx)$/.test(entry) && !entry.endsWith(".d.ts");
  28|▼|export const isValidDir = (entry: string): boolean =>
  29| |  !entry.startsWith(".") && entry !== "node_modules";
  31| |/** Safely read directory, returning empty array on error. */
  32|▼|const safeReaddir = (dir: string): string[] => {
  33| |  const result = tryCatch(() => readdirSync(dir));
  34| |  return result.ok ? result.value : [];
  35| |};
  37| |/** Safely check if path is directory. */
  38|▼|const safeIsDir = (path: string): boolean => {
  39| |  const result = tryCatch(() => statSync(path).isDirectory());
  40| |  return result.ok ? result.value : false;
  41| |};
  43| |/** Safely read file, returning empty string on error. */
  44|▼|const safeReadFile = (path: string): string => {
  45| |  const result = tryCatch(() => readFileSync(path, "utf-8"));
  46| |  return result.ok ? result.value : "";
  47| |};
  48|▼|export const scanDirectory = (dir: string, base = ""): string[] => {
  49| |  const out: string[] = [];
  50| |  for (const entry of safeReaddir(dir)) {
  51| |    const abs = join(dir, entry);
  52| |    const rel = join(base, entry).replace(/\\/g, "/");
  53| |    if (safeIsDir(abs)) {
  54| |      if (isValidDir(entry)) {
  55| |        out.push(...scanDirectory(abs, rel));
  56| |      }
  57| |    } else if (isRouteFile(entry)) {
  58| |      out.push(rel);
  59| |    }
  60| |  }
  61| |  return out;
  62| |};
  64|▼|export const parseRouteFilename = (
  65| |  file: string
  66| |): Pick<RouteDef, "method" | "path" | "paramNames" | "isDynamic" | "isStatic" | "segmentCount"> | null => {
  67| |  const ext = extname(file);
  68| |  const name = basename(file, ext);
  69| |  const parts = name.split(".");
  71| |  let method: HttpMethod = "GET";
  72| |  let routeName = name;
  74| |  const lastPart = parts.at(-1);
  75| |  if (lastPart) {
  76| |    const normalized = normalizeHttpMethod(lastPart);
  77| |    if (normalized) {
  78| |      method = normalized;
  79| |      routeName = parts.slice(0, -1).join(".");
  80| |    }
  81| |  }
  83| |  const dirPart = dirname(file);
  84| |  let routePath = "/" + join(dirPart, routeName).replace(/\\/g, "/");
  85| |  if (routePath.endsWith("/index")) {
  86| |    routePath = routePath.slice(0, -5) || "/";
  87| |  }
  89| |  const paramNames: string[] = [];
  90| |  let isDynamic = false;
  92| |  routePath = routePath.replace(/\[(\.\.\.[^\]]+)\]/g, (_, raw: string) => {
  93| |    isDynamic = true;
  94| |    const pname = raw.slice(3);
  95| |    paramNames.push(pname);
  96| |    return "*" + pname;
  97| |  });
  99| |  routePath = routePath.replace(/\[([^\]]+)\]/g, (_, pname: string) => {
 100| |    isDynamic = true;
 101| |    paramNames.push(pname);
 102| |    return ":" + pname;
 103| |  });
 105| |  return {
 106| |    method,
 107| |    path: routePath,
 108| |    paramNames,
 109| |    isDynamic,
 110| |    isStatic: !isDynamic,
 111| |    segmentCount: routePath.split("/").filter(Boolean).length,
 112| |  };
 113| |};
 115|▼|export const parseModule = (
 116| |  filePath: string,
 117| |  relPath: string,
 118| |  content: string,
 119| |): ModuleInfo => {
 120| |  const parsed = parseModuleAST(content);
 122| |  return {
 123| |    path: filePath,
 124| |    relPath,
 125| |    content,
 126| |    imports: parsed.imports,
 127| |    exports: parsed.exports,
 128| |    symbols: parsed.symbols,
 129| |    hasDefaultExport: parsed.hasDefaultExport,
 130| |    callGraph: new Map(),
 131| |    dataFlow: new Map(),
 133| |    ...(parsed.schemaExport ? { schemaExport: "schema" } : {}),
 134| |    ...(parsed.configExport ? { configExport: "config" } : {}),
 135| |  };
 136| |};
 138| |// Phase Orchestrator — Functional composition
 139|▼|export const runDiscovery = (opts: CompilerOptions, logger: Logger): DiscoveryResult =>
 140| |  logger.time("discovery", () => {
 141| |    const files = scanDirectory(opts.routesDir);
 142| |    const modules = files.map(f => {
 143| |      const abs = join(opts.routesDir, f);
 144| |      const content = safeReadFile(abs);
 145| |      return parseModule(abs, f, content);
 146| |    }).filter(m => m.content.length > 0); // Skip unreadable files
 148| |    logger.info(`Discovered ${files.length} files, ${modules.length} modules`, {
 149| |      routesDir: opts.routesDir,
 150| |    });
 151| |    return { files, modules };
 152| |  });

---
   1| |/**
   2| | * Phase 3: OPTIMIZATION
   3| | *
   4| | * Production cleanup:
   5| | * - removed jump table generation
   6| | * - removed dense/sparse/perfect-hash tables
   7| | * - removed response preserialization buffers
   8| | * - removed Zod-specific schema compilation
   9| | * - kept inline detection and deduplication
  10| | */
  12| |import type {
  13| |  RouteDef,
  14| |  ModuleInfo,
  15| |  CompilerOptions,
  16| |  OptimizationResult,
  17| |} from "../types";
  19| |import { estimateNodeCount } from "../utils/ast";
  20| |import type { Logger } from "../logger";
  22|▼|export const isInlineEligible = (
  23| |  route: RouteDef,
  24| |  mod: ModuleInfo | undefined,
  25| |  threshold: number
  26| |): boolean => {
  27| |  if (!mod) return false;
  28| |  if (route.hasValidation) return false;
  29| |  if (route.hooks.length > 0) return false;
  31| |  const nodeCount = estimateNodeCount(mod.content);
  32| |  return nodeCount <= threshold;
  33| |};
  35|▼|export const markInline = (
  36| |  route: RouteDef,
  37| |  modules: readonly ModuleInfo[],
  38| |  threshold: number
  39| |): RouteDef => {
  40| |  const mod = modules[route.moduleIdx];
  41| |  const shouldInline = isInlineEligible(route, mod, threshold);
  43| |  return shouldInline === route.shouldInline ? route : { ...route, shouldInline };
  44| |};
  46|▼|export const detectInlineCandidates = (
  47| |  routes: readonly RouteDef[],
  48| |  modules: readonly ModuleInfo[],
  49| |  threshold: number
  50| |): RouteDef[] => routes.map((r) => markInline(r, modules, threshold));
  52|▼|export const hasConstantResponse = (route: RouteDef): boolean =>
  53| |  route.isConstantResponse && !!route.constantResponse;
  55|▼|export const groupByConstantResponse = (
  56| |  routes: readonly RouteDef[]
  57| |): Map<string, RouteDef[]> => {
  58| |  const groups = new Map<string, RouteDef[]>();
  60| |  for (const route of routes) {
  61| |    if (!hasConstantResponse(route)) continue;
  63| |    const key = route.constantResponse!;
  64| |    const existing = groups.get(key);
  66| |    if (existing) existing.push(route);
  67| |    else groups.set(key, [route]);
  68| |  }
  70| |  return groups;
  71| |};
  73|▼|export const buildDedupMap = (
  74| |  groups: Map<string, RouteDef[]>
  75| |): Map<string, string> => {
  76| |  const replacements = new Map<string, string>();
  78| |  for (const group of groups.values()) {
  79| |    if (group.length < 2) continue;
  81| |    const leader = group[0]!;
  83| |    for (let i = 1; i < group.length; i++) {
  84| |      replacements.set(group[i]!.handlerRef, leader.handlerRef);
  85| |    }
  86| |  }
  88| |  return replacements;
  89| |};
  91|▼|export const applyDedup = (
  92| |  route: RouteDef,
  93| |  dedupMap: Map<string, string>
  94| |): RouteDef => {
  95| |  const dedupGroup = dedupMap.get(route.handlerRef);
  96| |  return dedupGroup ? { ...route, dedupGroup } : route;
  97| |};
  99|▼|export const deduplicateRoutes = (routes: RouteDef[]): RouteDef[] => {
 100| |  const groups = groupByConstantResponse(routes);
 101| |  const dedupMap = buildDedupMap(groups);
 103| |  if (dedupMap.size === 0) return routes;
 105| |  return routes.map((r) => applyDedup(r, dedupMap));
 106| |};
 108|▼|export const countInlined = (routes: readonly RouteDef[]): number =>
 109| |  routes.filter((r) => r.shouldInline).length;
 111|▼|export const countDeduped = (routes: readonly RouteDef[]): number =>
 112| |  routes.filter((r) => r.dedupGroup).length;
 114|▼|export const runOptimization = (
 115| |  routes: readonly RouteDef[],
 116| |  modules: readonly ModuleInfo[],
 117| |  opts: CompilerOptions,
 118| |  logger: Logger
 119| |): OptimizationResult =>
 120| |  logger.time("optimization", () => {
 121| |    const inlined = detectInlineCandidates(routes, modules, opts.inlineThreshold);
 123| |    const deduped = opts.enableHandlerDeduplication
 124| |      ? deduplicateRoutes(inlined)
 125| |      : inlined;
 127| |    const inlinedCount = countInlined(deduped);
 128| |    const dedupedCount = countDeduped(deduped);
 130| |    logger.info(
 131| |      `Optimized: ${inlinedCount} inlined | ${dedupedCount} deduplicated`
 132| |    );
 134| |    return {
 135| |      routes: deduped,
 136| |      meta: {
 137| |        inlined: inlinedCount,
 138| |        deduplicated: dedupedCount,
 139| |        eliminated: routes.length - deduped.length,
 140| |      },
 141| |    };
 142| |  });
---

   1| |/**
   2| | * @fileoverview File response helpers:
   3| | * - static file serving
   4| | * - downloads
   5| | * - HTTP range requests
   6| | * - conditional requests
   7| | * - mtime/ETag browser caching
   8| | */
  10| |import { stat } from "fs/promises";
  11| |import { basename, resolve, normalize, sep } from "path";
  12| |import { NotFoundError, ForbiddenError } from "./errors";
  13| |import { cacheControl } from "./cache";
  15|▼|export interface SendFileOptions {
  16| |  req?: Request;
  17| |  download?: boolean | string;
  18| |  contentType?: string;
  19| |  maxAge?: number;
  20| |  swr?: number;
  21| |  immutable?: boolean;
  22| |  isPrivate?: boolean;
  23| |}
  25|▼|export interface StreamDownloadOptions {
  26| |  filename?: string;
  27| |  contentType?: string;
  28| |  cacheControl?: string;
  29| |  size?: number;
  30| |}
  32| |/**
  33| | * Prevent path traversal.
  34| | *
  35| | * Example:
  36| | *   safeJoin("public", ctx.params.path)
  37| | */
  38|▼|export function safeJoin(root: string, target: string): string {
  39| |  const resolvedRoot = resolve(root);
  40| |  const resolved = resolve(resolvedRoot, normalize(target));
  42| |  if (!resolved.startsWith(resolvedRoot + sep)) {
  43|!|    throw new ForbiddenError("Invalid file path");
  44| |  }
  46| |  return resolved;
  47| |}
  49|▼|function isNotModified(
  50| |  req: Request,
  51| |  etag: string,
  52| |  lastModified: string
  53| |): boolean {
  54| |  const inm = req.headers.get("if-none-match");
  56| |  if (
  57| |    inm &&
  58| |    inm
  59| |      .split(",")
  60| |      .map((s) => s.trim())
  61| |      .includes(etag)
  62| |  ) {
  63| |    return true;
  64| |  }
  66| |  const ims = req.headers.get("if-modified-since");
  68| |  if (ims && new Date(ims).getTime() >= new Date(lastModified).getTime()) {
  69| |    return true;
  70| |  }
  72| |  return false;
  73| |}
  75|▼|export async function sendFile(
  76| |  path: string,
  77| |  opts: SendFileOptions = {}
  78| |): Promise<Response> {
  79| |  const stats = await stat(path).catch(() => null);
  81| |  if (!stats || !stats.isFile()) {
  82|!|    throw new NotFoundError("File");
  83| |  }
  85| |  const file = Bun.file(path);
  87| |  const etag = `W/"${stats.size.toString(16)}-${Math.floor(
  88| |    stats.mtimeMs
  89| |  ).toString(16)}"`;
  91| |  const lastModified = stats.mtime.toUTCString();
  93| |  const headers = new Headers();
  95| |  headers.set(
  96| |    "content-type",
  97| |    opts.contentType || file.type || "application/octet-stream"
  98| |  );
 100| |headers.set(
 101| |  "cache-control",
 102| |  cacheControl({
 103| |    public: !opts.isPrivate,
 104| |    maxAge: opts.maxAge ?? 3600,
 105| |    ...(opts.isPrivate !== undefined ? { private: opts.isPrivate } : {}),
 106| |    ...(opts.swr !== undefined ? { swr: opts.swr } : {}),
 107| |    ...(opts.immutable !== undefined ? { immutable: opts.immutable } : {}),
 108| |  }),
 109| |);
 111| |  headers.set("etag", etag);
 112| |  headers.set("last-modified", lastModified);
 113| |  headers.set("accept-ranges", "bytes");
 115| |  if (opts.download) {
 116| |    const filename =
 117| |      typeof opts.download === "string"
 118| |        ? opts.download
 119| |        : basename(path);
 121| |    headers.set(
 122| |      "content-disposition",
 123| |      `attachment; filename="${filename.replace(/"/g, "")}"`
 124| |    );
 125| |  }
 127| |  if (opts.req && isNotModified(opts.req, etag, lastModified)) {
 128| |    return new Response(null, {
 129| |      status: 304,
 130| |      headers,
 131| |    });
 132| |  }
 134| |  const range = opts.req?.headers.get("range");
 136| |  if (range) {
 137| |    const match = /bytes=(\d*)-(\d*)/.exec(range);
 139| |    if (!match) {
 140| |      return new Response("Range Not Satisfiable", {
 141| |        status: 416,
 142| |        headers: {
 143| |          "content-range": `bytes */${stats.size}`,
 144| |        },
 145| |      });
 146| |    }
 148| |    let start: number;
 149| |    let end: number;
 151| |    if (match[1] === "" && match[2] !== "") {
 152| |      // Suffix range: bytes=-500
 153| |      const suffix = parseInt(match[2]!, 10);
 154| |      start = Math.max(0, stats.size - suffix);
 155| |      end = stats.size - 1;
 156| |    } else {
 157| |      start = match[1] ? parseInt(match[1], 10) : 0;
 158| |      end = match[2] ? parseInt(match[2], 10) : stats.size - 1;
 159| |    }
 161| |    if (
 162| |      Number.isNaN(start) ||
 163| |      Number.isNaN(end) ||
 164| |      start > end ||
 165| |      start >= stats.size
 166| |    ) {
 167| |      return new Response("Range Not Satisfiable", {
 168| |        status: 416,
 169| |        headers: {
 170| |          "content-range": `bytes */${stats.size}`,
 171| |        },
 172| |      });
 173| |    }
 175| |    end = Math.min(end, stats.size - 1);
 177| |    headers.set("content-range", `bytes ${start}-${end}/${stats.size}`);
 178| |    headers.set("content-length", String(end - start + 1));
 180| |    return new Response(file.slice(start, end + 1), {
 181| |      status: 206,
 182| |      headers,
 183| |    });
 184| |  }
 186| |  headers.set("content-length", String(stats.size));
 188| |  return new Response(file, {
 189| |    status: 200,
 190| |    headers,
 191| |  });
 192| |}
 194|▼|export function streamDownload(
 195| |  stream: ReadableStream,
 196| |  opts: StreamDownloadOptions = {}
 197| |): Response {
 198| |  const headers = new Headers({
 199| |    "content-type": opts.contentType || "application/octet-stream",
 200| |    "cache-control": opts.cacheControl || "no-store",
 201| |  });
 203| |  if (opts.filename) {
 204| |    headers.set(
 205| |      "content-disposition",
 206| |      `attachment; filename="${opts.filename.replace(/"/g, "")}"`
 207| |    );
 208| |  }
 210| |  if (opts.size != null) {
 211| |    headers.set("content-length", String(opts.size));
 212| |  }
 214| |  return new Response(stream, {
 215| |    status: 200,
 216| |    headers,
 217| |  });
 218| |}

>packages/cli/src/commands/dev.ts

   1| |import { parseArgs } from "node:util";
   2| |import { watch, type FSWatcher } from "node:fs";
   3| |import { spawn as spawnProcess, spawnSync, type ChildProcess } from "node:child_process";
   4| |import { resolve, relative } from "node:path";
   5| |import { buildProject, findServerEntry } from "../utils/compiler.js";
   6| |import { loadConfig } from "../utils/config.js";
   7| |import { error, step, success, warn } from "../utils/logger.js";
   9|▼|export async function runDev(args: string[]): Promise<void> {
  10| |  const { values, positionals } = parseArgs({
  11| |    args,
  12| |    options: {
  13| |      root: { type: "string" },
  14| |      port: { type: "string" },
  15| |      runtime: { type: "string" },
  16| |      spawn: { type: "boolean" },
  17| |      outDir: { type: "string" },
  18| |      routesDir: { type: "string" },
  19| |      verbose: { type: "boolean" },
  20| |    },
  21| |    allowPositionals: true,
  22| |    strict: false,
  23| |  });
  25| |  const root = resolve((values.root as string | undefined) ?? positionals[0] ?? ".");
  26| |  const runtime = detectRuntime(values.runtime as string | undefined);
  27| |  const port = (values.port as string | undefined) ?? process.env.PORT ?? "3000";
  28| |  const shouldSpawn = values.spawn !== false;
  30| |  let child: ChildProcess | undefined;
  31| |  let timer: NodeJS.Timeout | undefined;
  32| |  let building = false;
  33| |  let pending = false;
  35| |  const watchers: FSWatcher[] = [];
  37|▼|  function stopChild(): void {
  38| |    if (!child) return;
  40| |    const pid = child.pid;
  42| |    if (process.platform === "win32" && pid) {
  43| |      spawnSync("taskkill", ["/pid", String(pid), "/T", "/F"], {
  44| |        stdio: "ignore",
  45| |      });
  46| |    } else if (process.platform !== "win32" && pid) {
  47| |      try {
  48| |        process.kill(-pid, "SIGTERM");
  49| |      } catch {
  50| |        try {
  51| |          child.kill("SIGTERM");
  52| |        } catch {
  53| |          // noop
  54| |        }
  55| |      }
  56| |    } else {
  57| |      try {
  58| |        child.kill("SIGTERM");
  59| |      } catch {
  60| |        // noop
  61| |      }
  62| |    }
  64| |    child = undefined;
  65| |  }
  67|▼|  function startChild(entry: string): ChildProcess {
  68| |    step(`Starting ${relative(process.cwd(), entry)} with ${runtime}`);
  70| |    const spawned = spawnProcess(runtime, [entry], {
  71| |      stdio: "inherit",
  72| |      detached: process.platform !== "win32",
  73| |      env: {
  74| |        ...process.env,
  75| |        PORT: String(port),
  76| |        NODE_ENV: "development",
  77| |      },
  78| |    });
  80| |    spawned.on("exit", (code, signal) => {
  81| |      if (code !== null && code !== 0) {
  82| |        warn(`Server exited code=${code} signal=${signal ?? "null"}`);
  83| |      }
  84| |    });
  86| |    return spawned;
  87| |  }
  89|▼|  function restart(entry: string): void {
  90| |    stopChild();
  91| |    child = startChild(entry);
  92| |  }
  94|▼|  async function buildOnce(): Promise<void> {
  95| |    if (building) {
  96| |      pending = true;
  97| |      return;
  98| |    }
 100| |    building = true;
 102| |    try {
 103| |      const opts = await buildProject(root, values as Record<string, unknown>);
 104| |      const entry = await findServerEntry(root, opts);
 106| |      if (!entry) {
 107| |        warn(
 108| |          "Could not locate generated server entry. Set outDir/output or run with --no-spawn.",
 109| |        );
 110| |      }
 112| |      if (shouldSpawn && entry) {
 113| |        restart(entry);
 114| |      }
 116| |      success("Dev build ready");
 117| |    } finally {
 118| |      building = false;
 120| |      if (pending) {
 121| |        pending = false;
 122| |        await buildOnce();
 123| |      }
 124| |    }
 125| |  }
 127|▼|  function scheduleRebuild(): void {
 128| |    if (timer) clearTimeout(timer);
 130| |    timer = setTimeout(() => {
 131| |      buildOnce().catch((err) => {
 132| |        error(err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err));
 133| |      });
 134| |    }, 120);
 135| |  }
 137| |  await buildOnce().catch((err) => {
 138| |    error(err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err));
 139| |  });
 141| |  const config = await loadConfig(root);
 142| |  const outDir = String(values.outDir ?? config.outDir ?? ".flux");
 144|▼|  function shouldIgnore(filename: string): boolean {
 145| |    const normalized = filename.replaceAll("\\", "/");
 146| |    const normalizedOut = outDir.replaceAll("\\", "/").replace(/^\.\//, "");
 148| |    const lockfiles = new Set([
 149| |      "bun.lockb",
 150| |      "package-lock.json",
 151| |      "pnpm-lock.yaml",
 152| |      "yarn.lock",
 153| |    ]);
 155| |    const basename = normalized.split("/").pop() ?? "";
 157| |    return (
 158| |      normalized.includes("node_modules/") ||
 159| |      normalized.startsWith(".git/") ||
 160| |      normalized.startsWith(`${normalizedOut}/`) ||
 161| |      normalized.includes("/dist/") ||
 162| |      normalized.endsWith(".log") ||
 163| |      lockfiles.has(basename)
 164| |    );
 165| |  }
 167|▼|  function onClose(): void {
 168| |    stopChild();
 170| |    for (const watcher of watchers) {
 171| |      watcher.close();
 172| |    }
 174| |    process.exit(0);
 175| |  }
 177| |  process.on("SIGINT", onClose);
 178| |  process.on("SIGTERM", onClose);
 180| |  try {
 181| |    const watcher = watch(root, { recursive: true }, (_event, filename) => {
 182| |      if (!filename) return;
 184| |      const file = String(filename);
 185| |      if (shouldIgnore(file)) return;
 187| |      scheduleRebuild();
 188| |    });
 190| |    watcher.on("error", () => {
 191| |      // Ignore watch errors; rebuilds are debounced.
 192| |    });
 194| |    watchers.push(watcher);
 195| |  } catch {
 196| |    warn(
 197| |      "Recursive fs.watch unavailable. Watching src/, routes/, hooks/, and config files non-recursively.",
 198| |    );
 200| |    const routesDir = String(config.routesDir ?? "src/routes");
 201| |    const hooksDir = String(config.hooksDir ?? "src/hooks");
 203| |    const dirs = [routesDir, hooksDir, "src"].map((dir) => resolve(root, dir));
 205| |    for (const dir of dirs) {
 206| |      try {
 207| |        const watcher = watch(dir, (_event, filename) => {
 208| |          if (!filename) return;
 209| |          if (shouldIgnore(String(filename))) return;
 210| |          scheduleRebuild();
 211| |        });
 213| |        watcher.on("error", () => {
 214| |          // noop
 215| |        });
 217| |        watchers.push(watcher);
 218| |      } catch {
 219| |        // Directory may not exist.
 220| |      }
 221| |    }
 223| |    const files = [
 224| |      "flux.config.ts",
 225| |      "flux.config.mts",
 226| |      "flux.config.mjs",
 227| |      "flux.config.js",
 228| |      "package.json",
 229| |    ];
 231| |    for (const file of files) {
 232| |      try {
 233| |        const watcher = watch(resolve(root, file), () => {
 234| |          scheduleRebuild();
 235| |        });
 237| |        watcher.on("error", () => {
 238| |          // noop
 239| |        });
 241| |        watchers.push(watcher);
 242| |      } catch {
 243| |        // File may not exist.
 244| |      }
 245| |    }
 246| |  }
 247| |}
 249|▼|function commandExists(command: string): boolean {
 250| |  try {
 251| |    const result = spawnSync(command, ["--version"], {
 252| |      stdio: "ignore",
 253| |    });
 255| |    return result.status === 0;
 256| |  } catch {
 257| |    return false;
 258| |  }
 259| |}
 261|▼|function detectRuntime(preferred?: string): string {
 262| |  if (preferred === "node") {
 263| |    return process.execPath;
 264| |  }
 266| |  if (preferred === "bun") {
 267| |    if (process.versions.bun || commandExists("bun")) {
 268| |      return "bun";
 269| |    }
 271| |    warn("bun not found, falling back to node");
 272| |    return process.execPath;
 273| |  }
 275| |  if (process.versions.bun) {
 276| |    return "bun";
 277| |  }
 279| |  if (commandExists("bun")) {
 280| |    return "bun";
 281| |  }
 283| |  return process.execPath;
 284| |}

   1| |/**
   2| | * @fileoverview Phase 2: ANALYSIS — AST-based, zero regex.
   3| | * Detects ctx usage at build time. Produces RouteDefs from discovered modules.
   4| | */
   6| |import type {
   7| |  RouteDef,
   8| |  ModuleInfo,
   9| |  CompilerOptions,
  10| |  HttpMethod,
  11| |  DiscoveryResult,
  12| |  AnalysisResult,
  13| |  HookDef,
  14| |  ContextUsage,
  15| |  RouteCacheConfig,
  16| |} from "../types";
  18| |import { HTTP_METHODS, FULL_CONTEXT_USAGE } from "../types";
  19| |import { parseRouteFilename } from "./discovery";
  20| |import { computeSignatureHash } from "../utils/hash";
  21| |import {
  22| |  parseModule,
  23| |  isPureBodyAST,
  24| |  inferResponseTypeAST,
  25| |} from "../utils/ast";
  29| |import type { Logger } from "../logger";
  30| |import { existsSync, readFileSync } from "fs";
  31| |import { join } from "path";
  32| |import { parseModule as parseModuleAST } from "../utils/ast";
  33| |import type { AppConfigInfo } from "../types";
  35|▼|const safeReadFile = (path: string): string => {
  36| |  try {
  37| |    return readFileSync(path, "utf-8");
  38| |  } catch {
  39| |    return "";
  40| |  }
  41| |};
  43|▼|export const resolveAppConfig = (
  44| |  opts: CompilerOptions,
  45| |): AppConfigInfo | undefined => {
  46| |  const relPath = opts.appConfig ?? "./src/app.config.ts";
  47| |  const absPath = join(process.cwd(), relPath);
  49| |  if (!existsSync(absPath)) {
  50| |    return undefined;
  51| |  }
  53| |  const content = safeReadFile(absPath);
  55| |  if (!content) {
  56| |    return undefined;
  57| |  }
  59| |  const parsed = parseModuleAST(content);
  60| |  const exportNames = new Set(parsed.exports.map((x) => x.name));
  62| |  return {
  63| |    path: absPath,
  64| |    relPath,
  65| |    hasPlugins: exportNames.has("plugins"),
  66| |    hasLifecycle:
  67| |      exportNames.has("lifecycle") || exportNames.has("hooks"),
  68| |    hasServer: exportNames.has("server"),
  69| |  };
  70| |};
  71| |// ============================================================================
  72| |// Pure Route Analysis Functions
  73| |// ============================================================================
  75|▼|export const parseRouteFile = (file: string) => parseRouteFilename(file);
  77|▼|export const findModuleByPath = (
  78| |  modules: readonly ModuleInfo[], relPath: string
  79| |): ModuleInfo | undefined => modules.find((m) => m.relPath === relPath);
  81|▼|export const findModuleIndex = (
  82| |  modules: readonly ModuleInfo[], relPath: string
  83| |): number => modules.findIndex((m) => m.relPath === relPath);
  85| |// ============================================================================
  86| |// Constant Response Detection
  87| |// ============================================================================
  89| |import { extractConstantReturn } from "../utils/ast";
  91|▼|const evaluateConstantBodyAST = (ast: any): string | null => {
  92| |  const result = extractConstantReturn(ast);
  93| |  if (!result.ok) return null;
  94| |  try {
  95| |    return JSON.stringify(result.value);
  96| |  } catch {
  97| |    return null;
  98| |  }
  99| |};
 101| |export const detectConstantResponse = (
 102| |  mod: ModuleInfo
 103| |): { isConstant: boolean; constantResponse?: string } => {
 104| |  const parsed = parseModule(mod.content);
 106| |  if (!parsed.handler) {
 107| |    return { isConstant: false };
 108| |  }
 110| |  if (!isPureBodyAST(parsed.ast)) {
 111| |    return { isConstant: false };
 112| |  }
 114| |  const json = evaluateConstantBodyAST(parsed.ast);
 116| |  if (!json) {
 117| |    return { isConstant: false };
 118| |  }
 120| |  return {
 121| |    isConstant: true,
 122| |    constantResponse: json,
 123| |  };
 124| |};
 126| |// ============================================================================
 127| |// RouteDef Factory — Pure
 128| |// ============================================================================
 130|▼|export const buildHandlerRef = (routeIndex: number): string => `_h${routeIndex}`;
 131|▼|export const buildSchemaRef = (routeIndex: number, hasSchema: boolean): string | null =>
 132| |  hasSchema ? `_s${routeIndex}` : null;
 133|▼|export const computeMethodIndex = (method: HttpMethod): number =>
 134| |  HTTP_METHODS.indexOf(method);
 136|▼|export const findHandlerSymbol = (mod: ModuleInfo) =>
 137| |  mod.symbols.find((s) => s.name === "default") || mod.symbols[0];
 138| |/**
 139| | * Normalize exported route cache config.
 140| | *
 141| | * Pure and exactOptionalPropertyTypes-safe.
 142| | */
 143|▼|const normalizeRouteCache = (
 144| |  input: unknown,
 145| |): RouteCacheConfig | undefined => {
 146| |  if (typeof input === "number") {
 147| |    return { maxAge: input };
 148| |  }
 150| |  if (!input || typeof input !== "object") {
 151| |    return undefined;
 152| |  }
 154| |  const cfg = input as Record<string, unknown>;
 156| |  const cache: {
 157| |    maxAge?: number;
 158| |    swr?: number;
 159| |    immutable?: boolean;
 160| |    vary?: string[];
 161| |  } = {};
 163| |  if (typeof cfg.maxAge === "number") cache.maxAge = cfg.maxAge;
 164| |  if (typeof cfg.swr === "number") cache.swr = cfg.swr;
 165| |  if (typeof cfg.immutable === "boolean") cache.immutable = cfg.immutable;
 167| |  if (Array.isArray(cfg.vary)) {
 168| |    cache.vary = cfg.vary.filter(
 169| |      (item): item is string => typeof item === "string",
 170| |    );
 171| |  }
 173| |  return Object.keys(cache).length > 0 ? cache : undefined;
 174| |};
 177|▼|export const createRouteDef = (
 178| |  file: string,
 179| |  parsed: NonNullable<ReturnType<typeof parseRouteFilename>>,
 180| |  mod: ModuleInfo,
 181| |  routeIndex: number,
 182| |  moduleIdx: number,
 183| |): RouteDef => {
 184| |  const handlerSym = findHandlerSymbol(mod);
 185| |  const methodIdx = computeMethodIndex(parsed.method);
 187| |  const astParsed = parseModule(mod.content);
 189| |  const cache = normalizeRouteCache(astParsed.config?.cache);
 190| |  const usage = astParsed.handler?.usage ?? FULL_CONTEXT_USAGE;
 192| |  const isAsync =
 193| |    astParsed.handler?.isAsync ?? handlerSym?.isAsync ?? false;
 195| |  const hooks = Array.isArray(astParsed.config?.hooks)
 196| |    ? astParsed.config.hooks.filter(
 197| |        (x: unknown): x is string => typeof x === "string",
 198| |      )
 199| |    : [];
 201| |  const { isConstant, constantResponse } = detectConstantResponse(mod);
 202| |  const inferredResponseType = inferResponseTypeAST(astParsed.ast);
 204| |  const responseType = usage.json
 205| |    ? "json"
 206| |    : usage.text
 207| |      ? "text"
 208| |      : usage.html
 209| |        ? "html"
 210| |        : usage.stream
 211| |          ? "stream"
 212| |          : inferredResponseType;
 214| |  return {
 215| |    ...parsed,
 216| |    file,
 217| |    moduleIdx,
 218| |    handlerRef: buildHandlerRef(routeIndex),
 219| |    schemaRef: buildSchemaRef(routeIndex, !!mod.schemaExport),
 220| |    signatureHash: computeSignatureHash(methodIdx, parsed.path),
 221| |    handlerSize: handlerSym?.size || 9999,
 222| |    isAsync,
 223| |    shouldInline: false,
 224| |    responseType,
 225| |    hasValidation: !!mod.schemaExport,
 226| |    hotnessScore: 0,
 227| |    hooks,
 228| |    isConstantResponse: isConstant,
 229| |    usage,
 231| |    ...(constantResponse !== undefined ? { constantResponse } : {}),
 232| |    ...(cache !== undefined ? { cache } : {}),
 233| |    ...(astParsed.config !== undefined ? { config: astParsed.config } : {}),
 234| |  };
 235| |};
 237| |export const resolveRouteModule = (
 238| |  file: string,
 239| |  modules: readonly ModuleInfo[]
 240| |): { mod: ModuleInfo; parsed: NonNullable<ReturnType<typeof parseRouteFilename>> } | null => {
 241| |  const parsed = parseRouteFile(file);
 242| |  if (!parsed) return null;
 243| |  const mod = findModuleByPath(modules, file);
 244| |  if (!mod) return null;
 245| |  if (!mod.hasDefaultExport) return null;
 246| |  return { mod, parsed };
 247| |};
 249| |// ============================================================================
 250| |// Route Graph Builder — Pure
 251| |// ============================================================================
 253|▼|export const buildRouteGraph = (
 254| |  files: readonly string[],
 255| |  modules: readonly ModuleInfo[]
 256| |): RouteDef[] => {
 257| |  const routes: RouteDef[] = [];
 259| |  for (const file of files) {
 260| |    const resolved = resolveRouteModule(file, modules);
 261| |    if (!resolved) continue;
 263| |    const moduleIdx = findModuleIndex(modules, file);
 264| |    if (moduleIdx < 0) continue;
 266| |    routes.push(
 267| |      createRouteDef(
 268| |        file,
 269| |        resolved.parsed,
 270| |        resolved.mod,
 271| |        routes.length,
 272| |        moduleIdx
 273| |      )
 274| |    );
 275| |  }
 277| |  return routes;
 278| |};
 279| |// ============================================================================
 280| |// Dead Route Detection — Pure
 281| |// ============================================================================
 283|▼|export const staticRouteKey = (route: RouteDef): string =>
 284| |  `${route.method}:${route.path}`;
 286| |export const detectDeadRoutes = (
 287| |  routes: readonly RouteDef[],
 288| |  modules: readonly ModuleInfo[]
 289| |): { alive: RouteDef[]; dead: RouteDef[] } => {
 290| |  const seen = new Map<string, number>();
 291| |  const alive: RouteDef[] = [];
 292| |  const dead: RouteDef[] = [];
 294| |  for (const route of routes) {
 295| |    const hasValidModule = route.moduleIdx >= 0 && route.moduleIdx < modules.length;
 296| |    if (!hasValidModule) {
 297| |      dead.push(route);
 298| |      continue;
 299| |    }
 300| |    if (route.isStatic && seen.has(staticRouteKey(route))) {
 301| |      dead.push(route);
 302| |      continue;
 303| |    }
 304| |    if (route.isStatic) {
 305| |      seen.set(staticRouteKey(route), alive.length);
 306| |    }
 307| |    alive.push(route);
 308| |  }
 309| |  return { alive, dead };
 310| |};
 313|▼|export interface RouteConflictIssue {
 314| |  readonly level: "error" | "warn";
 315| |  readonly message: string;
 316| |  readonly routes: readonly string[];
 317| |}
 319|▼|const normalizeConflictPattern = (path: string): string =>
 320| |  path
 321| |    .split("/")
 322| |    .map((segment) => {
 323| |      if (segment.startsWith(":")) return ":param";
 324| |      if (segment.startsWith("*")) return "*";
 325| |      return segment;
 326| |    })
 327| |    .join("/");
 329|▼|export const detectRouteConflicts = (
 330| |  routes: readonly RouteDef[],
 331| |  opts: CompilerOptions,
 332| |  logger: Logger,
 333| |): void => {
 334| |  const issues: RouteConflictIssue[] = [];
 336| |  const exact = new Map<string, RouteDef[]>();
 337| |  const patterns = new Map<string, RouteDef[]>();
 339| |  for (const route of routes) {
 340| |    const exactKey = `${route.method} ${route.path}`;
 341| |    const patternKey = `${route.method} ${normalizeConflictPattern(route.path)}`;
 343| |    const exactGroup = exact.get(exactKey);
 344| |    if (exactGroup) exactGroup.push(route);
 345| |    else exact.set(exactKey, [route]);
 347| |    const patternGroup = patterns.get(patternKey);
 348| |    if (patternGroup) patternGroup.push(route);
 349| |    else patterns.set(patternKey, [route]);
 350| |  }
 352| |  for (const [key, group] of exact) {
 353| |    if (group.length > 1) {
 354| |      issues.push({
 355| |        level: "error",
 356| |        message: `Duplicate route: ${key}`,
 357| |        routes: group.map((r) => r.file),
 358| |      });
 359| |    }
 360| |  }
 362| |  for (const [key, group] of patterns) {
 363| |    if (group.length <= 1) continue;
 365| |    const uniquePaths = new Set(group.map((r) => r.path));
 367| |    if (uniquePaths.size > 1) {
 368| |      issues.push({
 369| |        level: "warn",
 370| |        message: `Ambiguous dynamic route pattern: ${key}`,
 371| |        routes: group.map((r) => `${r.method} ${r.path} -> ${r.file}`),
 372| |      });
 373| |    }
 374| |  }
 376| |  for (const issue of issues) {
 377| |    if (issue.level === "error") {
 378| |      logger.error(issue.message, { routes: issue.routes });
 379| |    } else {
 380| |      logger.warn(issue.message, { routes: issue.routes });
 381| |    }
 382| |  }
 384| |  const hasError = issues.some((issue) => issue.level === "error");
 386| |  if (hasError && opts.strictRouteConflicts) {
 387|!|    throw new Error("Route conflicts detected and strictRouteConflicts is enabled.");
 388| |  }
 389| |};
 391| |// ============================================================================
 392| |// Hook Resolution — Pure
 393| |// ============================================================================
 395|▼|export const collectHookNames = (routes: readonly RouteDef[]): Set<string> => {
 396| |  const referenced = new Set<string>();
 397| |  for (const route of routes) {
 398| |    for (const hook of route.hooks) referenced.add(hook);
 399| |  }
 400| |  return referenced;
 401| |};
 403|▼|export const createHookDef = (name: string, hooksDir: string): HookDef => ({
 404| |  name,
 405| |  source: `${hooksDir}/${name}.ts`,
 406| |  moduleIdx: -1,
 407| |  isAsync: true,
 408| |});
 410|▼|export const resolveHooks = (
 411| |  routes: readonly RouteDef[],
 412| |  hooksDir: string | undefined
 413| |): ReadonlyMap<string, HookDef> => {
 414| |  const names = collectHookNames(routes);
 415| |  const hooks = new Map<string, HookDef>();
 416| |  if (!hooksDir || names.size === 0) return hooks;
 417| |  for (const name of names) {
 418| |    hooks.set(name, createHookDef(name, hooksDir));
 419| |  }
 420| |  return hooks;
 421| |};
 423| |// ============================================================================
 424| |// Statistics — Pure
 425| |// ============================================================================
 427|▼|export const countRoutes = (
 428| |  routes: readonly RouteDef[],
 429| |  predicate: (r: RouteDef) => boolean
 430| |): number => routes.filter(predicate).length;
 432|▼|export const countStatic = (routes: readonly RouteDef[]): number =>
 433| |  countRoutes(routes, (r) => r.isStatic);
 434|▼|export const countDynamic = (routes: readonly RouteDef[]): number =>
 435| |  countRoutes(routes, (r) => r.isDynamic);
 436|▼|export const countConstant = (routes: readonly RouteDef[]): number =>
 437| |  countRoutes(routes, (r) => r.isConstantResponse);
 439| |// ============================================================================
 440| |// Phase Orchestrator — Composed from pure functions
 441| |// ============================================================================
 443|▼|export const runAnalysis = (
 444| |  discovery: DiscoveryResult,
 445| |  opts: CompilerOptions,
 446| |  logger: Logger,
 447| |): AnalysisResult =>
 448| |  logger.time("analysis", () => {
 449| |    const routes = buildRouteGraph(discovery.files, discovery.modules);
 450| |    const { alive, dead } = detectDeadRoutes(routes, discovery.modules);
 452| |    if (dead.length > 0) {
 453| |      logger.warn(`Eliminated ${dead.length} dead route(s)`, {
 454| |        dead: dead.map((r) => `${r.method} ${r.path}`),
 455| |      });
 456| |    }
 458| |    detectRouteConflicts(alive, opts, logger);
 460| |    const hooks = resolveHooks(alive, opts.hooksDir);
 461| |    const appConfig = resolveAppConfig(opts);
 463| |    if (appConfig) {
 464| |      logger.info(`App config found: ${appConfig.relPath}`, {
 465| |        plugins: appConfig.hasPlugins,
 466| |        lifecycle: appConfig.hasLifecycle,
 467| |        server: appConfig.hasServer,
 468| |      });
 469| |    }
 471| |    return {
 472| |      routes: alive,
 473| |      modules: discovery.modules,
 474| |      hooks,
 475| |      ...(appConfig ? { appConfig } : {}),
 476| |    };
 477| |  });

  70| |    factory: () => Promise<Response>,
  71| |    opts?: HttpResponseCacheOptions & { vary?: string[] }
  72| |  ): Promise<Response>;
  74| |  readonly server: any;
  75| |}
  77|▼|const toCookieValue = (value: unknown): string =>
  78| |  typeof value === "object" && value !== null
  79| |    ? JSON.stringify(value)
  80| |    : String(value ?? "");
  82|▼|const encodeCookieValue = (value: string): string => encodeURIComponent(value);
  84|▼|const decodeCookieValue = (value: string): string => {
  85| |  try {
  86| |    return decodeURIComponent(value);
  87| |  } catch {
  88| |    return value;
  89| |  }
  90| |};
  92|▼|const normalizeSameSite = (
  93| |  sameSite: CookieOptions["sameSite"]
  94| |): string | undefined => {
  95| |  if (sameSite === true) return "Strict";
  96| |  if (sameSite === false || sameSite === undefined) return undefined;
  98| |  return sameSite.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + sameSite.slice(1);
  99| |};
 101|▼|const serializeCookiePair = (
 102| |  name: string,
 103| |  value: string,
 104| |  opts: ElysiaCookie
 105| |): string => {
 106| |  const parts = [`${name}=${encodeCookieValue(value)}`];
 108| |  if (opts.domain) parts.push(`Domain=${opts.domain}`);
 109| |  if (opts.path) parts.push(`Path=${opts.path}`);
 111| |  if (opts.expires instanceof Date) {
 112| |    parts.push(`Expires=${opts.expires.toUTCString()}`);
 113| |  }
 115| |  if (opts.maxAge != null) {
 116| |    parts.push(`Max-Age=${Math.floor(opts.maxAge)}`);
 117| |  }
 119| |  if (opts.httpOnly) parts.push("HttpOnly");
 120| |  if (opts.secure) parts.push("Secure");
 122| |  const sameSite = normalizeSameSite(opts.sameSite);
 123| |  if (sameSite) parts.push(`SameSite=${sameSite}`);
 125| |  if (opts.priority) parts.push(`Priority=${opts.priority}`);
 126| |  if (opts.partitioned) parts.push("Partitioned");
 128| |  return parts.join("; ");
 129| |};
 131|▼|export const serializeCookie = (
 132| |  cookies: Record<string, ElysiaCookie>
 133| |): string | string[] | undefined => {
 134| |  const serialized = Object.entries(cookies)
 135| |    .filter(([, opts]) => opts?.value != null)
 136| |    .map(([name, opts]) =>
 137| |      serializeCookiePair(name, toCookieValue(opts.value), opts)
 138| |    );
 140| |  if (serialized.length === 0) return undefined;
 142| |  return serialized.length === 1 ? serialized[0] : serialized;
 143| |};
 145|▼|export const parseCookieString = (
 146| |  cookieString: string | null
 147| |): Record<string, string> => {
 148| |  if (!cookieString) return {};
 150| |  return cookieString
 151| |    .split(";")
 152| |    .reduce<Record<string, string>>((acc, segment) => {
 153| |      const eq = segment.indexOf("=");
 154| |      if (eq === -1) return acc;
 156| |      const key = segment.slice(0, eq).trim();
 157| |      if (!key) return acc;
 159| |      const value = segment.slice(eq + 1).trim();
 160| |      acc[key] = decodeCookieValue(value);
 162| |      return acc;
 163| |    }, {});
 164| |};
 166|▼|export const parseSetCookieHeader = (header: string | string[] | null) => {
 167| |  if (!header) return [];
 168| |  return setCookie.parse(header);
 169| |};
 171|▼|export class Cookie<T = string | undefined> {
 172| |  constructor(
 173| |    private name: string,
 174| |    private jar: Record<string, ElysiaCookie>,
 175| |    private initial: Partial<ElysiaCookie> = {}
 176| |  ) {}
 178| |  get value(): T {
 179| |    return (this.jar[this.name]?.value ?? this.initial.value) as T;
 180| |  }
 182| |  set value(v: T) {
 183| |    const entry = (this.jar[this.name] ??= { ...this.initial });
 184| |    entry.value = v;
 185| |  }
 187| |  get expires() {
 188| |    return this.jar[this.name]?.expires ?? this.initial.expires;
 189| |  }
 191| |  set expires(v: Date | undefined) {
 192| |    this._set("expires", v);
 193| |  }
 195| |  get maxAge() {
 196| |    return this.jar[this.name]?.maxAge ?? this.initial.maxAge;
 197| |  }
 199| |  set maxAge(v: number | undefined) {
 200| |    this._set("maxAge", v);
 201| |  }
 203| |  get domain() {
 204| |    return this.jar[this.name]?.domain ?? this.initial.domain;
 205| |  }
 207| |  set domain(v: string | undefined) {
 208| |    this._set("domain", v);
 209| |  }
 211| |  get path() {
 212| |    return this.jar[this.name]?.path ?? this.initial.path;
 213| |  }
 215| |  set path(v: string | undefined) {
 216| |    this._set("path", v);
 217| |  }
 219| |  get secure() {
 220| |    return this.jar[this.name]?.secure ?? this.initial.secure;
 221| |  }
 223| |  set secure(v: boolean | undefined) {
 224| |    this._set("secure", v);
 225| |  }
 227| |  get httpOnly() {
 228| |    return this.jar[this.name]?.httpOnly ?? this.initial.httpOnly;
 229| |  }
 231| |  set httpOnly(v: boolean | undefined) {
 232| |    this._set("httpOnly", v);
 233| |  }
 235| |  get sameSite() {
 236| |    return this.jar[this.name]?.sameSite ?? this.initial.sameSite;
 237| |  }
 239| |  set sameSite(v: true | false | "lax" | "strict" | "none" | undefined) {
 240| |    this._set("sameSite", v);
 241| |  }
 243| |  update(config: Partial<ElysiaCookie>): this {
 244| |    const entry = (this.jar[this.name] ??= { ...this.initial });
 245| |    Object.assign(entry, config);
 246| |    return this;
 247| |  }
 249| |  remove(): this {
 250| |    this.update({ expires: new Date(0), maxAge: 0, value: "" });
 251| |    return this;
 252| |  }
 254| |  toString(): string {
 255| |    const v = this.value;
 256| |    return typeof v === "object" ? JSON.stringify(v) : String(v ?? "");
 257| |  }
 259| |  private _set(key: string, value: unknown) {
 260| |    const entry = (this.jar[this.name] ??= { ...this.initial });
 261| |    (entry as Record<string, unknown>)[key] = value;
 262| |  }
 263| |}
 265|▼|export const createCookieJar = (
 266| |  set: SetHeaders,
 267| |  store: Record<string, ElysiaCookie>,
 268| |  initial?: Partial<ElysiaCookie>
 269| |): Record<string, Cookie> => {
 270| |  if (!set.cookie) set.cookie = Object.create(null);
 272| |  return new Proxy(store, {
 273| |    get(_, key: string) {
 274| |      return new Cookie(key, set.cookie!, { ...initial, ...store[key] });
 275| |    },
 276| |  }) as Record<string, Cookie>;
 277| |};
 279|▼|export const createLazyCookieJar = (
 280| |  set: SetHeaders,
 281| |  getCookieHeader: () => string | null,
 282| |  initial?: Partial<ElysiaCookie>
 283| |): Record<string, Cookie> => {
 284| |  if (!set.cookie) set.cookie = Object.create(null);
 286| |  let parsed: Record<string, string> | undefined;
 288|▼|  const ensureParsed = () => {
 289| |    if (!parsed) {
 290| |      parsed = parseCookieString(getCookieHeader());
 291| |    }
 293| |    return parsed;
 294| |  };
 296| |  const target = Object.create(null);
 298| |  return new Proxy(target, {
 299| |    get(_, key: string) {
 300| |      const store = ensureParsed();
 302| |      return new Cookie(key, set.cookie!, {
 303| |        ...initial,
 304| |        value: store[key],
 305| |      });
 306| |    },
 307| |  }) as Record<string, Cookie>;
 308| |};
 310| |const HDR_JSON = { "content-type": "application/json; charset=utf-8" };
 311| |const HDR_TEXT = { "content-type": "text/plain; charset=utf-8" };
 312| |const HDR_HTML = { "content-type": "text/html; charset=utf-8" };
 314| |let requestIdCounter = 0;
 316|▼|const generateRequestId = (): string => {
 317| |  const ts = performance.now().toString(36).replace(".", "");
 318| |  const seq = (++requestIdCounter).toString(36);
 319| |  return `${ts}-${seq}`;
 320| |};
 322|▼|type ResponseHeadersInit = NonNullable<ResponseInit["headers"]>;
 324|▼|type FluxHeadersInit =
 325| |  | ResponseHeadersInit
 326| |  | Record<string, string | undefined>
 327| |  | Array<[string, string | undefined]>;
 329|▼|const asResponseHeaders = (headers: Headers): ResponseHeadersInit =>
 330| |  headers as unknown as ResponseHeadersInit;
 332|▼|const mergeHeaders = (
 333| |  base: Record<string, string>,
 334| |  init?: FluxHeadersInit
 335| |): ResponseHeadersInit => {
 336| |  const headers = new Headers(base);
 338| |  if (init === undefined) {
 339| |    return asResponseHeaders(headers);
 340| |  }
 342| |  const forEachFn = (init as { forEach?: unknown }).forEach;
 344| |  if (!Array.isArray(init) && typeof forEachFn === "function") {
 345| |    (forEachFn as (cb: (value: string, key: string) => void) => void).call(
 346| |      init,
 347| |      (value, key) => {
 348| |        headers.set(key, value);
 349| |      }
 350| |    );
 352| |    return asResponseHeaders(headers);
 353| |  }
 355| |  if (Array.isArray(init)) {
 356| |    for (const [key, value] of init as Array<[string, string | undefined]>) {
 357| |      if (value !== undefined) {
 358| |        headers.set(key, value);
 359| |      }
 360| |    }
 362| |    return asResponseHeaders(headers);
 363| |  }
 365| |  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(
 366| |    init as Record<string, string | undefined>
 367| |  )) {
 368| |    if (value !== undefined) {
 369| |      headers.set(key, value);
 370| |    }
 371| |  }
 373| |  return asResponseHeaders(headers);
 374| |};
 376|▼|const createResponseInit = (
 377| |  status: number,
 378| |  headers?: FluxHeadersInit
 379| |): ResponseInit => {
 380| |  if (headers === undefined) {
 381| |    return { status };
 382| |  }
 384| |  return {
 385| |    status,
 386| |    headers: mergeHeaders({}, headers),
 387| |  };
 388| |};
 390| |const defaultCache = new HttpResponseCache({
 391| |  max: 1000,
 392| |  ttlMs: 60_000,
 393| |  staleTtlMs: 300_000,
 394| |});
 396| |export function createContext<P = Record<string, string>>(
 397| |  req: Request,
 398| |  params: P,
 399| |  opts: ContextOptions = {}
 400| |): FluxContext<P, URLSearchParams> {
 401| |  let _url: URL | undefined;
 402| |  let _query: URLSearchParams | undefined = opts.query;
 404| |  const body = opts.bodyInstance ?? createLazyBody(req, opts.body);
 406| |  let state: Map<string | symbol, unknown> | undefined;
 408|▼|  const ensureState = () => {
 409| |    if (!state) {
 410| |      state = new Map<string | symbol, unknown>();
 411| |    }
 413| |    return state;
 414| |  };
 416| |  const set: SetHeaders = { headers: {}, status: 200, ...opts.set };
 418| |  const cookie = createLazyCookieJar(set, () => req.headers.get("cookie"));
 420| |  const ctx: FluxContext<P, URLSearchParams> = {
 421| |    req,
 423| |    get url() {
 424| |      return (_url ??= new URL(req.url));
 425| |    },
 427| |    method: req.method as HttpMethod,
 429| |    get path() {
 430| |      return this.url.pathname;
 431| |    },
 433| |    route: "",
 434| |    headers: req.headers,
 435| |    requestId: generateRequestId(),
 436| |    startTime: performance.now(),
 438| |    get ip(): string {
 439| |      const server = (this as any).server;
 441| |      try {
 442| |        const socketIp = server?.requestIP?.(req)?.address;
 443| |        if (socketIp) return socketIp;
 444| |      } catch {
 445| |        // ignore
 446| |      }
 448| |      return req.headers.get("x-real-ip") || "anonymous";
 449| |    },
 451| |    params,
 453| |    get query() {
 454| |      return (_query ??= this.url.searchParams) as URLSearchParams;
 455| |    },
 457| |    body,
 458| |    cookie,
 460| |    get state() {
 461| |      return ensureState();
 462| |    },
 464| |    getState<T = unknown>(key: string | symbol): T | undefined {
 465| |      return ensureState().get(key) as T | undefined;
 466| |    },
 468| |    setState<T>(key: string | symbol, value: T): void {
 469| |      ensureState().set(key, value);
 470| |    },
 472| |    json<T>(data: T, init?: ResponseInit): Response {
 473| |      const status = init?.status ?? set.status ?? 200;
 475| |      return Response.json(data, {
 476| |        status,
 477| |        headers: mergeHeaders(HDR_JSON, init?.headers),
 478| |      });
 479| |    },
 481| |    text(data: string, init?: ResponseInit): Response {
 482| |      const status = init?.status ?? set.status ?? 200;
 484| |      return new Response(data, {
 485| |        status,
 486| |        headers: mergeHeaders(HDR_TEXT, init?.headers),
 487| |      });
 488| |    },
 490| |    html(data: string, init?: ResponseInit): Response {
 491| |      const status = init?.status ?? set.status ?? 200;
 493| |      return new Response(data, {
 494| |        status,
 495| |        headers: mergeHeaders(HDR_HTML, init?.headers),
 496| |      });
 497| |    },
 499| |    stream(stream: ReadableStream, init?: ResponseInit): Response {
 500| |      return new Response(
 501| |        stream,
 502| |        createResponseInit(init?.status ?? 200, init?.headers)
 503| |      );
 504| |    },
 506| |    empty(status = 204): Response {
 507| |      return new Response(null, { status });
 508| |    },
 510| |    status(code: number): Response {
 511| |      return new Response(null, { status: code });
 512| |    },
 514| |    sendFile(path: string, sendOpts: SendFileOptions = {}) {
 515| |      return sendFile(path, { req, ...sendOpts });
 516| |    },
 518|→|    proxy(target: string | URL, proxyOpts: ProxyOptions = {}) {
 519| |      return proxyRequest(target, proxyOpts);
 520| |    },
 522| |    forward(target: string | URL, proxyOpts: ProxyOptions = {}) {
 523| |      return forwardRequest(req, target, proxyOpts);
 524| |    },
 526|→|    cache(factory: () => Promise<Response>, cacheOpts = {}) {
 527| |      return defaultCache.getOrSet(req, factory, cacheOpts);
 528| |    },
 530| |    redirect(
 531| |      url: string,
 532| |      status: 301 | 302 | 303 | 307 | 308 = 302
 533| |    ): Response {
 534| |      return Response.redirect(url, status);
 535| |    },
 537| |    server: null,
 538| |  };
 540| |  return ctx;
 541| |}

  93| |      logger
  94| |    );
  96| |    logger.info("optimization complete", {
  97| |      inlined: result.meta.inlined,
  98| |      deduplicated: result.meta.deduplicated,
  99| |      eliminated: result.meta.eliminated,
 100| |    });
 102| |    return result;
 103| |  });
 105|▼|export const runCodegenPhase = (
 106| |  optimized: OptimizationResult,
 107| |  analysis: AnalysisResult,
 108| |  opts: CompilerOptions,
 109| |  logger: Logger
 110| |): string =>
 111| |  logger.time("codegen", () => {
 112| |    const code = runCodeGen(
 113| |      optimized.routes,
 114| |      analysis.modules,
 115| |      analysis.hooks,
 116| |      opts,
 117| |      logger
 118| |    );
 120| |    logger.info("codegen complete", {
 121| |      lines: code.split("\n").length,
 122| |    });
 124| |    return code;
 125| |  });
 127|▼|export const runLinkingPhase = (
 128| |  code: string,
 129| |  opts: CompilerOptions,
 130| |  logger: Logger
 131| |): string =>
 132| |  logger.time("linker", () => {
 133| |    return runLinker(code, opts, logger);
 134| |  });
 136|▼|export const runLinkingPhaseAsync = async (
 137| |  code: string,
 138| |  opts: CompilerOptions,
 139| |  logger: Logger
 140| |): Promise<string> => {
 141| |  return runLinkerAsync(code, opts, logger);
 142| |};
 144|▼|export class FluxCompiler {
 145| |  constructor(private readonly input: Partial<CompilerOptions> = {}) {}
 147| |  compile(): CompiledRoute {
 148| |    const validated = validateOptions(this.input);
 150| |    if (!validated.ok) {
 151|!|      throw new Error(
 152| |        `Compiler options invalid:\n${validated.error.join("\n")}`
 153| |      );
 154| |    }
 156| |    const opts = validated.value;
 157| |    const logger = consoleLogger();
 158| |    const t0 = performance.now();
 160| |    if (opts.precompileValidators || opts.precompileSerializers) {
 161| |      logger.warn(
 162| |        "compile() is synchronous. Use buildAsync() to enable validator/serializer precompilation."
 163| |      );
 164| |    }
 166| |    logger.info("flux compiler started", {
 167| |      target: opts.target,
 168| |      optimizationLevel: opts.optimizationLevel,
 169| |      routesDir: opts.routesDir,
 170| |      outDir: opts.outDir,
 171| |    });
 173| |    const discovery = runDiscoveryPhase(opts, logger);
 174| |    const analysis = runAnalysisPhase(discovery, opts, logger);
 175| |    const optimized = runOptimizationPhase(analysis, opts, logger);
 177| |    writeArtifacts(optimized.routes, opts, logger);
 179| |    const code = runCodegenPhase(optimized, analysis, opts, logger);
 180| |    const outPath = runLinkingPhase(code, opts, logger);
 182| |    const elapsed = performance.now() - t0;
 184| |    logger.info("build complete", {
 185| |      elapsedMs: Number(elapsed.toFixed(2)),
 186| |      outPath,
 187| |    });
 189| |    return createCompilationResult(optimized, analysis, elapsed);
 190| |  }
 192| |  async compileAsync(): Promise<CompiledRoute> {
 193| |    const validated = validateOptions(this.input);
 195| |    if (!validated.ok) {
 196|!|      throw new Error(
 197| |        `Compiler options invalid:\n${validated.error.join("\n")}`
 198| |      );
 199| |    }
 201| |    const opts = validated.value;
 202| |    const logger = consoleLogger();
 203| |    const t0 = performance.now();
 205| |    logger.info("flux compiler started (async)", {
 206| |      target: opts.target,
 207| |      optimizationLevel: opts.optimizationLevel,
 208| |      routesDir: opts.routesDir,
 209| |      outDir: opts.outDir,
 210| |    });
 212| |    const discovery = runDiscoveryPhase(opts, logger);
 213| |    const analysis = runAnalysisPhase(discovery, opts, logger);
 214| |    const optimized = runOptimizationPhase(analysis, opts, logger);
 216| |    let routes = optimized.routes;
 218| |    routes = await precompileValidators(
 219| |      routes,
 220| |      analysis.modules,
 221| |      opts,
 222| |      logger
 223| |    );
 225| |    routes = await precompileSerializers(
 226| |      routes,
 227| |      analysis.modules,
 228| |      opts,
 229| |      logger
 230| |    );
 232| |    const enriched: OptimizationResult = {
 233| |      routes,
 234| |      meta: optimized.meta,
 235| |    };
 237| |    writeArtifacts(enriched.routes, opts, logger);
 239| |    const code = runCodegenPhase(enriched, analysis, opts, logger);
 240| |    const outPath = await runLinkingPhaseAsync(code, opts, logger);
 242| |    const elapsed = performance.now() - t0;
 244| |    logger.info("build complete", {
 245| |      elapsedMs: Number(elapsed.toFixed(2)),
 246| |      outPath,
 247| |    });
 249| |    return createCompilationResult(enriched, analysis, elapsed);
 250| |  }
 251| |}
 253|▼|export function build(opts?: Partial<CompilerOptions>): CompiledRoute {
 254| |  return new FluxCompiler(opts).compile();
 255| |}
 257|▼|export async function buildAsync(
 258| |  opts?: Partial<CompilerOptions>
 259| |): Promise<CompiledRoute> {
 260| |  return new FluxCompiler(opts).compileAsync();
 261| |}
 263| |if (import.meta.main) {
 264| |  await buildAsync();
 265| |}
---

   1| |/**
   2| | * @fileoverview Derive & Resolve — Context enrichment pipeline.
   3| | * Composable, type-safe context extensions.
   4| | */
   6| |import type { FluxContext } from "./context";
   7| |import type { MaybePromise } from "./types";
   9|▼|export type DeriveFn<In extends Record<string, unknown> = {}, Out extends Record<string, unknown> = {}> =
  10| |  (ctx: FluxContext & In) => MaybePromise<Out>;
  12|▼|export type ResolveFn<In extends Record<string, unknown> = {}, Out extends Record<string, unknown> = {}> =
  13| |  (ctx: FluxContext & In) => MaybePromise<Out>;
  15| |// ============================================================================
  16| |// Derive Pipeline (runs before validation)
  17| |// ============================================================================
  19|▼|export const createDerivePipeline = () => {
  20| |  const fns: DeriveFn[] = [];
  22| |  return {
  23| |    add(fn: DeriveFn) { fns.push(fn); return this; },
  25| |    async execute(ctx: FluxContext): Promise<FluxContext> {
  26| |      let current = ctx;
  27| |      for (const fn of fns) {
  28| |        const result = await fn(current);
  29| |        if (result && typeof result === "object") {
  30| |          Object.assign(current, result);
  31| |        }
  32| |      }
  33| |      return current;
  34| |    },
  36| |    get length() { return fns.length; },
  37| |  };
  38| |};
  40| |// ============================================================================
  41| |// Resolve Pipeline (runs after validation, before handler)
  42| |// ============================================================================
  44|▼|export const createResolvePipeline = () => {
  45| |  const fns: ResolveFn[] = [];
  47| |  return {
  48| |    add(fn: ResolveFn) { fns.push(fn); return this; },
  50| |    async execute(ctx: FluxContext): Promise<FluxContext> {
  51| |      let current = ctx;
  52| |      for (const fn of fns) {
  53| |        const result = await fn(current);
  54| |        if (result && typeof result === "object") {
  55| |          Object.assign(current, result);
  56| |        }
  57| |      }
  58| |      return current;
  59| |    },
  61| |    get length() { return fns.length; },
  62| |  };
  63| |};
  65| |// ============================================================================
  66| |// Common Derive Factories
  67| |// ============================================================================
  69|▼|export const deriveUser = <T>(extractor: (ctx: FluxContext) => MaybePromise<T | null>) =>
  70| |  async (ctx: FluxContext) => ({ user: await extractor(ctx) });
  72|▼|export const deriveDb = <T>(factory: () => T) =>
  73| |  (ctx: FluxContext) => ({ db: factory() });
  75|▼|export const deriveRequestId = () =>
  76| |  (ctx: FluxContext) => ({ requestId: ctx.requestId });

---
   1| |/**
   2| | * @fileoverview Hook Execution Engine v3.0
   3| | * Composable, async middleware with scoped lifecycle.
   4| | */
   6| |import type { FluxContext } from "./context";
   7| |import type { HookContainer, LifeCycleType } from "./types";
   9| |// ============================================================================
  10| |// Types
  11| |// ============================================================================
  13|▼|export type HookResult =
  14| |  | { readonly ok: true; ctx: FluxContext }
  15| |  | { readonly ok: false; response: Response };
  17|▼|export type HookFn = (ctx: FluxContext) => Promise<HookResult> | HookResult;
  19| |// ============================================================================
  20| |// Hook Constructors
  21| |// ============================================================================
  23|▼|export const continueHook = (ctx: FluxContext): HookResult => ({ ok: true, ctx });
  24|▼|export const haltHook = (response: Response): HookResult => ({ ok: false, response });
  26| |// ============================================================================
  27| |// Hook Execution
  28| |// ============================================================================
  30| |export const executeHooks = async (
  31| |  ctx: FluxContext,
  32| |  hooks: readonly HookFn[]
  33| |): Promise<{ ctx: FluxContext; halted?: Response }> => {
  34| |  let current = ctx;
  35| |  for (const hook of hooks) {
  36| |    const result = await hook(current);
  37| |    if (!result.ok) return { ctx: current, halted: result.response };
  38| |    current = result.ctx;
  39| |  }
  40| |  return { ctx: current };
  41| |};
  43| |// ============================================================================
  44| |// Hook Composition
  45| |// ============================================================================
  47|▼|export const composeHooks = (...hooks: HookFn[]): HookFn =>
  48| |  async (ctx) => {
  49| |    const result = await executeHooks(ctx, hooks);
  50| |    if (result.halted) return haltHook(result.halted);
  51| |    return continueHook(result.ctx);
  52| |  };
  54| |// ============================================================================
  55| |// Hook Filtering by Scope
  56| |// ============================================================================
  58|▼|export const filterByScope = (scope: LifeCycleType) =>
  59| |  (hooks: HookContainer[]): HookContainer[] =>
  60| |    hooks.filter(h => !h.scope || h.scope === scope || h.scope === "global");
  62|▼|export const filterGlobal = (hooks: HookContainer[]): HookContainer[] =>
  63| |  hooks.filter(h => h.scope === "global" || h.scope === "scoped");
  65| |// ============================================================================
  66| |// Hook Merging (Pure)
  67| |// ============================================================================
  69|▼|export const mergeHookArrays = (
  70| |  a: HookContainer[] | undefined,
  71| |  b: HookContainer[] | undefined
  72| |): HookContainer[] => {
  73| |  if (!a && !b) return [];
  74| |  if (!a) return b!;
  75| |  if (!b) return a;
  77| |  const checksums = new Set(a.map(h => h.checksum).filter(Boolean));
  78| |  const merged = [...a];
  79| |  for (const hook of b) {
  80| |    if (hook.checksum && checksums.has(hook.checksum)) continue;
  81| |    merged.push(hook);
  82| |  }
  83| |  return merged;
  84| |};
  86| |// ============================================================================
  87| |// Async Detection
  88| |// ============================================================================
  90|▼|export const isAsyncFn = (fn: Function): boolean =>
  91| |  fn.constructor.name === "AsyncFunction" ||
  92| |  fn.constructor.name === "AsyncGeneratorFunction";
  94| |// ============================================================================
  95| |// Higher-Order Hook Factories
  96| |// ============================================================================
  98|▼|export const withTiming = (name: string, hook: HookFn): HookFn =>
  99| |  async (ctx) => {
 100| |    const start = performance.now();
 101| |    const result = await hook(ctx);
 102| |    ctx.setState(`__timing_${name}`, performance.now() - start);
 103| |    return result;
 104| |  };
 106|▼|export const withErrorBoundary = (fallback: (err: Error) => Response) => (hook: HookFn): HookFn =>
 107| |  async (ctx) => {
 108| |    try { return await hook(ctx); }
 109|!|    catch (err) { return haltHook(fallback(err as Error)); }
 110| |  };
 112|▼|export const conditional = (predicate: (ctx: FluxContext) => boolean) => (hook: HookFn): HookFn =>
 113| |  (ctx) => predicate(ctx) ? hook(ctx) : continueHook(ctx);
---

---
   1| |// ============================================================================
   2| |// FLUX HTTP — Schema-first typed route definitions
   3| |// ============================================================================
   4| |//
   5| |// Breaking change:
   6| |// - The second argument is now a schema object, not a route path.
   7| |// - Route path is inferred from the filename by the compiler.
   8| |//
   9| |// Example:
  10| |//   export default get(async (ctx) => {
  11| |//     return ctx.json({ q: ctx.query.q });
  12| |//   }, {
  13| |//     query: Type.Object({ q: Type.String() }),
  14| |//   });
  15| |// ============================================================================
  17| |import type { FluxContext } from "./context";
  18| |import type { LazyBody } from "./body";
  19| |import type { MaybePromise, StandardSchemaV1, TSchema } from "./types";
  21|▼|export type SchemaLike = StandardSchemaV1<any, any> | TSchema | object;
  23|▼|export type RouteSchemas = {
  24| |  body?: SchemaLike;
  25| |  query?: SchemaLike;
  26| |  params?: SchemaLike;
  27| |  headers?: SchemaLike;
  28| |  response?: SchemaLike | Record<number, SchemaLike>;
  29| |};
  31|▼|export type BodyRouteSchemas = RouteSchemas;
  32|▼|export type NoBodyRouteSchemas = Omit<RouteSchemas, "body">;
  34|▼|type InferSchema<T> = T extends StandardSchemaV1<any, infer Output>
  35| |  ? Output
  36| |  : T extends { static: infer S }
  37| |    ? S
  38| |    : unknown;
  40|▼|type InferBody<S> = S extends { body: infer X } ? InferSchema<X> : unknown;
  42|▼|type InferQuery<S> = S extends { query: infer X }
  43| |  ? InferSchema<X>
  44| |  : URLSearchParams;
  46|▼|type InferParams<S> = S extends { params: infer X }
  47| |  ? InferSchema<X>
  48| |  : Record<string, string>;
  50|▼|type LooksLikeSchema<T> = T extends StandardSchemaV1<any, any>
  51| |  ? true
  52| |  : T extends { "~standard": unknown }
  53| |    ? true
  54| |    : T extends { static: unknown }
  55| |      ? true
  56| |      : T extends { type: string }
  57| |        ? true
  58| |        : false;
  60|▼|type InferResponse<S> = S extends { response: infer R }
  61| |  ? LooksLikeSchema<R> extends true
  62| |    ? InferSchema<R>
  63| |    : R extends Record<string, infer V>
  64| |      ? InferSchema<V>
  65| |      : unknown
  66| |  : unknown;
  68|▼|type TypedLazyBody<B> = {
  69| |  json<T = B>(): Promise<T>;
  70| |  form<T = B extends Record<string, unknown> ? B : Record<string, string>>(): Promise<T>;
  71| |  multipart<T = B extends Record<string, unknown> ? B : Record<string, unknown>>(): Promise<T>;
  72| |} & LazyBody;
  74|▼|export type RouteContext<S extends Partial<RouteSchemas>> = Omit<
  75| |  FluxContext<InferParams<S>, InferQuery<S>, InferBody<S>>,
  76| |  "body" | "query"
  77| |> & {
  78| |  body: TypedLazyBody<InferBody<S>>;
  79| |  query: InferQuery<S>;
  80| |};
  82|▼|type RouteResult<S extends Partial<RouteSchemas>> = MaybePromise<
  83| |  Response | InferResponse<S>
  84| |>;
  86|▼|export type RouteHandler<S extends Partial<RouteSchemas>> = (
  87| |  ctx: RouteContext<S>,
  88| |) => RouteResult<S>;
  90| |/**
  91| | * Backward-compatible handler type.
  92| | */
  93|▼|export type Handler<
  94| |  B = unknown,
  95| |  Q = URLSearchParams,
  96| |  P = Record<string, string>,
  97| |> = (ctx: FluxContext<P, Q, B>) => MaybePromise<unknown>;
  99|▼|type AnyFunction = (...args: any[]) => any;
 101|▼|const attachSchema = <T extends AnyFunction>(fn: T, schemaOrPath?: unknown): T => {
 102| |  // Runtime compatibility: if an old path string is passed, ignore it.
 103| |  if (schemaOrPath == null || typeof schemaOrPath === "string") {
 104| |    return fn;
 105| |  }
 107| |  Object.defineProperty(fn, "schema", {
 108| |    value: schemaOrPath,
 109| |    enumerable: false,
 110| |    writable: false,
 111| |    configurable: true,
 112| |  });
 114| |  return fn;
 115| |};
 117| |/** Path is inferred from filename. Second parameter is a schema object. */
 118|▼|export function get<const S extends NoBodyRouteSchemas = {}>(
 119| |  fn: RouteHandler<S>,
 120| |  schema?: S,
 121| |): RouteHandler<S> {
 122| |  return attachSchema(fn, schema);
 123| |}
 125| |/** Path is inferred from filename. Second parameter is a schema object. */
 126|▼|export function post<const S extends BodyRouteSchemas = {}>(
 127| |  fn: RouteHandler<S>,
 128| |  schema?: S,
 129| |): RouteHandler<S> {
 130| |  return attachSchema(fn, schema);
 131| |}
 133| |/** Path is inferred from filename. Second parameter is a schema object. */
 134|▼|export function put<const S extends BodyRouteSchemas = {}>(
 135| |  fn: RouteHandler<S>,
 136| |  schema?: S,
 137| |): RouteHandler<S> {
 138| |  return attachSchema(fn, schema);
 139| |}
 141| |/** Path is inferred from filename. Second parameter is a schema object. */
 142|▼|export function patch<const S extends BodyRouteSchemas = {}>(
 143| |  fn: RouteHandler<S>,
 144| |  schema?: S,
 145| |): RouteHandler<S> {
 146| |  return attachSchema(fn, schema);
 147| |}
 149| |/** Path is inferred from filename. Second parameter is a schema object. */
 150|▼|export function del<const S extends BodyRouteSchemas = {}>(
 151| |  fn: RouteHandler<S>,
 152| |  schema?: S,
 153| |): RouteHandler<S> {
 154| |  return attachSchema(fn, schema);
 155| |}
 157| |/** Path is inferred from filename. Second parameter is a schema object. */
 158|▼|export function all<const S extends BodyRouteSchemas = {}>(
 159| |  fn: RouteHandler<S>,
 160| |  schema?: S,
 161| |): RouteHandler<S> {
 162| |  return attachSchema(fn, schema);
 163| |}
