>packages/core/src/macro.ts
l:./context|./types
e:MacroContext|MacroFn|MacroDefinition|createMacroRegistry|authMacro|cacheMacro
f:createMacroRegistry()
t:MacroContext
t:MacroFn
t:MacroDefinition
---
   1| |/**
   2| | * Macro System
   3| | *
   4| | * Fixed:
   5| | * - afterHandle can return Response
   6| | * - afterHandle hooks are placed in afterHandle lifecycle
   7| | */
   9| |import type { FluxContext } from "./context";
  10| |import type { LifeCycleStore, HookContainer } from "./types";
  12|▼|export interface MacroContext {
  13| |  onRequest?: (ctx: FluxContext) => Response | void | Promise<Response | void>;
  14| |  beforeHandle?: (ctx: FluxContext) => Response | void | Promise<Response | void>;
  15| |  afterHandle?: (
  16| |    ctx: FluxContext,
  17| |    response: Response
  18| |  ) => Response | void | Promise<Response | void>;
  19| |  afterResponse?: (ctx: FluxContext, response: Response) => void | Promise<void>;
  20| |}
  22|▼|export type MacroFn = (value: unknown, ctx: MacroContext) => void;
  24|▼|export interface MacroDefinition {
  25| |  name: string;
  26| |  fn: MacroFn;
  27| |}
  29|▼|export const createMacroRegistry = () => {
  30| |  const macros = new Map<string, MacroFn>();
  32| |  return {
  33| |    register(name: string, fn: MacroFn) {
  34| |      macros.set(name, fn);
  35| |      return this;
  36| |    },
  38| |    apply(
  39| |      routeConfig: Record<string, unknown>,
  40| |      lifecycle: LifeCycleStore
  41| |    ): LifeCycleStore {
  42| |      const macroCtx: MacroContext = {};
  44| |      for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(routeConfig)) {
  45| |        const macro = macros.get(key);
  46| |        if (macro && value !== undefined) {
  47| |          macro(value, macroCtx);
  48| |        }
  49| |      }
  51| |      const requestHooks: HookContainer[] = [];
  52| |      const beforeHooks: HookContainer[] = [];
  53| |      const afterHooks: HookContainer[] = [];
  55| |      if (macroCtx.onRequest) {
  56| |        requestHooks.push({ fn: macroCtx.onRequest, scope: "local" });
  57| |      }
  59| |      if (macroCtx.beforeHandle) {
  60| |        beforeHooks.push({ fn: macroCtx.beforeHandle, scope: "local" });
  61| |      }
  63| |      if (macroCtx.afterHandle) {
  64| |        afterHooks.push({ fn: macroCtx.afterHandle, scope: "local" });
  65| |      }
  67| |      return {
  68| |        ...lifecycle,
  69| |        request: [...lifecycle.request, ...requestHooks],
  70| |        beforeHandle: [...lifecycle.beforeHandle, ...beforeHooks],
  71| |        afterHandle: [...lifecycle.afterHandle, ...afterHooks],
  72| |      };
  73| |    },
  75| |    has(name: string): boolean {
  76| |      return macros.has(name);
  77| |    },
  79| |    get size(): number {
  80| |      return macros.size;
  81| |    },
  82| |  };
  83| |};
  85| |export const authMacro: MacroDefinition = {
  86| |  name: "auth",
  87| |  fn(value, ctx) {
  88| |    if (value === true) {
  89| |      ctx.beforeHandle = (c: FluxContext) => {
  90| |        if (!c.headers.get("authorization")) {
  91| |          return Response.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  92| |        }
  93| |      };
  94| |    }
  95| |  },
  96| |};
  98| |export const cacheMacro: MacroDefinition = {
  99| |  name: "cache",
 100| |  fn(value, ctx) {
 101| |    if (typeof value === "number") {
 102| |      ctx.afterHandle = (_c: FluxContext, response: Response) => {
 103| |        const headers = new Headers(response.headers);
 104| |        headers.set("cache-control", `public, max-age=${value}`);
 106| |        return new Response(response.body, {
 107| |          status: response.status,
 108| |          statusText: response.statusText,
 109| |          headers,
 110| |        });
 111| |      };
 112| |    }
 113| |  },
 114| |};

   9| |  constructor(

  17| |      return this.raw.send(JSON.stringify(data), compress);

   1| |/**
   2| | * @fileoverview Guard — Scoped hook application.
   3| | * Apply hooks to a group of routes with proper scoping.
   4| | */
   6| |import type { LifeCycleStore, HookContainer, LifeCycleType } from "./types";
   7| |import { EMPTY_LIFECYCLE } from "./types";
   8| |import { mergeHookArrays } from "./hooks";
  10|▼|export interface GuardOptions {
  11| |  scope?: LifeCycleType;
  12| |  beforeHandle?: HookContainer | HookContainer[];
  13| |  afterHandle?: HookContainer | HookContainer[];
  14| |  transform?: HookContainer | HookContainer[];
  15| |  error?: HookContainer | HookContainer[];
  16| |  onRequest?: HookContainer | HookContainer[];
  17| |}
  19|▼|export const createGuard = (options: GuardOptions = {}) => {
  20| |  const scope = options.scope ?? "scoped";
  22|▼|  const toContainers = (hooks: HookContainer | HookContainer[] | undefined): HookContainer[] => {
  23| |    if (!hooks) return [];
  24| |    const arr = Array.isArray(hooks) ? hooks : [hooks];
  25| |    return arr.map(h => ({ ...h, scope: h.scope ?? scope }));
  26| |  };
  28| |  const guardHooks: Partial<LifeCycleStore> = {
  29| |    beforeHandle: toContainers(options.beforeHandle),
  30| |    afterHandle: toContainers(options.afterHandle),
  31| |    transform: toContainers(options.transform),
  32| |    error: toContainers(options.error),
  33| |    request: toContainers(options.onRequest),
  34| |  };
  36| |  return {
  37| |    scope,
  38| |    hooks: guardHooks,
  40| |    applyTo(lifecycle: LifeCycleStore): LifeCycleStore {
  41| |      return {
  42| |        ...lifecycle,
  43| |        beforeHandle: mergeHookArrays(lifecycle.beforeHandle, guardHooks.beforeHandle),
  44| |        afterHandle: mergeHookArrays(lifecycle.afterHandle, guardHooks.afterHandle),
  45| |        transform: mergeHookArrays(lifecycle.transform, guardHooks.transform),
  46| |        error: mergeHookArrays(lifecycle.error, guardHooks.error),
  47| |        request: mergeHookArrays(lifecycle.request, guardHooks.request),
  48| |      };
  49| |    },
  50| |  };
  51| |};
  53|▼|export const mergeLifeCycle = (a: LifeCycleStore, b: Partial<LifeCycleStore>): LifeCycleStore => ({
  54| |  start: mergeHookArrays(a.start, b.start),
  55| |  request: mergeHookArrays(a.request, b.request),
  56| |  parse: mergeHookArrays(a.parse, b.parse),
  57| |  transform: mergeHookArrays(a.transform, b.transform),
  58| |  beforeHandle: mergeHookArrays(a.beforeHandle, b.beforeHandle),
  59| |  afterHandle: mergeHookArrays(a.afterHandle, b.afterHandle),
  60| |  mapResponse: mergeHookArrays(a.mapResponse, b.mapResponse),
  61| |  afterResponse: mergeHookArrays(a.afterResponse, b.afterResponse),
  62| |  trace: mergeHookArrays(a.trace, b.trace),
  63| |  error: mergeHookArrays(a.error, b.error),
  64| |  stop: mergeHookArrays(a.stop, b.stop),
  65| |});

   1| |/**
   2| | * @fileoverview Plugin Architecture v3.1
   3| | * Lifecycle hooks, extensibility, composable plugins.
   4| | */
   6| |import type { FluxContext } from "./context";
   7| |import type { HookFn } from "./hooks";
   8| |import type { HookContainer, LifeCycleStore } from "./types";
  10| |// ============================================================================
  11| |// Plugin Interface
  12| |// ============================================================================
  14|▼|export interface FluxPlugin {
  15| |  readonly name: string;
  16| |  readonly version?: string;
  18| |  // Lifecycle
  19| |  init?(): MaybePromise<void>;
  20| |  close?(): MaybePromise<void>;
  22| |  // Request lifecycle
  23| |  onRequest?(ctx: FluxContext): MaybePromise<FluxContext | Response>;
  24| |  onResponse?(ctx: FluxContext, response: Response): MaybePromise<Response>;
  25| |  onError?(error: Error, ctx: FluxContext): MaybePromise<Response | void>;
  26| |}
  28|▼|type MaybePromise<T> = T | Promise<T>;
  30| |// ============================================================================
  31| |// Plugin Registry
  32| |// ============================================================================
  34|▼|export interface PluginContext {
  35| |  plugins: FluxPlugin[];
  36| |  hooks: Map<string, HookFn[]>;
  37| |  addHook(name: string, hook: HookFn): void;
  38| |  getHooks(name: string): readonly HookFn[];
  39| |  register(plugin: FluxPlugin): void;
  40| |  initAll(): Promise<void>;
  41| |  closeAll(): Promise<void>;
  42| |}
  44|▼|export const createPluginContext = (): PluginContext => {
  45| |  const hooks = new Map<string, HookFn[]>();
  46| |  const plugins: FluxPlugin[] = [];
  48| |  return {
  49| |    plugins,
  50| |    hooks,
  51| |    addHook(name, hook) {
  52| |      const existing = hooks.get(name) ?? [];
  53| |      existing.push(hook);
  54| |      hooks.set(name, existing);
  55| |    },
  56| |    getHooks(name) {
  57| |      return hooks.get(name) ?? [];
  58| |    },
  59| |    register(plugin) {
  60| |      plugins.push(plugin);
  61| |    },
  62| |    async initAll() {
  63| |      for (const p of plugins) await p.init?.();
  64| |    },
  65| |    async closeAll() {
  66| |      for (const p of plugins) await p.close?.();
  67| |    },
  68| |  };
  69| |};
  71| |// ============================================================================
  72| |// Plugin Composition
  73| |// ============================================================================
  75|▼|export const composePlugins = (...plugins: FluxPlugin[]): FluxPlugin => ({
  76| |  name: plugins.map((p) => p.name).join("+"),
  77| |  async init() {
  78| |    for (const p of plugins) await p.init?.();
  79| |  },
  80| |  async close() {
  81| |    for (const p of [...plugins].reverse()) await p.close?.();
  82| |  },
  83| |  async onRequest(ctx) {
  84| |    let current = ctx;
  85| |    for (const p of plugins) {
  86| |      const result = await p.onRequest?.(current);
  87| |      if (result instanceof Response) return result;
  88| |      if (result) current = result;
  89| |    }
  90| |    return current;
  91| |  },
  92| |  async onResponse(ctx, response) {
  93| |    let current = response;
  94| |    for (const p of [...plugins].reverse()) {
  95| |      current = (await p.onResponse?.(ctx, current)) ?? current;
  96| |    }
  97| |    return current;
  98| |  },
  99| |  async onError(error, ctx) {
 100| |    for (const p of plugins) {
 101| |      const result = await p.onError?.(error, ctx);
 102| |      if (result instanceof Response) return result;
 103| |    }
 104| |  },
 105| |});
 107| |// ============================================================================
 108| |// Plugin -> Lifecycle Bridge
 109| |// ============================================================================
 111|▼|function isFluxPlugin(value: unknown): value is FluxPlugin {
 112| |  return typeof value === "object" && value !== null && "name" in value;
 113| |}
 115|▼|export const pluginsToLifeCycle = (
 116| |  plugins: unknown[],
 117| |): Partial<LifeCycleStore> => {
 118| |  const list = (plugins ?? [])
 119| |    .flat()
 120| |    .filter(isFluxPlugin);
 122| |  const request: HookContainer[] = list
 123| |    .filter((p) => typeof p.onRequest === "function")
 124| |    .map((p) => ({
 125| |      scope: "global" as const,
 126| |      fn: async (ctx: FluxContext) => {
 127| |        const result = await p.onRequest!(ctx);
 128| |        if (result instanceof Response) {
 129| |          return { response: result };
 130| |        }
 131| |        if (result) {
 132| |          return { ctx: result };
 133| |        }
 134| |        return { ctx };
 135| |      },
 136| |    }));
 138| |  const afterHandle: HookContainer[] = list
 139| |    .filter((p) => typeof p.onResponse === "function")
 140| |    .map((p) => ({
 141| |      scope: "global" as const,
 142| |      fn: async (ctx: FluxContext, response: Response) => {
 143| |        const result = await p.onResponse!(ctx, response);
 144| |        if (result instanceof Response) {
 145| |          return { response: result };
 146| |        }
 147| |        return {};
 148| |      },
 149| |    }));
 151| |  const error: HookContainer[] = list
 152| |    .filter((p) => typeof p.onError === "function")
 153| |    .map((p) => ({
 154| |      scope: "global" as const,
 155| |      fn: async (ctx: FluxContext, error: unknown) => {
 156| |        const result = await p.onError!(error as Error, ctx);
 157| |        if (result instanceof Response) {
 158| |          return { response: result };
 159| |        }
 160| |        return {};
 161| |      },
 162| |    }));
 164| |  return {
 165| |    request,
 166| |    afterHandle,
 167| |    error,
 168| |  };
 169| |};

>packages/core/src/plugins/compression.ts

f:compression(options: CompressionOptions = {}):FluxPlugin

---
   1| |/**
   2| | * Compression plugin — Bun 1.4 edition.
   3| | *
   4| | * Adds Brotli when available.
   5| | */
   7| |import type { FluxPlugin } from "../plugin";
   9|▼|export interface CompressionOptions {
  10| |  threshold?: number;
  11| |  filter?: (contentType: string) => boolean;
  12| |}
  14| |const COMPRESSIBLE = new Set([
  15| |  "text/",
  16| |  "application/json",
  17| |  "application/javascript",
  18| |  "application/xml",
  19| |  "image/svg+xml",
  20| |]);
  22|▼|const shouldCompress = (ct: string): boolean => {
  23| |  for (const prefix of COMPRESSIBLE) {
  24| |    if (ct.startsWith(prefix)) return true;
  25| |  }
  27| |  return false;
  28| |};
  30| |let supportsBrotli = false;
  32| |try {
  33| |  const CS = (globalThis as any).CompressionStream;
  35| |  if (typeof CS !== "undefined") {
  36| |    new CS("br");
  37| |    supportsBrotli = true;
  38| |  }
  39| |} catch {
  40| |  supportsBrotli = false;
  41| |}
  43|▼|export const compression = (options: CompressionOptions = {}): FluxPlugin => {
  44| |  const { threshold = 1024, filter = shouldCompress } = options;
  46| |  return {
  47| |    name: "compression",
  49| |    onResponse(ctx, response) {
  50| |      if (!response.body) return response;
  51| |      if (response.headers.get("content-encoding")) return response;
  53| |      const contentType = response.headers.get("content-type") || "";
  54| |      if (!filter(contentType)) return response;
  56| |      const contentLength = Number(response.headers.get("content-length") || "0");
  57| |      if (contentLength && contentLength < threshold) return response;
  59| |      const acceptEncoding = ctx.headers.get("accept-encoding") || "";
  61| |      const encoding =
  62| |        supportsBrotli && acceptEncoding.includes("br")
  63| |          ? "br"
  64| |          : acceptEncoding.includes("gzip")
  65| |            ? "gzip"
  66| |            : acceptEncoding.includes("deflate")
  67| |              ? "deflate"
  68| |              : null;
  70| |      if (!encoding) return response;
  72| |      const CS = (globalThis as any).CompressionStream;
  74| |      if (typeof CS === "undefined") {
  75| |        return response;
  76| |      }
  78| |      const headers = new Headers(response.headers);
  79| |      headers.set("content-encoding", encoding);
  80| |      headers.delete("content-length");
  81| |      headers.append("vary", "Accept-Encoding");
  83| |      const compressed = response.body.pipeThrough(new CS(encoding));
  85| |      return new Response(compressed, {
  86| |        status: response.status,
  87| |        statusText: response.statusText,
  88| |        headers,
  89| |      });
  90| |    },
  91| |  };
  92| |};

>packages/core/src/plugins/cors.ts
l:../plugin|../context
e:CorsOptions|cors
f:cors(options: CorsOptions = {}):FluxPlugin
f:isOriginAllowed(requestOrigin: string, ctx: FluxContext):boolean
f:appendVary(headers: Headers, value: string):void
f:setCorsHeaders(ctx: FluxContext, headers: Headers):void
t:CorsOptions
---
   1| |/**
   2| | * CORS plugin — Bun 1.4 hardened edition.
   3| | */
   5| |import type { FluxPlugin } from "../plugin";
   6| |import type { FluxContext } from "../context";
   8|▼|export interface CorsOptions {
   9| |  origin?: string | string[] | ((origin: string, ctx: FluxContext) => boolean);
  10| |  methods?: string[];
  11| |  allowedHeaders?: string[];
  12| |  exposedHeaders?: string[];
  13| |  credentials?: boolean;
  14| |  maxAge?: number;
  15| |  preflightContinue?: boolean;
  16| |}
  18| |const DEFAULT_METHODS = ["GET", "HEAD", "PUT", "PATCH", "POST", "DELETE"];
  20|▼|export const cors = (options: CorsOptions = {}): FluxPlugin => {
  21| |  const {
  22| |    origin = "*",
  23| |    methods = DEFAULT_METHODS,
  24| |    allowedHeaders,
  25| |    exposedHeaders,
  26| |    credentials = false,
  27| |    maxAge = 86400,
  28| |    preflightContinue = false,
  29| |  } = options;
  31| |  if (origin === "*" && credentials) {
  32|!|    throw new Error(
  33| |      "CORS misconfiguration: origin '*' cannot be used with credentials: true. Use an explicit origin allowlist."
  34| |    );
  35| |  }
  37|▼|  const isOriginAllowed = (requestOrigin: string, ctx: FluxContext): boolean => {
  38| |    if (origin === "*") return true;
  39| |    if (typeof origin === "string") return origin === requestOrigin;
  40| |    if (Array.isArray(origin)) return origin.includes(requestOrigin);
  41| |    return origin(requestOrigin, ctx);
  42| |  };
  44|▼|  const appendVary = (headers: Headers, value: string): void => {
  45| |    const existing = headers.get("vary");
  47| |    if (!existing) {
  48| |      headers.set("vary", value);
  49| |      return;
  50| |    }
  52| |    const parts = existing.split(",").map((x) => x.trim().toLowerCase());
  54| |    if (!parts.includes(value.toLowerCase())) {
  55| |      headers.set("vary", `${existing}, ${value}`);
  56| |    }
  57| |  };
  59|▼|  const setCorsHeaders = (ctx: FluxContext, headers: Headers): void => {
  60| |    appendVary(headers, "Origin");
  62| |    const requestOrigin = ctx.headers.get("origin") || "";
  63| |    if (!requestOrigin) return;
  65| |    if (isOriginAllowed(requestOrigin, ctx)) {
  66| |      headers.set("Access-Control-Allow-Origin", requestOrigin);
  68| |      if (credentials) {
  69| |        headers.set("Access-Control-Allow-Credentials", "true");
  70| |      }
  71| |    } else if (origin === "*" && !credentials) {
  72| |      headers.set("Access-Control-Allow-Origin", "*");
  73| |    }
  75| |    if (exposedHeaders?.length) {
  76| |      headers.set("Access-Control-Expose-Headers", exposedHeaders.join(", "));
  77| |    }
  78| |  };
  80| |  return {
  81| |    name: "cors",
  83| |    onRequest(ctx) {
  84| |      if (!ctx.headers.get("origin")) return ctx;
  86| |      if (ctx.method === "OPTIONS") {
  87| |        const headers = new Headers();
  89| |        setCorsHeaders(ctx, headers);
  90| |        headers.set("Access-Control-Allow-Methods", methods.join(", "));
  92| |        if (allowedHeaders?.length) {
  93| |          headers.set("Access-Control-Allow-Headers", allowedHeaders.join(", "));
  94| |        } else {
  95| |          const reqHeaders = ctx.headers.get("access-control-request-headers");
  97| |          if (reqHeaders) {
  98| |            headers.set("Access-Control-Allow-Headers", reqHeaders);
  99| |          }
 100| |        }
 102| |        headers.set("Access-Control-Max-Age", String(maxAge));
 104| |        if (preflightContinue) return ctx;
 106| |        return new Response(null, { status: 204, headers });
 107| |      }
 109| |      return ctx;
 110| |    },
 112| |    onResponse(ctx, response) {
 113| |      const headers = new Headers(response.headers);
 114| |      setCorsHeaders(ctx, headers);
 116| |      return new Response(response.body, {
 117| |        status: response.status,
 118| |        statusText: response.statusText,
 119| |        headers,
 120| |      });
 121| |    },
 122| |  };
 123| |};
---

   1| |/**
   2| | * Logger plugin.
   3| | *
   4| | * Hardened:
   5| | * - redacts sensitive headers
   6| | * - exactOptionalPropertyTypes-safe pino options
   7| | */
   8| |import pino, { type Logger as PinoLogger } from "pino";
   9| |import type { FluxPlugin } from "../plugin";
  10| |import type { FluxContext } from "../context";
  12|▼|export interface LoggerOptions {
  13| |  level?: string;
  14| |  logger?: PinoLogger;
  15| |  skip?: (ctx: FluxContext) => boolean;
  16| |}
  18| |const REDACT_PATHS = [
  19| |  "req.headers.authorization",
  20| |  "req.headers.cookie",
  21| |  "headers.authorization",
  22| |  "headers.cookie",
  23| |] as const;
  25| |/**
  26| | * Create a pino logger with safe defaults.
  27| | */
  28|▼|const createPinoLogger = (options: LoggerOptions): PinoLogger => {
  29| |  if (options.logger) return options.logger;
  31|→|  return pino({
  32| |    level: options.level ?? "info",
  33| |    base: null,
  34| |    redact: [...REDACT_PATHS],
  35| |  });
  36| |};
  38| |/**
  39| | * Build structured access-log payload.
  40| | */
  41|▼|const createLogPayload = (ctx: FluxContext, response: Response) => {
  42| |  const duration = performance.now() - ctx.startTime;
  44| |  return {
  45| |    requestId: ctx.requestId,
  46| |    method: ctx.method,
  47| |    path: ctx.path,
  48| |    status: response.status,
  49| |    durationMs: Math.round(duration * 1000) / 1000,
  50| |    timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
  51| |  };
  52| |};
  54|▼|export const logger = (options: LoggerOptions = {}): FluxPlugin => {
  55| |  const log = createPinoLogger(options);
  57| |  return {
  58| |    name: "logger",
  60| |    onResponse(ctx, response) {
  61| |      if (options.skip?.(ctx)) return response;
  63| |      const payload = createLogPayload(ctx, response);
  65| |      if (response.status >= 500) {
  66| |        log.error(payload);
  67| |      } else if (response.status >= 400) {
  68| |        log.warn(payload);
  69| |      } else {
  70| |        log.info(payload);
  71| |      }
  73| |      return response;
  74| |    },
  75| |  };
  76| |};

>packages/core/src/plugins/ratelimit.ts
l:../plugin|../context|../lru
e:RateLimitOptions|rateLimit
f:rateLimit(options: RateLimitOptions = {}):FluxPlugin
f:defaultKeyGenerator(ctx: FluxContext):string
f:getHeaders(entry: WindowEntry):Record<string, string>
t:RateLimitOptions
t:WindowEntry
---
   1| |/**
   2| | * Rate limit plugin — Bun 1.4 edition.
   3| | *
   4| | * Uses ctx.ip, which prefers Bun server.requestIP().
   5| | */
   7| |import type { FluxPlugin } from "../plugin";
   8| |import type { FluxContext } from "../context";
   9| |import { LRUCache } from "../lru";
  11|▼|export interface RateLimitOptions {
  12| |  windowMs?: number;
  13| |  maxRequests?: number;
  14| |  storeMax?: number;
  15| |  trustProxy?: boolean;
  16| |  keyGenerator?: (ctx: FluxContext) => string;
  17| |  skip?: (ctx: FluxContext) => boolean;
  18| |  message?: string;
  19| |}
  21|▼|interface WindowEntry {
  22| |  count: number;
  23| |  resetTime: number;
  24| |}
  26|▼|export const rateLimit = (options: RateLimitOptions = {}): FluxPlugin => {
  27| |  const {
  28| |    windowMs = 60_000,
  29| |    maxRequests = 100,
  30| |    storeMax = 10_000,
  31| |    trustProxy = false,
  32| |    skip,
  33| |    message = "Too many requests",
  34| |  } = options;
  36|▼|  const defaultKeyGenerator = (ctx: FluxContext): string => {
  37| |    if (trustProxy) {
  38| |      const xff = ctx.headers.get("x-forwarded-for");
  40| |      if (xff) {
  41| |        return xff.split(",")[0]?.trim() || ctx.ip;
  42| |      }
  43| |    }
  45| |    return ctx.ip;
  46| |  };
  48| |  const keyGenerator = options.keyGenerator ?? defaultKeyGenerator;
  50| |  const store = new LRUCache<string, WindowEntry>({
  51| |    max: storeMax,
  52| |    ttlMs: windowMs,
  53| |  });
  55|▼|  const getHeaders = (entry: WindowEntry): Record<string, string> => ({
  56| |    "X-RateLimit-Limit": String(maxRequests),
  57| |    "X-RateLimit-Remaining": String(Math.max(0, maxRequests - entry.count)),
  58| |    "X-RateLimit-Reset": String(Math.ceil(entry.resetTime / 1000)),
  59| |  });
  61| |  return {
  62| |    name: "rateLimit",
  64| |    onRequest(ctx) {
  65| |      if (skip?.(ctx)) return ctx;
  67| |      const key = keyGenerator(ctx);
  68| |      const now = Date.now();
  70| |      let entry = store.get(key);
  72| |      if (!entry || entry.resetTime <= now) {
  73| |        entry = { count: 0, resetTime: now + windowMs };
  74| |        store.set(key, entry, { ttlMs: windowMs });
  75| |      }
  77| |      entry.count++;
  79| |      store.set(key, entry, {
  80| |        ttlMs: Math.max(0, entry.resetTime - now),
  81| |      });
  83| |      if (entry.count > maxRequests) {
  84| |        return Response.json(
  85| |          { error: message },
  86| |          {
  87| |            status: 429,
  88| |            headers: {
  89| |              "content-type": "application/json",
  90| |              ...getHeaders(entry),
  91| |            },
  92| |          }
  93| |        );
  94| |      }
  96| |      ctx.setState("__ratelimit", entry);
  98| |      return ctx;
  99| |    },
 101| |    onResponse(ctx, response) {
 102| |      const entry = ctx.getState<WindowEntry>("__ratelimit");
 104| |      if (!entry) return response;
 106| |      const headers = new Headers(response.headers);
 108| |      for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(getHeaders(entry))) {
 109| |        headers.set(k, v);
 110| |      }
 112| |      return new Response(response.body, {
 113| |        status: response.status,
 114| |        statusText: response.statusText,
 115| |        headers,
 116| |      });
 117| |    },
 118| |  };
 119| |};
---

>packages/core/src/plugins/security.ts

f:security(options: SecurityOptions = {}):FluxPlugin
t:SecurityOptions
---
   1| |/**
   2| | * Security headers plugin — Bun 1.4 edition.
   3| | *
   4| | * HSTS only on HTTPS requests.
   5| | */
   7| |import type { FluxPlugin } from "../plugin";
   8| |import type { FluxContext } from "../context";
  10|▼|export interface SecurityOptions {
  11| |  contentSecurityPolicy?: string | false;
  12| |  crossOriginEmbedderPolicy?: string | false;
  13| |  crossOriginOpenerPolicy?: string | false;
  14| |  crossOriginResourcePolicy?: string | false;
  15| |  frameguard?: { action: "deny" | "sameorigin" } | false;
  16| |  hidePoweredBy?: boolean;
  17| |  hsts?: { maxAge?: number; includeSubDomains?: boolean; preload?: boolean } | false;
  18| |  noSniff?: boolean;
  19| |  referrerPolicy?: string | false;
  20| |  xssFilter?: boolean;
  21| |}
  23| |const DEFAULTS: SecurityOptions = {
  24| |  contentSecurityPolicy:
  25| |    "default-src 'self'; base-uri 'self'; font-src 'self' https: data:; form-action 'self'; frame-ancestors 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; object-src 'none'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' https: 'unsafe-inline'",
  26| |  crossOriginEmbedderPolicy: "require-corp",
  27| |  crossOriginOpenerPolicy: "same-origin",
  28| |  crossOriginResourcePolicy: "same-origin",
  29| |  frameguard: { action: "deny" },
  30| |  hidePoweredBy: true,
  31| |  hsts: { maxAge: 15552000, includeSubDomains: true, preload: true },
  32| |  noSniff: true,
  33| |  referrerPolicy: "no-referrer",
  34| |  xssFilter: true,
  35| |};
  37|▼|const isHttpsRequest = (ctx: FluxContext): boolean => {
  38| |  const forwardedProto = ctx.headers.get("x-forwarded-proto");
  40| |  if (forwardedProto && forwardedProto.toLowerCase().includes("https")) {
  41| |    return true;
  42| |  }
  44| |  try {
  45| |    return ctx.url.protocol === "https:";
  46| |  } catch {
  47| |    return false;
  48| |  }
  49| |};
  51|▼|export const security = (options: SecurityOptions = {}): FluxPlugin => {
  52| |  const opts = { ...DEFAULTS, ...options };
  54| |  return {
  55| |    name: "security",
  57| |    onResponse(ctx, response) {
  58| |      const headers = new Headers(response.headers);
  60| |      if (opts.contentSecurityPolicy) {
  61| |        headers.set("Content-Security-Policy", opts.contentSecurityPolicy);
  62| |      }
  64| |      if (opts.crossOriginEmbedderPolicy) {
  65| |        headers.set("Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy", opts.crossOriginEmbedderPolicy);
  66| |      }
  68| |      if (opts.crossOriginOpenerPolicy) {
  69| |        headers.set("Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy", opts.crossOriginOpenerPolicy);
  70| |      }
  72| |      if (opts.crossOriginResourcePolicy) {
  73| |        headers.set("Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy", opts.crossOriginResourcePolicy);
  74| |      }
  76| |      if (opts.frameguard) {
  77| |        headers.set("X-Frame-Options", opts.frameguard.action.toUpperCase());
  78| |      }
  80| |      if (opts.hidePoweredBy) {
  81| |        headers.delete("X-Powered-By");
  82| |      }
  84| |      if (opts.hsts && isHttpsRequest(ctx)) {
  85| |        let value = `max-age=${opts.hsts.maxAge ?? 15552000}`;
  87| |        if (opts.hsts.includeSubDomains) {
  88| |          value += "; includeSubDomains";
  89| |        }
  91| |        if (opts.hsts.preload) {
  92| |          value += "; preload";
  93| |        }
  95| |        headers.set("Strict-Transport-Security", value);
  96| |      }
  98| |      if (opts.noSniff) {
  99| |        headers.set("X-Content-Type-Options", "nosniff");
 100| |      }
 102| |      if (opts.referrerPolicy) {
 103| |        headers.set("Referrer-Policy", opts.referrerPolicy);
 104| |      }
 106| |      if (opts.xssFilter) {
 107| |        headers.set("X-XSS-Protection", "0");
 108| |      }
 110| |      return new Response(response.body, {
 111| |        status: response.status,
 112| |        statusText: response.statusText,
 113| |        headers,
 114| |      });
 115| |    },
 116| |  };
 117| |};
